                    st.write("**Mapping:**", ten_xa_mapping if ten_xa_mapping else "(Táº¥t cáº£ tÃªn khá»›p trá»±c tiáº¿p)")

            xa_chon_raw = st.selectbox("Chá»n XÃ£/PhÆ°á»ng", ds_xa_pgd, key="m07_xa")

            # xa_chon_raw: tÃªn gá»‘c tá»« config (dÃ¹ng cho slug/key lÆ°u)
            # xa_chon:     tÃªn trong HSTD (dÃ¹ng cho filter dá»¯ liá»‡u)
            xa_chon = ten_xa_mapping.get(xa_chon_raw, xa_chon_raw)
            if st.query_params.get("debug") == "1" and xa_chon != xa_chon_raw:
                st.caption(f"ðŸ“Œ Mapping: '{xa_chon_raw}' â†’ '{xa_chon}' (trong HSTD)")
            elif df_full is not None and "TÃªn xÃ£" in df_full.columns:
                ds_xa_co_data = df_full["TÃªn xÃ£"].dropna().unique()
                if xa_chon not in ds_xa_co_data:
                    st.warning(f"âš ï¸ XÃ£ '{xa_chon}' khÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y trong HSTD. Kiá»ƒm tra XA_NAME_MAP hoáº·c tÃªn xÃ£.")

        with col_nam:
            nam_kh = st.number_input(
                "NÄƒm KH", min_value=2024, max_value=2030,
                value=_NAM_KH_DEFAULT, step=1, key="m07_nam",
            )

        pgd_slug_key = _slug(pgd_chon)
        xa_slug_key  = _slug(xa_chon_raw)  # DÃ¹ng xa_chon_raw (tÃªn gá»‘c) cho slug Ä‘á»ƒ á»•n Ä‘á»‹nh key lÆ°u
        nam_baseline = nam_kh - 1

        # â”€â”€ â‘¡ Loáº¡i vÄƒn báº£n â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        loai_chon = st.radio(
            "Loáº¡i vÄƒn báº£n",
            ["ðŸ†• Giao láº§n Ä‘áº§u", "âœï¸ Äiá»u chá»‰nh"],
            horizontal=True,
            key="m07_loai",
            label_visibility="collapsed",
        )
        loai_van_ban = "giao" if "Giao" in loai_chon else "dieu_chinh"

        # â”€â”€ â‘¢ Äá»c dá»¯ liá»‡u â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        kv_key_ht = _kv_key(pgd_chon, xa_chon_raw)
        kv_key_ls = _kv_key_ls(pgd_chon, xa_chon_raw)
        data_hien_tai: dict = _doc_kv_dict(kv_key_ht)
        lich_su: list       = _doc_kv_list(kv_key_ls)

        # Äá»c baseline HSTD 31/12
        df_baseline = None
        co_baseline = False
        try:
            from config import (
                baseline_pgd_path, baseline_path,
                danh_sach_nam_baseline_pgd,
            )
            from data.hstd import doc_baseline_merged, doc_baseline

            ds_nam_bl = danh_sach_nam_baseline_pgd()
            if nam_baseline in ds_nam_bl:
                fp = baseline_pgd_path(pgd_chon, nam_baseline)
                _ts = os.path.getmtime(fp) if os.path.exists(fp) else 0
                df_baseline = doc_baseline_merged(nam_baseline, _ts=_ts)
                co_baseline = df_baseline is not None and not df_baseline.empty

            if not co_baseline:
                fp2  = baseline_path(nam_baseline)
                _ts2 = os.path.getmtime(fp2) if os.path.exists(fp2) else 0
                df_baseline = doc_baseline(nam_baseline, _ts=_ts2)
                co_baseline = df_baseline is not None and not df_baseline.empty
        except Exception:
            co_baseline = False

        if co_baseline:
            _raw = tinh_du_no_ap_baseline(df_baseline, xa_chon)
            # Kiá»ƒm tra lá»—i tráº£ vá» tá»« hÃ m
            if "_err" in _raw:
                _err_msg = _raw["_err"]
                st.warning(f"âš ï¸ Baseline 31/12/{nam_baseline} cÃ³ nhÆ°ng khÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c dÆ° ná»£: {_err_msg}")
                # Váº«n hiá»ƒn thá»‹ debug Ä‘á»ƒ cháº©n Ä‘oÃ¡n
                with st.expander("ðŸ” Debug baseline", expanded=True):
                    st.write(f"**Cá»™t trong file:** {list(df_baseline.columns[:15])}")
                    if COT_TEN_XA in df_baseline.columns or "TÃªn xÃ£" in df_baseline.columns:
                        col_xa_debug = COT_TEN_XA if COT_TEN_XA in df_baseline.columns else "TÃªn xÃ£"
                        ds_xa_debug = sorted(df_baseline[col_xa_debug].dropna().unique().tolist())
                        st.write(f"**Danh sÃ¡ch xÃ£ trong baseline ({len(ds_xa_debug)} xÃ£):** {ds_xa_debug[:10]}")
                        st.caption(f"Äang tÃ¬m xÃ£: **'{xa_chon}'** â€” kiá»ƒm tra tÃªn cÃ³ khá»›p khÃ´ng")
                du_no_baseline = {}
            else:
                so_ap = len({k.split("|")[0] for k in _raw})
                so_ct = len(_raw)
                st.success(
                    f"âœ… Baseline 31/12/{nam_baseline}: {so_ap} áº¥p/thÃ´n, {so_ct} chá»‰ tiÃªu "
                    f"â€” dÃ¹ng lÃ m sá»‘ gá»‘c láº§n Ä‘áº§u"
                )
                du_no_baseline = _raw
        else:
            st.warning(
                f"âš ï¸ ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u HSTD 31/12/{nam_baseline} â€” "
                "sá»‘ gá»‘c láº§n Ä‘áº§u = 0. Vui lÃ²ng upload baseline trÆ°á»›c."
            )
            du_no_baseline = {}

        if lich_su:
            st.info(
                f"ðŸ“œ ÄÃ£ cÃ³ **{len(lich_su)}** láº§n giao/Ä‘iá»u chá»‰nh. "
                f"Sá»‘ gá»‘c hiá»‡n táº¡i = Chá»‰ tiÃªu KH láº§n {len(lich_su)}."
            )

        st.divider()

        # â”€â”€ â‘£â‘¤ Báº¢NG NHáº¬P DUY NHáº¤T (THAY CHO EXPANDER Tá»ªNG áº¤P) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

        # â•â•â• Láº¤Y DANH SÃCH áº¤P Tá»° Äá»˜NG â•â•â•
        # Nguá»“n 1: Tá»« baseline (Æ°u tiÃªn)
        ds_ap_from_baseline = set()
        if du_no_baseline:
            ds_ap_from_baseline = set(key.split("|")[0] for key in du_no_baseline.keys() if "|" in key)

        # Nguá»“n 2: Tá»« df_baseline (HSTD 31/12)
        ds_ap_from_baseline_df = set()
        if co_baseline and df_baseline is not None and not df_baseline.empty:

"""Nháº­p dá»¯ liá»‡u cho tab Káº¿ hoáº¡ch TÃ­n dá»¥ng (Chi nhÃ¡nh + theo XÃ£/PGD)."""
from __future__ import annotations

# ThÆ° má»¥c lÆ°u vÄƒn báº£n QÄ cáº¥p Chi nhÃ¡nh
QD_DIR_CN = DATA_DIR / "qd"


def _format_kich_thuoc(byte_count: int) -> str:
    """Äá»‹nh dáº¡ng dung lÆ°á»£ng file thÃ nh chuá»—i dá»… Ä‘á»c."""
    if byte_count >= 1_048_576:
        return f"{byte_count / 1_048_576:.1f} MB"
    return f"{byte_count / 1024:.1f} KB"


def _doc_meta_qd(kv_key: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Äá»c danh sÃ¡ch metadata file QÄ tá»« kv_store."""
    try:
        with db.get_conn() as conn:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT value FROM kv_store WHERE key=?", (kv_key,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row:
                val = json.loads(row["value"])
                return val if isinstance(val, list) else []
    except Exception:
        pass
    return []


def _luu_meta_qd(kv_key: str, danh_sach: list[dict], username: str) -> None:
    """Ghi danh sÃ¡ch metadata file QÄ vÃ o kv_store."""
    try:
        with db.get_conn() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO kv_store (key, value, updated_at, updated_by) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                (kv_key, json.dumps(danh_sach, ensure_ascii=False),
                 datetime.now().isoformat(), username),
            )
            conn.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        st.error(f"Lá»—i lÆ°u metadata file QÄ: {e}")


def _luu_file_qd(uploaded, thu_muc: Path, kv_key: str, username: str) -> Path:
    """LÆ°u file má»›i vá»›i timestamp prefix, cáº­p nháº­t metadata trong kv_store."""
    ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    ten_goc = uploaded.name
    ten_luu = f"{ts}_{ten_goc}"
    thu_muc.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    duong_dan = thu_muc / ten_luu
    noi_dung = uploaded.getvalue()
    duong_dan.write_bytes(noi_dung)

    danh_sach = _doc_meta_qd(kv_key)
    danh_sach.append({
        "ten_file":    ten_goc,
        "duong_dan":   str(duong_dan),
        "ngay_upload": datetime.now().strftime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M"),
        "nguoi_upload": username,
        "kich_thuoc":  len(noi_dung),
    })
    _luu_meta_qd(kv_key, danh_sach, username)
    return duong_dan


def _hien_thi_lich_su_qd(kv_key: str, nhan: str, role: str, username: str) -> None:
    """Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ báº£ng lá»‹ch sá»­ file QÄ, nÃºt táº£i xuá»‘ng vÃ  (admin) nÃºt xÃ³a."""
    danh_sach = _doc_meta_qd(kv_key)
    st.markdown(f"**{nhan}**")
    if not danh_sach:
        st.info("ðŸ“­ ChÆ°a cÃ³ file nÃ o Ä‘Æ°á»£c upload.")
        return

    # Header báº£ng
    h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 = st.columns([3, 2, 2, 1.5, 1, 1])
    h1.markdown("**TÃªn file**")
    h2.markdown("**NgÃ y upload**")
    h3.markdown("**NgÆ°á»i upload**")
    h4.markdown("**Dung lÆ°á»£ng**")

    for idx_rev, meta in enumerate(reversed(danh_sach)):
        idx_thuc = len(danh_sach) - 1 - idx_rev
        c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6 = st.columns([3, 2, 2, 1.5, 1, 1])
        c1.text(meta.get("ten_file", "â€”"))
        c2.text(meta.get("ngay_upload", "â€”"))
        c3.text(meta.get("nguoi_upload", "â€”"))
        c4.text(_format_kich_thuoc(meta.get("kich_thuoc", 0)))

        duong_dan = Path(meta.get("duong_dan", ""))
        if duong_dan.exists():
            c5.download_button(
                "â¬‡",
                data=duong_dan.read_bytes(),
                file_name=meta.get("ten_file", duong_dan.name),
                key=f"dl_{kv_key}_{idx_rev}",
                help="Táº£i xuá»‘ng",
            )
        else:
            c5.markdown("âš ï¸")

        if get_permissions(role)["can_edit_khtd"]:
            if c6.button("ðŸ—‘", key=f"del_{kv_key}_{idx_rev}", help="XÃ³a file"):
                if duong_dan.exists():
                    duong_dan.unlink()
                danh_sach.pop(idx_thuc)
                _luu_meta_qd(kv_key, danh_sach, username)
                db.ghi_audit(
                    username, "xoa_van_ban_qd",
                    f"File: {meta.get('ten_file')} Â· key: {kv_key}",
                )
                st.rerun()


def _section_van_ban_qd_cn(role: str, username: str) -> None:

    with st.expander("ðŸ“Ž VÄƒn báº£n QÄ", expanded=True):
        # â”€â”€ Lá»‹ch sá»­ tá»«ng loáº¡i â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        col_hist1, col_hist2 = st.columns(2)
        with col_hist1:
            _hien_thi_lich_su_qd("qd_files_hdqt_tinh", "QÄ HÄQT tá»‰nh", role, username)

        if not get_permissions(role)["can_edit_khtd"]:

def _tao_df_mau_khtd_cn() -> pd.DataFrame:
    """DataFrame máº«u upload KHTD Chi nhÃ¡nh (má»™t dÃ²ng / ma_key trong CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD)."""
    rows: list[dict] = []
    for ma_key, _ma_ct, ten, nv, _ in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD:
        rows.append({
            "ChÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh": ten,
            "MÃ£ CT": ma_key,
            "Nguá»“n vá»‘n": nv,
            "KH (triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng)": 0.0,
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def _doc_excel_khtd_cn_upload(file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]] | None:
    """
    Äá»c Excel upload â†’ dict ma_key â†’ sá»‘ Ä‘á»“ng.
    Tráº£ vá» None náº¿u thiáº¿u cá»™t báº¯t buá»™c hoáº·c khÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c file.
    """
    try:
        df_up = pd.read_excel(BytesIO(file_bytes), header=0)
    except Exception as e:
        st.error(f"KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c file Excel: {e}")
        return None

    ten_cot = {str(c).strip(): c for c in df_up.columns}
    if "MÃ£ CT" not in ten_cot:
        st.error(
            "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y cá»™t **MÃ£ CT** trong file. Vui lÃ²ng dÃ¹ng Ä‘Ãºng file máº«u "
            "(nÃºt **â¬‡ï¸ Táº£i file máº«u Excel** phÃ­a trÃªn) vÃ  giá»¯ nguyÃªn tÃªn cÃ¡c cá»™t."
        )
        return None

    col_kh = ten_cot.get("KH (triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng)")
    if col_kh is None:
        for t, c in ten_cot.items():
            tl = t.lower()
            if "kh" in tl and ("triá»‡u" in t or "trieu" in tl):
                col_kh = c
                break
    if col_kh is None:
        st.error(
            "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y cá»™t **KH (triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng)**. Vui lÃ²ng dÃ¹ng file máº«u vÃ  khÃ´ng Ä‘á»•i tÃªn cá»™t KH."
        )
        return None

    col_ma = ten_cot["MÃ£ CT"]
    out: dict[str, float] = {}
    bo_qua: list[str] = []
    for _, row in df_up.iterrows():
        ma_key = str(row[col_ma]).strip()
        if not ma_key or ma_key.lower() == "nan":
            continue
        if ma_key not in MA_KEYS_CO_KHTD:
            bo_qua.append(ma_key)
            continue
        v = row[col_kh]
        if pd.isna(v):
            continue
        try:
            kh_trieu = float(v)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        if kh_trieu == 0:
            continue
        out[ma_key] = kh_trieu * 1_000_000

    if bo_qua:
        st.warning(
            f"Bá» qua **{len(bo_qua)}** dÃ²ng cÃ³ MÃ£ CT khÃ´ng thuá»™c danh má»¥c KHTD: "
            f"{', '.join(sorted(set(bo_qua))[:12])}"
            + ("â€¦" if len(set(bo_qua)) > 12 else "")
        )
    return out, len(out), bo_qua

    def _fvn_form(x: float, d: int = 1) -> str:
        return f"{float(x):,.{d}f}".replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")

    def _md_right(val: str, color: str = "#212121") -> str:
        return (
            f"<div style='text-align:right;color:{color};font-size:0.88rem;"
            f"padding:2px 0'>{val}</div>"
        )

    st.markdown(
        """
<style>
[data-testid="stHorizontalBlock"] {
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0 !important;
    padding: 2px 0 !important;
}
[data-testid="stHorizontalBlock"]:hover {
    background-color: #f8fafc !important;
}
</style>
""",
        unsafe_allow_html=True,
    )
    nhom_mau_nen = ["#eef6ff", "#eefaf3", "#fff8ee"]
    idx_nhom = 0
    for tieu_de_nhom, ds_ma_ct in KHTD_CN_NHOM_MA_CT:
        bg = nhom_mau_nen[idx_nhom % len(nhom_mau_nen)]
        idx_nhom += 1
        st.markdown(
            f"<p style='margin:0.8rem 0 0.4rem 0;padding:7px 12px;"
            f"background-color:{bg};border-radius:6px;font-weight:600;"
            f"font-size:0.9rem'>{tieu_de_nhom}</p>",
            unsafe_allow_html=True,
        )
        for ma_ct in ds_ma_ct:
            # â”€â”€ Xá»­ lÃ½ Ä‘áº·c biá»‡t: GQVL (ma_ct=3) phÃ¢n táº§ng 4 nhÃ³m â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if ma_ct == 3:
                # Header GQVL (chá»‰ hiá»ƒn thá»‹, khÃ´ng cÃ³ input)
                cols_hdr = st.columns(_colw)
                cols_hdr[0].markdown(
                    "<div style='font-size:0.88rem;font-weight:600;"
                    "padding:4px 0'>Cho vay giáº£i quyáº¿t viá»‡c lÃ m</div>",
                    unsafe_allow_html=True
                )
                # Tá»•ng TW vÃ  ÄP Ä‘á»ƒ hiá»ƒn thá»‹ á»Ÿ header
                th_3_tw = (th_gqvl.get("3_TW_NHCSXH", 0.0) + th_gqvl.get("3_TW_NSNN", 0.0)) / 1e6
                th_3_dp = (th_gqvl.get("3_DP_TINH", 0.0) + th_gqvl.get("3_DP_XA", 0.0)) / 1e6
                cols_hdr[2].markdown(_md_right(_fvn_form(th_3_tw, 0)), unsafe_allow_html=True)
                cols_hdr[5].markdown(_md_right(_fvn_form(th_3_dp, 0)), unsafe_allow_html=True)
                cols_hdr[7].markdown(_md_right(_fvn_form(th_3_tw + th_3_dp, 0)), unsafe_allow_html=True)

                # 4 sub-dÃ²ng thá»¥t vÃ o
                for sub_key, sub_ten, sub_nv in GQVL_SUB_NHOM:
                    k_inp = f"khtd_cn_inp_{sub_key}"
                    kh_vnd = float(kh_cn.get(sub_key, 0.0))
                    kh_trieu = kh_vnd / 1_000_000
                    th_trieu = th_gqvl.get(sub_key, 0.0) / 1e6

                    cols_sub = st.columns(_colw)
                    # TÃªn sub: thá»¥t vÃ o, mÃ u nháº¡t hÆ¡n
                    cols_sub[0].markdown(
                        f"<div style='font-size:0.83rem;color:#555;"
                        f"padding:3px 0 3px 16px'>{sub_ten}</div>",
                        unsafe_allow_html=True
                    )
                    # Cá»™t KH: TW á»Ÿ cols[1], ÄP á»Ÿ cols[4]
                    col_kh_idx = 1 if sub_nv == "TW" else 4
                    col_th_idx = 2 if sub_nv == "TW" else 5
                    col_cp_idx = 3 if sub_nv == "TW" else 6

                    cols_sub[col_kh_idx].number_input(
                        sub_ten,
                        value=kh_trieu,
                        min_value=0.0,
                        step=1000.0,
                        format="%.0f",
                        label_visibility="collapsed",
                        key=k_inp,
                    )
                    kh_inp = float(st.session_state.get(k_inp, kh_trieu))

                    cols_sub[col_th_idx].markdown(
                        _md_right(_fvn_form(th_trieu, 0)), unsafe_allow_html=True
                    )
                    # CÃ²n pháº£i TH
                    cpth = kh_inp - th_trieu
                    if kh_inp == 0:
                        cols_sub[col_cp_idx].markdown(
                            _md_right("â€”", "#9e9e9e"), unsafe_allow_html=True
                        )
                    elif cpth < 0:
                        cols_sub[col_cp_idx].markdown(
                            _md_right(_fvn_form(cpth), "#c62828"), unsafe_allow_html=True
                        )
                    elif cpth == 0:
                        cols_sub[col_cp_idx].markdown(
                            _md_right("0 âœ“", "#2e7d32"), unsafe_allow_html=True
                        )
                    else:
                        cols_sub[col_cp_idx].markdown(
                            _md_right(_fvn_form(cpth)), unsafe_allow_html=True
                        )
                    # CÃ¡c cá»™t tá»•ng Ä‘á»ƒ trá»‘ng cho sub-dÃ²ng
                continue  # Bá» qua xá»­ lÃ½ máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh cho ma_ct == 3

            # â”€â”€ Xá»­ lÃ½ máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh cho cÃ¡c CT khÃ¡c â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            mk_tw = f"{ma_ct}_TW"

            co_dp = mk_dp in MA_KEYS_CO_KHTD

            cols = st.columns(_colw)

                    key=k_tw,
                )
                kh_tw_trieu = float(
                    st.session_state[k_tw]
                    if k_tw in st.session_state
                    else ht_tw
                )
            else:
                cols[1].caption("â€”")
                kh_tw_trieu = 0.0

            cols[2].markdown(
                _md_right(_fvn_form(th_tw_trieu, 0)), unsafe_allow_html=True
            )
            if kh_tw_trieu == 0:
                cols[3].markdown(
                    _md_right("â€”", "#9e9e9e"), unsafe_allow_html=True
                )
            else:
                cpth_tw = kh_tw_trieu - th_tw_trieu
                if cpth_tw < 0:

                    )
                elif cpth_tw == 0:
                    cols[3].markdown(
                        _md_right("0,0 âœ“", "#2e7d32"), unsafe_allow_html=True
                    )
                else:
                    cols[3].markdown(
                        _md_right(_fvn_form(cpth_tw)), unsafe_allow_html=True
                    )

            if co_dp:

                    min_value=0.0,
                    step=1000.0,
                    format="%.0f",
                    label_visibility="collapsed",
                    help="Káº¿ hoáº¡ch Äá»‹a phÆ°Æ¡ng â€” Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹: triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng",
                    key=k_dp,
                )
                kh_dp_trieu = float(
                    st.session_state[k_dp]
                    if k_dp in st.session_state
                    else ht_dp
                )
            else:
                cols[4].caption("â€”")
                kh_dp_trieu = 0.0

            cols[5].markdown(
                _md_right(_fvn_form(th_dp_trieu, 0)), unsafe_allow_html=True
            )
            if kh_dp_trieu == 0:
                cols[6].markdown(
                    _md_right("â€”", "#9e9e9e"), unsafe_allow_html=True
                )
            else:
                cpth_dp = kh_dp_trieu - th_dp_trieu
                if cpth_dp < 0:
                    cols[6].markdown(
                        _md_right(_fvn_form(cpth_dp), "#c62828"),
                        unsafe_allow_html=True,
                    )
                elif cpth_dp == 0:
                    cols[6].markdown(
                        _md_right("0,0 âœ“", "#2e7d32"), unsafe_allow_html=True
                    )
                else:
                    cols[6].markdown(
                        _md_right(_fvn_form(cpth_dp)), unsafe_allow_html=True
                    )

            th_tong = th_tw_trieu + th_dp_trieu
            cols[7].markdown(
                _md_right(_fvn_form(th_tong, 0)), unsafe_allow_html=True
            )
            kh_tong = kh_tw_trieu + kh_dp_trieu
            cpth_tong = kh_tong - th_tong
            if kh_tong == 0:
                cols[8].markdown(

                )
            elif cpth_tong < 0:
                cols[8].markdown(
                    _md_right(_fvn_form(cpth_tong), "#c62828"),
                    unsafe_allow_html=True,
                )
            elif cpth_tong == 0:
                cols[8].markdown(
                    _md_right("0,0 âœ“", "#2e7d32"), unsafe_allow_html=True
                )
            else:
                cols[8].markdown(
                    _md_right(_fvn_form(cpth_tong)), unsafe_allow_html=True
                )

    tong_kh_trieu_hien_tai = 0.0
    for _tieu_de, ds_ma_ct in KHTD_CN_NHOM_MA_CT:
        for ma_ct in ds_ma_ct:
            # Bá» qua CT 3 (GQVL) - Ä‘Ã£ tÃ­nh qua sub-key bÃªn dÆ°á»›i
            if ma_ct == 3:
                continue
            mk_tw = f"{ma_ct}_TW"
            mk_dp = f"{ma_ct}_DP"
            if mk_tw in MA_KEYS_CO_KHTD:
                k_tw = f"khtd_cn_inp_{ma_ct}_tw"
                tong_kh_trieu_hien_tai += float(
                    st.session_state[k_tw]
                    if k_tw in st.session_state
                    else float(kh_cn.get(mk_tw, 0.0)) / 1_000_000
                )
            if mk_dp in MA_KEYS_CO_KHTD:
                k_dp = f"khtd_cn_inp_{ma_ct}_dp"
                tong_kh_trieu_hien_tai += float(
                    st.session_state[k_dp]
                    if k_dp in st.session_state
                    else float(kh_cn.get(mk_dp, 0.0)) / 1_000_000
                )
    # ThÃªm 4 sub-key GQVL vÃ o tá»•ng (thay vÃ¬ Ä‘áº¿m 3_TW/3_DP)
    for sub_key, _, _ in GQVL_SUB_NHOM:
        k_inp = f"khtd_cn_inp_{sub_key}"
        tong_kh_trieu_hien_tai += float(
            st.session_state.get(k_inp,
                float(kh_cn.get(sub_key, 0.0)) / 1_000_000)
        )
    tong_kh_nhap_form = tong_kh_trieu_hien_tai * 1_000_000

    if tong_kh_nhap_form <= 0:
        st.warning(
            "âš ï¸ Táº¥t cáº£ chá»‰ tiÃªu Ä‘ang = 0, kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i trÆ°á»›c khi lÆ°u"
        )

    if st.button("ðŸ’¾ LÆ°u káº¿ hoáº¡ch Chi nhÃ¡nh", type="primary", key="btn_luu_khtd_cn"):
        patch: dict[str, float] = {}
        for tieu_de_nhom, ds_ma_ct in KHTD_CN_NHOM_MA_CT:
            for ma_ct in ds_ma_ct:
                # Bá» qua CT 3 khi lÆ°u máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh - sáº½ lÆ°u qua sub-key
                if ma_ct == 3:
                    continue
                mk_tw = f"{ma_ct}_TW"
                mk_dp = f"{ma_ct}_DP"
                if mk_tw in MA_KEYS_CO_KHTD:
                    patch[mk_tw] = float(
                        st.session_state.get(f"khtd_cn_inp_{ma_ct}_tw", 0.0)
                    )
                if mk_dp in MA_KEYS_CO_KHTD:
                    patch[mk_dp] = float(
                        st.session_state.get(f"khtd_cn_inp_{ma_ct}_dp", 0.0)
                    )
        # LÆ°u 4 sub-key GQVL
        for sub_key, _, _ in GQVL_SUB_NHOM:
            k_inp = f"khtd_cn_inp_{sub_key}"
            patch[sub_key] = float(st.session_state.get(k_inp, 0.0))
        # Backward compat: ghi tá»•ng vÃ o key cÅ©
        patch["3_TW"] = patch.get("3_TW_NHCSXH", 0.0) + patch.get("3_TW_NSNN", 0.0)
        patch["3_DP"] = patch.get("3_DP_TINH", 0.0) + patch.get("3_DP_XA", 0.0)
        tong_kh_luu = sum(v * 1_000_000 for v in patch.values())
        if tong_kh_luu <= 0:
            st.warning(
                "âš ï¸ Táº¥t cáº£ chá»‰ tiÃªu Ä‘ang = 0, kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i trÆ°á»›c khi lÆ°u"
            )
        else:
            for ma_key, gia_tri_trieu in patch.items():
                kh_cn[ma_key] = gia_tri_trieu * 1_000_000
            if _luu_kv(KV_KEY_CN, kh_cn, username):
                tw_kh_d = sum(
                    float(kh_cn.get(mk, 0.0))
                    for mk, _mc, _t, nv, _tm in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD
                    if nv == "TW"
                )
                dp_kh_d = sum(
                    float(kh_cn.get(mk, 0.0))
                    for mk, _mc, _t, nv, _tm in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD
                    if nv == "DP"
                )
                tw_th_d = sum(
                    float((th_cn or {}).get(mk, 0.0))
                    for mk, _mc, _t, nv, _tm in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD
                    if nv == "TW"
                )
                dp_th_d = sum(
                    float((th_cn or {}).get(mk, 0.0))
                    for mk, _mc, _t, nv, _tm in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD
                    if nv == "DP"
                )
                pt_tw = (
                    round(tw_th_d / tw_kh_d * 100, 1) if tw_kh_d > 0 else None
                )
                pt_dp = (
                    round(dp_th_d / dp_kh_d * 100, 1) if dp_kh_d > 0 else None
                )
                all_kh_d = tw_kh_d + dp_kh_d
                all_th_d = tw_th_d + dp_th_d
                pt_all = (
                    round(all_th_d / all_kh_d * 100, 1) if all_kh_d > 0 else None
                )
                db.ghi_audit(
                    username,
                    "luu_khtd_cn",
                    f"{len(patch)} chá»‰ tiÃªu, tá»•ng {vn(sum(patch.values()), 1)} triá»‡u",
                )
                st.cache_data.clear()
                st.session_state["khtd_cn_save_info"] = (
                    tw_kh_d,
                    tw_th_d,
                    pt_tw,
                    dp_kh_d,
                    dp_th_d,
                    pt_dp,
                    all_kh_d,
                    all_th_d,
                    pt_all,
                )
                st.rerun()

    _info_luu = st.session_state.pop("khtd_cn_save_info", None)
    if isinstance(_info_luu, tuple) and len(_info_luu) == 9:
        (
            tw_kh_d,
            tw_th_d,
            pt_tw,
            dp_kh_d,
            dp_th_d,
            pt_dp,

        st.info(

            f"KH Trung Æ°Æ¡ng: **{_fvn(tw_kh_d / 1e6, 1)}** triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng Â· "

            f"Äáº¡t **{_pt(pt_tw)}**\n\n"
            f"KH Äá»‹a phÆ°Æ¡ng: **{_fvn(dp_kh_d / 1e6, 1)}** triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng Â· "
            f"Thá»±c hiá»‡n: **{_fvn(dp_th_d / 1e6, 0)}** triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng Â· "
            f"Äáº¡t **{_pt(pt_dp)}**\n\n"
            f"Tá»•ng cá»™ng: KH **{_fvn(all_kh_d / 1e6, 1)}** triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng Â· "
            f"Thá»±c hiá»‡n: **{_fvn(all_th_d / 1e6, 0)}** triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng Â· "
            f"Äáº¡t **{_pt(pt_all)}**"
        )

    # â”€â”€ TÃ³m táº¯t hiá»‡n tráº¡ng (luÃ´n hiá»ƒn thá»‹) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    st.markdown("##### ðŸ“Š TÃ³m táº¯t hiá»‡n tráº¡ng")
    _hien_thi_bang_cn_readonly(
        kh_cn,
        th_cn,
        ds_ct_loc=[mk for mk, _ in ds_ct],
        df_loc=df_loc,
        username=username,
    )

    st.divider()
    _section_van_ban_qd_cn(role, username)

    # â”€â”€ Lá»‹ch sá»­ phiÃªn báº£n (chá»‰ admin / admin_cn) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    if role in ("admin", "admin_cn"):
        with st.expander("ðŸ• Lá»‹ch sá»­ chá»‰nh sá»­a KHTD Chi nhÃ¡nh", expanded=False):
            history = db.doc_kv_history(KV_KEY_CN, limit=15)
            if not history:
                st.info("ChÆ°a cÃ³ lá»‹ch sá»­ chá»‰nh sá»­a.")
            else:
                df_hist = pd.DataFrame(history)
                df_hist_display = df_hist.rename(columns={
                    "changed_at": "Thá»i Ä‘iá»ƒm",
                    "changed_by": "NgÆ°á»i sá»­a",
                    "note": "Ghi chÃº",
                })
                st.dataframe(
                    df_hist_display[["Thá»i Ä‘iá»ƒm", "NgÆ°á»i sá»­a", "Ghi chÃº"]],
                    use_container_width=True,

                )

                options = ["-- Chá»n --"] + [
                    f"#{row['id']} â€” {row['changed_at']} ({row['changed_by']})"
                    for row in history
                ]
                lua_chon = st.selectbox(

                    options=options,
                    key="khtd_cn_history_select",

                if lua_chon != "-- Chá»n --":
                    try:
                        hist_id = int(lua_chon.split(" â€” ")[0].lstrip("#"))
                        row_match = next((r for r in history if r["id"] == hist_id), None)
                        if row_match:
                            value_preview = json.loads(row_match["value"])
                            st.json(value_preview)
                            if st.button(

                                ok = db.khoi_phuc_kv(

                                if ok:

                                    st.cache_data.clear()
                                else:
                                    st.error("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y phiÃªn báº£n.")
                    except (ValueError, StopIteration):
                        st.error("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y phiÃªn báº£n.")

    if not danh_sach_xa:
        st.warning(f"ChÆ°a cÃ³ danh sÃ¡ch xÃ£ cho **{pgd_chon}**.")

    # â”€â”€ ThÆ° má»¥c lÆ°u PDF â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

        st.session_state["khtd_pdf_folder"] = pdf_folder
    
    with col_btn:
        st.markdown("<br>", unsafe_allow_html=True)
        xuat_pdf_clicked = st.button("ðŸ–¨ï¸ Xuáº¥t PDF", use_container_width=True)

    # â”€â”€ Upload Excel hÃ ng loáº¡t â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    with st.expander("ðŸ“¤ Upload Excel káº¿ hoáº¡ch hÃ ng loáº¡t", expanded=False):
        st.caption(
            "Cáº¥u trÃºc file: **Cá»™t A** = TÃªn xÃ£ Â· **Cá»™t B** = MÃ£ CT (vd: `1_TW`) Â· "
            "**Cá»™t C** = GiÃ¡ trá»‹ (triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng)"

    )
    hr1[4].markdown(_khtd_cn_hdr_cell("", "#c8e6c9"), unsafe_allow_html=True)

    # â”€â”€ Header dÃ²ng 2 â”€â”€
    hr2 = st.columns(_colw_xa)

        _khtd_cn_hdr_cell("ChÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh", "#f0f4fa", "#37474f", bold=True),
        unsafe_allow_html=True,
    )

"""Tab Káº¿ hoáº¡ch TÃ­n dá»¥ng cáº¥p PGD â€” Há»— trá»£ Ä‘á»‹a bÃ n.

Äá»c dá»¯ liá»‡u tá»« khtd_xa ({ten_xa|ma_ct: gia_tri_dong}), hiá»ƒn thá»‹ báº£ng
tá»•ng há»£p hÃ ng=xÃ£, cá»™t=chÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh cho PGD Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»n, cÃ³ dÃ²ng tá»•ng vÃ  xuáº¥t Excel.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import json
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill

import db
from auth import la_phan_he_cn

from config import (

)

# â”€â”€ Háº±ng sá»‘ â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
KV_KEY_XA   = "khtd_xa"
DS_MA_CT    = [row[0] for row in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD]

MA_CT_BY_MAKEY = {mk: int(ma_ct) for mk, ma_ct, _, _, _ in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD}

for mk, ma_ct, ten, _nv, _ in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD:
    TEN_BASE_BY_MACT.setdefault(int(ma_ct), str(ten))

# ThÆ° má»¥c lÆ°u vÄƒn báº£n QÄ cáº¥p PGD
DATA_DIR     = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "data"
PGD_DATA_DIR = DATA_DIR / "pgd_data"


# â”€â”€ Trá»£ lÃ½ vÄƒn báº£n QÄ â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def _pgd_slug(ten_pgd: str) -> str:
    """Chuyá»ƒn tÃªn PGD thÃ nh chuá»—i an toÃ n dÃ¹ng trong tÃªn file/thÆ° má»¥c."""
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", ten_pgd)
    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", slug).strip("_").lower()


def _format_kich_thuoc(byte_count: int) -> str:
    """Äá»‹nh dáº¡ng dung lÆ°á»£ng file thÃ nh chuá»—i dá»… Ä‘á»c."""
    if byte_count >= 1_048_576:
        return f"{byte_count / 1_048_576:.1f} MB"
    return f"{byte_count / 1024:.1f} KB"


def _doc_meta_qd(kv_key: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Äá»c danh sÃ¡ch metadata file QÄ tá»« kv_store."""
    try:
        with db.get_conn() as conn:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT value FROM kv_store WHERE key=?", (kv_key,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row:
                val = json.loads(row["value"])
                return val if isinstance(val, list) else []
    except Exception:
        pass
    return []


def _luu_meta_qd(kv_key: str, danh_sach: list[dict], username: str) -> None:
    """Ghi danh sÃ¡ch metadata file QÄ vÃ o kv_store."""
    try:
        with db.get_conn() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO kv_store (key, value, updated_at, updated_by) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                (kv_key, json.dumps(danh_sach, ensure_ascii=False),
                 datetime.now().isoformat(), username),
            )
            conn.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        st.error(f"Lá»—i lÆ°u metadata file QÄ: {e}")


def _luu_file_qd(uploaded, thu_muc: Path, kv_key: str, username: str) -> Path:
    """LÆ°u file má»›i vá»›i timestamp prefix, cáº­p nháº­t metadata trong kv_store."""
    ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    ten_goc = uploaded.name
    ten_luu = f"{ts}_{ten_goc}"
    thu_muc.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    duong_dan = thu_muc / ten_luu
    noi_dung = uploaded.getvalue()
    duong_dan.write_bytes(noi_dung)

    danh_sach = _doc_meta_qd(kv_key)
    danh_sach.append({
        "ten_file":     ten_goc,
        "duong_dan":    str(duong_dan),
        "ngay_upload":  datetime.now().strftime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M"),
        "nguoi_upload": username,
        "kich_thuoc":   len(noi_dung),
    })
    _luu_meta_qd(kv_key, danh_sach, username)
    return duong_dan

    """Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ báº£ng lá»‹ch sá»­ file QÄ, nÃºt táº£i xuá»‘ng vÃ  (admin) nÃºt xÃ³a."""

                db.ghi_audit(

                )

                                     f"PGD: {pgd} Â· File: {dp.name}")
                        st.success(f"âœ… ÄÃ£ lÆ°u: `{dp.name}`")
                        st.rerun()
                    except Exception as e:
                        st.session_state.pop(_id, None)
                        st.error(f"Lá»—i lÆ°u file QÄ HÄQT xÃ£: {e}")


# â”€â”€ Äá»c kv_store â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def _tao_column_config_khtd_pgd(cot_so: list[str]) -> dict[str, st.column_config.Column]:
    """
    Táº¡o column_config cho báº£ng KHTD PGD.
    
    Args:
        cot_so: Danh sÃ¡ch tÃªn cá»™t sá»‘ cáº§n format
    
    Returns:
        Dict cáº¥u hÃ¬nh column cho st.dataframe
    """
    config: dict[str, st.column_config.Column] = {
        "STT": st.column_config.TextColumn("STT", width="small"),
        "Chá»‰ TiÃªu": st.column_config.TextColumn("Chá»‰ TiÃªu", width="large"),
        "Cá»™ng": st.column_config.NumberColumn(
            "Cá»™ng",
            format="%.1f triá»‡u",
            help="ÄÆ¡n vá»‹: triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng"
        ),
    }
    for col in cot_so:
        if col not in ("STT", "Chá»‰ TiÃªu", "Cá»™ng"):
            config[col] = st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                col,
                format="%.1f triá»‡u",
                help="ÄÆ¡n vá»‹: triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng"
            )
    return config


def _tao_column_config_ss() -> dict[str, st.column_config.Column]:
    """Táº¡o column_config cho báº£ng so sÃ¡nh KH vs TH."""
    trieu_cols = [
        "KH TW (triá»‡u)", "KH ÄP (triá»‡u)", "TH TW (triá»‡u)", "TH ÄP (triá»‡u)",
        "KH Tá»•ng (triá»‡u)", "TH Tá»•ng (triá»‡u)", "CÃ²n láº¡i (triá»‡u)"
    ]
    config: dict[str, st.column_config.Column] = {
        "ChÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh": st.column_config.TextColumn("ChÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh", width="large"),
    }
    for col in trieu_cols:
        config[col] = st.column_config.NumberColumn(
            col,
            format="%.1f",
            help="ÄÆ¡n vá»‹: triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng"
        )
    config["Tá»· lá»‡ TH %"] = st.column_config.NumberColumn(
        "Tá»· lá»‡ TH %",
        format="%.1f%%",
        help="Tá»· lá»‡ thá»±c hiá»‡n %"
    )
    return config


def _doc_khtd_xa() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Äá»c toÃ n bá»™ káº¿ hoáº¡ch xÃ£ tá»« kv_store (key=khtd_xa).
    
    Returns:
        Dict chá»©a dá»¯ liá»‡u káº¿ hoáº¡ch xÃ£
    """
    try:
        with db.get_conn() as conn:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT value FROM kv_store WHERE key=?", (KV_KEY_XA,)
            ).fetchone()
            return json.loads(row["value"]) if row else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _fmt_vn(x, d: int = 1) -> str:
    try:
        if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and pd.isna(x)):
            return "â€”"
        v = float(x)
        s = f"{v:,.{d}f}"
        return s.replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")
    except Exception:
        return "â€”"


def _fmt_vn_signed(x, d: int = 1) -> str:
    try:
        v = float(x)
        s = _fmt_vn(v, d)
        return f"+{s}" if v > 0 else s
    except Exception:
        return "â€”"

def _nv_int_tu_ma_key(ma_key: str) -> int | None:
    if ma_key.endswith("_TW"):
        return 1
    if ma_key.endswith("_DP"):
        return 2
    if "|" in ma_key:
        try:
            return int(ma_key.split("|", 1)[1])
        except Exception:
            return None
    nv = NGUON_VON_MA.get(ma_key)
    if nv == "TW":
        return 1
    if nv == "DP":
        return 2
    return None


def _ma_ct_tu_ma_key(ma_key: str) -> int | None:
    if "|" in ma_key:
        try:
            return int(ma_key.split("|", 1)[0])
        except Exception:
            return None
    if ma_key.endswith("_TW") or ma_key.endswith("_DP"):
        try:
            return int(ma_key.rsplit("_", 1)[0])
        except Exception:
            return None
    return MA_CT_BY_MAKEY.get(ma_key)


def _bang_so_sanh_kh_th_pivot(
    kh_theo_ct: dict[str, float],
    th_theo_ct: dict[str, float],
    ten_ct_map: dict[str, str],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    keys = set(kh_theo_ct.keys()) | set(th_theo_ct.keys())
    ma_cts = sorted({m for m in (_ma_ct_tu_ma_key(k) for k in keys) if m is not None})
    rows: list[dict] = []
    for ma_ct in ma_cts:
        mk_tw = f"{ma_ct}|1"
        mk_dp = f"{ma_ct}|2"
        mk_tw2 = f"{ma_ct}_TW"
        mk_dp2 = f"{ma_ct}_DP"
        kh_tw = float(kh_theo_ct.get(mk_tw, kh_theo_ct.get(mk_tw2, 0.0))) / 1_000_000
        kh_dp = float(kh_theo_ct.get(mk_dp, kh_theo_ct.get(mk_dp2, 0.0))) / 1_000_000
        th_tw = float(th_theo_ct.get(mk_tw, th_theo_ct.get(mk_tw2, 0.0))) / 1_000_000
        th_dp = float(th_theo_ct.get(mk_dp, th_theo_ct.get(mk_dp2, 0.0))) / 1_000_000
        kh_tong = kh_tw + kh_dp
        th_tong = th_tw + th_dp
        if kh_tong == 0 and th_tong == 0:
            continue
        ten = TEN_BASE_BY_MACT.get(ma_ct)
        if not ten:
            ten = ten_ct_map.get(mk_tw2) or ten_ct_map.get(mk_dp2) or ten_ct_map.get(mk_tw) or ten_ct_map.get(mk_dp) or str(ma_ct)
        rows.append({
            "ChÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh": ten,
            "KH TW (triá»‡u)": round(kh_tw, 1),
            "KH ÄP (triá»‡u)": round(kh_dp, 1),
            "TH TW (triá»‡u)": round(th_tw, 1),
            "TH ÄP (triá»‡u)": round(th_dp, 1),
            "KH Tá»•ng (triá»‡u)": round(kh_tong, 1),
            "TH Tá»•ng (triá»‡u)": round(th_tong, 1),
            "CÃ²n láº¡i (triá»‡u)": round(kh_tong - th_tong, 1),
            "Tá»· lá»‡ TH %": round(th_tong / kh_tong * 100, 1) if kh_tong > 0 else None,
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def _ten_ct_map_tu_df(df: "pd.DataFrame | None") -> dict[str, str]:
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return {}
    if COT_MA_CHUONG_TRINH not in df.columns or COT_NGUON_VON not in df.columns:
        return {}
    if COT_TEN_CT not in df.columns:
        return {}

    lookup: dict[tuple[int, int], str] = {}
    for ma_key, ma_ct, _, nguon_von, _ in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD:
        nv_int = 1 if nguon_von == "TW" else 2
        if (int(ma_ct), nv_int) not in lookup:
            lookup[(int(ma_ct), nv_int)] = ma_key

    ma_ct_s = pd.to_numeric(df[COT_MA_CHUONG_TRINH], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
    nv_s = pd.to_numeric(df[COT_NGUON_VON], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
    ten_s = df[COT_TEN_CT].astype(str).fillna("").str.strip()

    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    for i in range(len(ma_ct_s)):
        ma_ct = int(ma_ct_s.iat[i])
        nv_int = int(nv_s.iat[i])
        if ma_ct <= 0 or nv_int not in (1, 2):
            continue
        mk = lookup.get((ma_ct, nv_int), f"{ma_ct}|{nv_int}")
        if mk in out:
            continue
        ten = str(ten_s.iat[i]).strip()
        out[mk] = TEN_CHINH_THUC_CT.get(mk, ten) or mk
    return out


def _tinh_thuc_hien_theo_ct(df: "pd.DataFrame") -> dict[str, float]:
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return {}
    if COT_MA_CHUONG_TRINH not in df.columns or COT_NGUON_VON not in df.columns:
        return {}
    col_th = COT_TONG_DU_NO if COT_TONG_DU_NO in df.columns else (
        COT_DU_NO_TH if COT_DU_NO_TH in df.columns else None
    )
    if not col_th:
        return {}

    lookup: dict[tuple[int, int], str] = {}
    for ma_key, ma_ct, _, nguon_von, _ in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD:
        nv_int = 1 if nguon_von == "TW" else 2
        if (int(ma_ct), nv_int) not in lookup:
            lookup[(int(ma_ct), nv_int)] = ma_key

    ma_ct_s = pd.to_numeric(df[COT_MA_CHUONG_TRINH], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
    nv_s = pd.to_numeric(df[COT_NGUON_VON], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
    th_s = pd.to_numeric(df[col_th], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(float)

    tmp = pd.DataFrame({"ma_ct": ma_ct_s, "nv": nv_s, "th": th_s})
    tmp = tmp[(tmp["ma_ct"] > 0) & (tmp["nv"].isin([1, 2])) & (tmp["th"] != 0)]
    if tmp.empty:
        return {}

    g = tmp.groupby(["ma_ct", "nv"])["th"].sum()
    out: dict[str, float] = {}
    for (ma_ct, nv_int), val in g.items():
        mk = lookup.get((int(ma_ct), int(nv_int)), f"{int(ma_ct)}|{int(nv_int)}")
        out[mk] = float(val)
    return out


def _tinh_ke_hoach_pgd_theo_ct(
    pgd: str,
    kh_xa: dict,
    ds_ct_loc: list[tuple[str, str]],
) -> dict[str, float]:
    ds_xa = PGD_XA_MAP.get(pgd, [])
    if not ds_xa:
        return {}
    out: dict[str, float] = {}
    for ma_key, _ in ds_ct_loc:
        tong = 0.0
        for xa in ds_xa:
            tong += float(kh_xa.get(f"{xa}|{ma_key}", 0.0))
        out[ma_key] = tong
    return out


def _bang_so_sanh_kh_th(
    ds_ct_loc: list[tuple[str, str]],
    kh_theo_ct: dict[str, float],
    th_theo_ct: dict[str, float],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    ten_ct_map = {mk: ten for mk, ten in ds_ct_loc}
    return _bang_so_sanh_kh_th_pivot(kh_theo_ct, th_theo_ct, ten_ct_map)


# â”€â”€ XÃ¢y dá»±ng DataFrame tá»•ng há»£p cho má»™t PGD â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def _xay_dung_bang_pgd(pgd: str, kh_xa: dict, ds_ct_loc: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Táº¡o DataFrame ma tráº­n (hÃ ng=chá»‰ tiÃªu, cá»™t=xÃ£) cho PGD."""
    danh_sach_xa = PGD_XA_MAP.get(pgd, [])
    if not danh_sach_xa:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    ds_loc_set = {mk for mk, _ in ds_ct_loc}
    hierarchy_rows: list[dict] = [
        {"stt": "A", "chi_tieu": "Káº¾ HOáº CH", "nhom": "A", "ma_key": None},
        {"stt": "I", "chi_tieu": "Nguá»“n vá»‘n Trung Æ°Æ¡ng", "nhom": "I", "ma_key": None},
    ]
    stt_tw = 1
    for mk, _ma_ct, ten, nv, *_ in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD:
        if nv != "TW" or mk not in ds_loc_set:
            continue
        hierarchy_rows.append({
            "stt": str(stt_tw),
            "chi_tieu": f"  {ten}",
            "nhom": "con",
            "ma_key": mk,
        })
        stt_tw += 1
    hierarchy_rows.append({"stt": "II", "chi_tieu": "Nguá»“n vá»‘n Äá»‹a phÆ°Æ¡ng", "nhom": "II", "ma_key": None})
    stt_dp = 1
    for mk, _ma_ct, ten, nv, *_ in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD:
        if nv != "DP" or mk not in ds_loc_set:
            continue
        hierarchy_rows.append({
            "stt": str(stt_dp),
            "chi_tieu": f"  {ten}",
            "nhom": "con",
            "ma_key": mk,
        })
        stt_dp += 1

    rows: list[dict] = []
    for row in hierarchy_rows:
        hang = {"STT": row["stt"], "Chá»‰ TiÃªu": row["chi_tieu"]}
        if row["ma_key"]:
            tong = 0.0
            for xa in danh_sach_xa:
                val = round(float(kh_xa.get(f"{xa}|{row['ma_key']}", 0.0)) / 1_000_000, 1)
                hang[xa] = val
                tong += val
            hang["Cá»™ng"] = round(tong, 1)
        else:
            for xa in danh_sach_xa:
                hang[xa] = None
            hang["Cá»™ng"] = None
        hang["_nhom"] = row["nhom"]
        rows.append(hang)

    # DÃ²ng tá»•ng PGD á»Ÿ cuá»‘i báº£ng
    tong_hang = {"STT": "", "Chá»‰ TiÃªu": "Tá»”NG PGD", "_nhom": "tong"}
    for xa in danh_sach_xa:
        tong_hang[xa] = round(
            sum(
                float(kh_xa.get(f"{xa}|{mk}", 0.0)) / 1_000_000
                for mk, _ma_ct, _ten, _nv, *_ in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD
                if mk in ds_loc_set
            ),
            1,
        )
    tong_hang["Cá»™ng"] = round(sum(v for k, v in tong_hang.items() if k in danh_sach_xa), 1)
    rows.append(tong_hang)

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# â”€â”€ Entry point â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def render(tab: DeltaGenerator, **kwargs: dict) -> None:
    """
    Render tab KHTD cáº¥p PGD.
    
    Args:
        tab: Streamlit DeltaGenerator cho tab nÃ y
        **kwargs: Chá»©a role, username, pgd_user, df_full, df
    """
    role = kwargs.get("role", "user")
    username = kwargs.get("username", "unknown")
    pgd_user = kwargs.get("pgd_user", "")
    df = kwargs.get("df_full", kwargs.get("df"))

    with tab:
        st.title("ðŸ¦ Káº¿ hoáº¡ch TÃ­n dá»¥ng â€” Cáº¥p PGD")
        st.caption("Há»— trá»£ Ä‘á»‹a bÃ n Â· Xem tá»•ng há»£p KH theo XÃ£ Ã— ChÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh")

        # â”€â”€ XÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh PGD hiá»ƒn thá»‹ â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        if role in ("admin", "manager", "admin_cn", "manager_cn"):
            pgd_hien_tai: str = st.selectbox(
                "Chá»n PGD", DS_PGD, key="khtd_pgd_sel_admin"
            )
        else:
            if not pgd_user:
                st.warning("âš ï¸ ChÆ°a gÃ¡n PGD cho tÃ i khoáº£n nÃ y. LiÃªn há»‡ Admin.")
                return
            pgd_hien_tai = pgd_user
            st.info(f"ðŸ“ PGD cá»§a báº¡n: **{pgd_hien_tai}**")

        # â”€â”€ VÄƒn báº£n QÄ theo PGD â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        _section_van_ban_qd_pgd(pgd_hien_tai, role, username)

        # â”€â”€ Lá»c nguá»“n vá»‘n â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        col_nv, _ = st.columns([2, 3])
        with col_nv:
            nv_chon = st.radio(
                "Nguá»“n vá»‘n",
                ["Táº¥t cáº£", "Trung Æ°Æ¡ng", "Äá»‹a phÆ°Æ¡ng"],
                horizontal=True,
                key="khtd_pgd_nv_filter",
            )
        st.divider()

        # â”€â”€ Äá»c dá»¯ liá»‡u & dá»±ng báº£ng â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        kh_xa = _doc_khtd_xa()

        df_th_pgd = df
        if df_th_pgd is not None and not df_th_pgd.empty:
            if COT_TEN_PGD in df_th_pgd.columns:
                df_th_pgd = df_th_pgd[df_th_pgd[COT_TEN_PGD] == pgd_hien_tai]
        th_theo_ct = _tinh_thuc_hien_theo_ct(df_th_pgd) if df_th_pgd is not None else {}
        th_theo_ct = {k: v for k, v in th_theo_ct.items() if float(v) > 0}
        ten_ct_map = _ten_ct_map_tu_df(df_th_pgd)

        ds_xa = set(PGD_XA_MAP.get(pgd_hien_tai, []))
        keys_kh_pgd: set[str] = set()
        for khoa in kh_xa.keys():
            try:
                xa, ma_key = khoa.split("|", 1)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if xa in ds_xa:
                keys_kh_pgd.add(ma_key)

        keys_show = set(keys_kh_pgd) | set(th_theo_ct.keys())
        base_all = [(mk, ten) for mk, _, ten, _, _ in CHUONG_TRINH_KHTD]
        if not keys_show:
            keys_show = {mk for mk, _ in base_all}

        if nv_chon == "Trung Æ°Æ¡ng":
            keys_show = {k for k in keys_show if _nv_int_tu_ma_key(k) == 1}
        elif nv_chon == "Äá»‹a phÆ°Æ¡ng":
            keys_show = {k for k in keys_show if _nv_int_tu_ma_key(k) == 2}

        base_keys = [mk for mk, _ in base_all if mk in keys_show]
        base_key_set = {mk for mk, _ in base_all}
        extra_keys = sorted(
            (k for k in keys_show if k not in base_key_set),
            key=lambda k: (
                _nv_int_tu_ma_key(k) or 9,
                int(k.split("_", 1)[0]) if "_" in k and k.split("_", 1)[0].isdigit()
                else (int(k.split("|", 1)[0]) if "|" in k and k.split("|", 1)[0].isdigit() else 9_999),
                k,
            ),
        )

        ds_ct_loc: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        for mk in base_keys + extra_keys:
            ds_ct_loc.append((mk, TEN_CHINH_THUC_CT.get(mk, ten_ct_map.get(mk, mk)) or mk))

        df_pgd = _xay_dung_bang_pgd(pgd_hien_tai, kh_xa, ds_ct_loc)
        if df_pgd.empty:
            if not PGD_XA_MAP.get(pgd_hien_tai):
                st.warning(
                    f"ChÆ°a cÃ³ danh sÃ¡ch xÃ£ cho **{pgd_hien_tai}**. "
                    "Kiá»ƒm tra cáº¥u hÃ¬nh `PGD_XA_MAP` trong config.py."
                )
            else:
                st.info(
                    f"ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u káº¿ hoáº¡ch xÃ£ cho **{pgd_hien_tai}**. "
                    "YÃªu cáº§u PhÃ²ng KH-NV nháº­p dá»¯ liá»‡u trÃªn tab **KHTD theo XÃ£**."
                )
            return

        kh_theo_ct = _tinh_ke_hoach_pgd_theo_ct(pgd_hien_tai, kh_xa, ds_ct_loc)
        df_ss = _bang_so_sanh_kh_th(ds_ct_loc, kh_theo_ct, th_theo_ct)

        # â”€â”€ Metrics tá»•ng â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    # â”€â”€ Tá»•ng há»£p tá»•ng xÃ£ theo tá»«ng mÃ£ CT â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    tong_xa_theo_ct: dict[str, float] = {}

    rows = []

        gia_tri_cn = float(kh_cn.get(ma_key, 0.0))

        elif ty_le_phan_bo is not None and ty_le_phan_bo < 95:

        rows.append({

    # â”€â”€ Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ cáº£nh bÃ¡o tá»•ng quan â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    if co_canh_bao_do:

            "ðŸ”´ **Cáº£nh bÃ¡o nghiÃªm trá»ng:** Má»™t sá»‘ chÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh cÃ³ tá»•ng káº¿ hoáº¡ch xÃ£ "
            "**vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡** káº¿ hoáº¡ch Chi nhÃ¡nh Ä‘Ã£ duyá»‡t!"
        )
    if co_canh_bao_vang:
        st.warning(
            "ðŸŸ¡ **LÆ°u Ã½:** Má»™t sá»‘ chÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh chÆ°a phÃ¢n bá»• Ä‘á»§ 95% káº¿ hoáº¡ch Chi nhÃ¡nh "

        )
    if not co_canh_bao_do and not co_canh_bao_vang:
        st.success("ðŸŸ¢ Táº¥t cáº£ chÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh Ä‘Ã£ phÃ¢n bá»• Ä‘áº¡t yÃªu cáº§u (â‰¥ 95% vÃ  khÃ´ng vÆ°á»£t CN).")

    st.divider()

    # â”€â”€ Metrics tá»•ng â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    tong_cn_all = df["Chi nhÃ¡nh (triá»‡u)"].sum()
    tong_xa_all = df["Tá»•ng xÃ£ (triá»‡u)"].sum()
    ty_le_all = (tong_xa_all / tong_cn_all * 100) if tong_cn_all > 0 else 0.0

    m1, m2, m3, m4 = st.columns(4)
    m1.metric("Tá»•ng KH Chi nhÃ¡nh (triá»‡u)", _fmt_vn(tong_cn_all, 1))
    m2.metric("Tá»•ng KH XÃ£ (triá»‡u)", _fmt_vn(tong_xa_all, 1))
    m3.metric("ChÃªnh lá»‡ch (triá»‡u)", _fmt_vn_signed(tong_xa_all - tong_cn_all, 1))
    m4.metric("Tá»· lá»‡ phÃ¢n bá»• tá»•ng", f"{_fmt_vn(ty_le_all, 1)}%")

    st.divider()

    # â”€â”€ TÃ´ mÃ u báº£ng theo tráº¡ng thÃ¡i â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    def _to_mau_hang(row: pd.Series) -> list[str]:
        if "ðŸ”´" in str(row.get("Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i", "")):
            return ["background-color: #ffd6d6"] * len(row)
        if "ðŸŸ¡" in str(row.get("Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i", "")):

        return [""] * len(row)

    # Column config cho báº£ng cáº£nh bÃ¡o
    column_config_cb: dict[str, st.column_config.Column] = {

        "Tá»· lá»‡ phÃ¢n bá»• %": st.column_config.NumberColumn(
            "Tá»· lá»‡ phÃ¢n bá»• %",
            format="%.1f%%",
            help="Tá»· lá»‡ phÃ¢n bá»• %"

    }

    hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang(

    # â”€â”€ Xuáº¥t Excel â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

"""
Tab Kiá»ƒm soÃ¡t Chi nhÃ¡nh â€” chá»n nhÃ³m/bÃ¡o cÃ¡o tá»« registry, gá»i render_fn tÆ°Æ¡ng á»©ng.
Má»Ÿ rá»™ng bÃ¡o cÃ¡o: chá»‰ sá»­a services/kiem_soat_service.py (registry + hÃ m render).
"""
import pandas as pd
import streamlit as st

from config import (
    COT_TEN_PGD,
    COT_DU_NO_QH,
    COT_TONG_DU_NO,
    COT_SO_KU,
    COT_TEN_KH,
    COT_TEN_CT,
    COT_NGAY_DH,
)
from data import danh_dau_khong_hd, tong_hop_khong_hd, ds_chi_tiet_khong_hd
from services.kiem_soat_service import BAO_CAO_REGISTRY, NHOM_BAO_CAO, chon_pgd_filter


def _get_ks_cache(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    cache_key = (len(df), tuple(df.columns.tolist()))
    ks = st.session_state.get("ks_cache", {})
    if ks.get("_key") == cache_key:
        return ks

    with st.spinner("Äang phÃ¢n tÃ­ch dá»¯ liá»‡u..."):
        df_kh = danh_dau_khong_hd(df)

        df_khd_pgd = tong_hop_khong_hd(df_kh, nhom_theo=COT_TEN_PGD)
        df_khd_chi = ds_chi_tiet_khong_hd(df_kh)

        mask_nqh = pd.to_numeric(
            df_kh.get(COT_DU_NO_QH, pd.Series(dtype=float, index=df_kh.index)),
            errors="coerce",
        ).fillna(0) > 0
        df_nqh = df_kh[mask_nqh]

        if not df_nqh.empty and COT_TEN_PGD in df_nqh.columns:
            df_nqh_pgd = (
                df_nqh.groupby(COT_TEN_PGD, dropna=False)
                .agg(
                    Sá»‘_há»“_sÆ¡_NQH=(COT_SO_KU, "nunique"),
                    Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£_QH=(COT_DU_NO_QH, "sum"),
                    Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£=(COT_TONG_DU_NO, "sum"),
                )
                .reset_index()
            )
            tdn = df_nqh_pgd["Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£"].replace(0, pd.NA)
            df_nqh_pgd["Tá»·_lá»‡_QH_%"] = (
                df_nqh_pgd["Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£_QH"] / tdn * 100
            ).round(1).fillna(0)
        else:
            df_nqh_pgd = pd.DataFrame()

        df_nqh_chi = df_nqh[
            [c for c in [
                COT_TEN_PGD,
                COT_TEN_KH,
                COT_SO_KU,
                COT_TEN_CT,
                COT_DU_NO_QH,
                COT_TONG_DU_NO,
                COT_NGAY_DH,
            ] if c in df_nqh.columns]
        ].reset_index(drop=True)

    result = {
        "_key": cache_key,
        "df_kh": df_kh,
        "df_khd_pgd": df_khd_pgd,
        "df_khd_chi": df_khd_chi,
        "df_nqh_pgd": df_nqh_pgd,
        "df_nqh_chi": df_nqh_chi,
    }
    st.session_state["ks_cache"] = result
    return result


def render_tab(df, role: str, username: str) -> None:
    if df is None or df.empty:
        st.warning("ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u HSTD toÃ n CN.")
        return

    cache = _get_ks_cache(df)

    readonly = role == "executive"
    nhom_keys = list(NHOM_BAO_CAO.keys())

    col_a, col_b, col_c = st.columns([1, 1, 2])
    with col_a:
        st.selectbox(
            "NhÃ³m bÃ¡o cÃ¡o",
            options=nhom_keys,
            format_func=lambda k: NHOM_BAO_CAO[k],
            key="ks_nhom",
        )
    nhom = st.session_state["ks_nhom"]

    ds_ma = [ma for ma, meta in BAO_CAO_REGISTRY.items() if meta.nhom == nhom]
    if not ds_ma:
        st.info("NhÃ³m nÃ y chÆ°a cÃ³ bÃ¡o cÃ¡o.")
        return

    if st.session_state.get("ks_bao_cao") not in ds_ma:
        st.session_state["ks_bao_cao"] = ds_ma[0]

    with col_b:
        st.selectbox(
            "BÃ¡o cÃ¡o",
            options=ds_ma,
            format_func=lambda k: BAO_CAO_REGISTRY[k].ten,
            key="ks_bao_cao",
        )
    with col_c:
        pgd_chon = chon_pgd_filter(df, "main")

    meta = BAO_CAO_REGISTRY[st.session_state["ks_bao_cao"]]
    st.caption(meta.mo_ta)

    meta.render_fn(cache, pgd_chon, username, readonly)

â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  - manager / admin : táº¡o nhiá»‡m vá»¥, xem danh sÃ¡ch, háº­u kiá»ƒm duyá»‡t káº¿t quáº£
  - user (CBTD)     : xem nhiá»‡m vá»¥ Ä‘Æ°á»£c giao, nháº­p & cáº­p nháº­t káº¿t quáº£
"""
import streamlit as st
import db
from datetime import datetime


# â”€â”€ Ãnh xáº¡ nhÃ£n tráº¡ng thÃ¡i â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
_NHAN_TRANG_THAI_NV: dict[str, str] = {
    "cho_thuc_hien":  "â³ Chá» thá»±c hiá»‡n",
    "dang_thuc_hien": "ðŸ”„ Äang thá»±c hiá»‡n",
    "da_hoan_thanh":  "âœ… ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh",
}
_NHAN_TRANG_THAI_KQ: dict[str, str] = {
    "cho_duyet":   "â³ Chá» duyá»‡t",
    "da_duyet":    "âœ… ÄÃ£ duyá»‡t",
    "yeu_cau_sua": "ðŸ” YÃªu cáº§u sá»­a",
}
_NHAN_CHU_KY: dict[str, str] = {
    "thang": "ThÃ¡ng",
    "quy":   "QuÃ½",
    "nam":   "NÄƒm",
}


# â”€â”€ HÃ m tiá»‡n Ã­ch â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def _tao_ky(chu_ky: str) -> list[str]:
    """Táº¡o danh sÃ¡ch nhÃ£n ká»³ tÆ°Æ¡ng á»©ng vá»›i chu ká»³ Ä‘Ã£ chá»n."""
    nam = datetime.now().year
    if chu_ky == "thang":
        return [f"{nam}-T{m:02d}" for m in range(1, 13)]
    if chu_ky == "quy":
        return [f"{nam}-Q{q}" for q in range(1, 5)]
    if chu_ky == "nam":
        return [str(y) for y in range(nam - 1, nam + 2)]
    return []


def _ky_mac_dinh(chu_ky: str, ds_ky: list[str]) -> str:
    """Tráº£ vá» ká»³ máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh phÃ¹ há»£p vá»›i thÃ¡ng / quÃ½ hiá»‡n táº¡i."""
    if not ds_ky:
        return ""
    thang_hien = datetime.now().month
    if chu_ky == "thang":
        return ds_ky[thang_hien - 1]
    if chu_ky == "quy":
        return ds_ky[(thang_hien - 1) // 3]
    return ds_ky[-1]  # nÄƒm hiá»‡n táº¡i (pháº§n tá»­ giá»¯a danh sÃ¡ch 3 nÄƒm)


def _nhan_nv(ts: str) -> str:
    return _NHAN_TRANG_THAI_NV.get(ts, ts)


def _nhan_kq(ts: str) -> str:
    return _NHAN_TRANG_THAI_KQ.get(ts, ts)


# â”€â”€ Truy váº¥n DB â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def _doc_nhiem_vu(chu_ky: str, ky: str, pgd: str | None) -> list[dict]:
    """Äá»c danh sÃ¡ch nhiá»‡m vá»¥ theo chu ká»³ + ká»³ + PGD (NULL = táº¥t cáº£)."""
    with db.get_conn() as conn:
        if pgd:
            rows = conn.execute(
                """SELECT * FROM nhiem_vu
                   WHERE chu_ky=? AND ky=? AND (pgd=? OR pgd IS NULL)
                   ORDER BY id DESC""",
                (chu_ky, ky, pgd),
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM nhiem_vu WHERE chu_ky=? AND ky=? ORDER BY id DESC",
                (chu_ky, ky),
            ).fetchall()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


def _doc_ket_qua(nhiem_vu_id: int) -> list[dict]:
    """Äá»c táº¥t cáº£ káº¿t quáº£ cá»§a má»™t nhiá»‡m vá»¥."""
    with db.get_conn() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM nhiem_vu_ketqua WHERE nhiem_vu_id=? ORDER BY ngay_nhap DESC",
            (nhiem_vu_id,),
        ).fetchall()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


def _doc_ket_qua_pgd(nhiem_vu_id: int, pgd: str) -> dict | None:
    """Äá»c káº¿t quáº£ cá»§a má»™t PGD cá»¥ thá»ƒ cho má»™t nhiá»‡m vá»¥."""
    with db.get_conn() as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM nhiem_vu_ketqua WHERE nhiem_vu_id=? AND pgd=?",
            (nhiem_vu_id, pgd),
        ).fetchone()
    return dict(row) if row else None


def _upsert_ket_qua(
    nhiem_vu_id: int,
    pgd: str,
    noi_dung_th: str | None,
    so_lieu: str | None,
    username: str,
) -> None:
    """ChÃ¨n má»›i hoáº·c cáº­p nháº­t káº¿t quáº£ theo (nhiem_vu_id, pgd)."""
    now = datetime.now().isoformat()
    with db.get_conn() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            """INSERT INTO nhiem_vu_ketqua
               (nhiem_vu_id, pgd, noi_dung_th, so_lieu, trang_thai, nguoi_nhap, ngay_nhap)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'cho_duyet', ?, ?)

                 noi_dung_th = excluded.noi_dung_th,
                 so_lieu     = excluded.so_lieu,

            (nhiem_vu_id, pgd, noi_dung_th, so_lieu, username, now),

# â”€â”€ Widget lá»c chu ká»³ / ká»³ (dÃ¹ng chung) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def _bo_loc_ky(key_prefix: str, hien_pgd: bool = False, ds_pgd: list | None = None):
    """Render bá»™ lá»c chu_ky + ky (+ pgd tuá»³ chá»n). Tráº£ vá» (chu_ky, ky, pgd|None)."""
    cols = st.columns(3) if hien_pgd else st.columns(2)

    with cols[0]:
        chu_ky = st.selectbox(
            "Chu ká»³",
            ["thang", "quy", "nam"],
            format_func=lambda x: _NHAN_CHU_KY[x],
            key=f"{key_prefix}_chu_ky",
        )

    ds_ky = _tao_ky(chu_ky)
    ky_default = _ky_mac_dinh(chu_ky, ds_ky)
    idx_default = ds_ky.index(ky_default) if ky_default in ds_ky else 0

    with cols[1]:
        ky = st.selectbox("Ká»³", ds_ky, index=idx_default, key=f"{key_prefix}_ky")

    pgd_chon = None
    if hien_pgd and ds_pgd is not None:
        with cols[2]:
            pgd_sel = st.selectbox(
                "PGD", ["Táº¥t cáº£ PGD"] + ds_pgd, key=f"{key_prefix}_pgd"
            )
        pgd_chon = None if pgd_sel == "Táº¥t cáº£ PGD" else pgd_sel

    return chu_ky, ky, pgd_chon

def _render_nhap_moi(tab, **kwargs):
    """âž• Nháº­p nhiá»‡m vá»¥ má»›i â€” manager / admin táº¡o nhiá»‡m vá»¥ cho PGD."""
    username: str  = kwargs.get("username", "")

    with tab:
        st.subheader("âž• Nháº­p nhiá»‡m vá»¥ má»›i")

        # chu_ky Ä‘áº·t NGOÃ€I form Ä‘á»ƒ ká»³ cáº­p nháº­t Ä‘á»™ng khi ngÆ°á»i dÃ¹ng Ä‘á»•i chu ká»³
        chu_ky = st.selectbox(
            "Chu ká»³ *",
            ["thang", "quy", "nam"],
            format_func=lambda x: _NHAN_CHU_KY[x],
            key="nhap_moi_chu_ky",
        )
        ds_ky = _tao_ky(chu_ky)

        with st.form("form_nhap_nhiem_vu_moi"):
            tieu_de = st.text_input(
                "TiÃªu Ä‘á» nhiá»‡m vá»¥ *",
                placeholder="VÃ­ dá»¥: Tá»•ng há»£p dÆ° ná»£ NOXH thÃ¡ng 4",
            )
            mo_ta = st.text_area(
                "MÃ´ táº£ chi tiáº¿t",
                placeholder="NÃªu rÃµ yÃªu cáº§u, ná»™i dung cáº§n thá»±c hiá»‡n...",
            )

            c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
            with c1:
                ky = st.selectbox(
                    "Ká»³ *",
                    ds_ky,
                    index=ds_ky.index(ky_default) if ky_default in ds_ky else 0,
                    key="nhap_moi_ky",
                )
            with c2:
                pgd_chon = st.selectbox(
                    "Giao cho PGD",
                    ["Táº¥t cáº£ PGD"] + ds_pgd_all,
                    key="nhap_moi_pgd",
                )

            c3, c4 = st.columns(2)
            with c3:
                ngay_deadline = st.date_input(
                    "NgÃ y deadline", value=None, key="nhap_moi_deadline"
                )
            with c4:
                st.markdown("<br>", unsafe_allow_html=True)

            ghi_chu = st.text_area("Ghi chÃº káº¿ hoáº¡ch (tuá»³ chá»n)")
            submitted = st.form_submit_button("ðŸ’¾ LÆ°u nhiá»‡m vá»¥", type="primary")

        if submitted:

                st.error("âš ï¸ Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p tiÃªu Ä‘á» nhiá»‡m vá»¥!")
            else:
                pgd_luu = None if pgd_chon == "Táº¥t cáº£ PGD" else pgd_chon
                deadline_str = str(ngay_deadline) if ngay_deadline else None
                try:
                    with db.get_conn() as conn:
                        conn.execute(
                            """INSERT INTO nhiem_vu
                               (tieu_de, mo_ta, chu_ky, ky, pgd, trang_thai,
                                nguoi_tao, ngay_tao, ngay_deadline, ghi_chu_kh)
                               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'cho_thuc_hien', ?, ?, ?, ?)""",

                                tieu_de.strip(),
                                mo_ta.strip() or None,
                                chu_ky, ky,

                                username,
                                datetime.now().isoformat(),
                                deadline_str,
                                ghi_chu.strip() or None,
                            ),
                        )
                        conn.commit()
                    db.ghi_audit(
                        username, "nhiem_vu_tao",
                        f"Táº¡o NV: '{tieu_de}' Â· chu_ky={chu_ky} Â· ky={ky} Â· pgd={pgd_luu}",
                    )
                    st.toast(f"âœ… ÄÃ£ táº¡o nhiá»‡m vá»¥: {tieu_de}")

                except Exception as e:
                    st.error(f"Lá»—i khi lÆ°u nhiá»‡m vá»¥: {e}")

def render(tab, **kwargs):
    """Render tab Quáº£n lÃ½ Nhiá»‡m vá»¥ â€” phÃ¢n nhÃ¡nh theo role."""
    role: str = kwargs.get("role", "user")

def _lay_pgd_tu_user(role: str, pgd_user: str | None, df: pd.DataFrame) -> str | None:
    if pgd_user:
        return pgd_user
    if role in ("admin", "manager", "admin_cn", "manager_cn", "executive") and df is not None and COT_TEN_PGD in df.columns:
        ds = df[COT_TEN_PGD].dropna().unique().tolist()
        if len(ds) == 1:
            return str(ds[0])
    return None


def _loc_df_theo_pgd(df: pd.DataFrame, role: str, pgd_user: str | None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return df
    if role in ("user_pgd", "admin_pgd", "manager_pgd", "user") and pgd_user and COT_TEN_PGD in df.columns:
        return df[df[COT_TEN_PGD] == pgd_user].copy()
    return df


def _tao_kv_key(ten_pgd: str) -> str:
    now = datetime.now()
    return f"no_rui_ro_{pgd_slug(ten_pgd)}_{now.year}_{now.month:02d}"

    df_xem = pd.DataFrame(ds)
    cols_xem = [c for c in [
        "ten_kh", "so_ku", "ten_ct", "du_no", "bien_phap",
        "nguyen_nhan", "muc_do", "so_thang", "ngay_rr", "ghi_chu",
    ] if c in df_xem.columns]
    if "du_no" in df_xem.columns:
        df_xem["du_no"] = df_xem["du_no"].apply(lambda x: fmt(x) if pd.notna(x) else "")
    st.dataframe(df_xem[cols_xem], use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)

def render(tab: DeltaGenerator, **kwargs: dict) -> None:
    """
    Render tab NQ11.
    
    Args:
        tab: Streamlit DeltaGenerator cho tab nÃ y
        **kwargs: Chá»©a df, df_full, role, pgd_user, username, df_nq11
    """
    df = kwargs.get("df")
    df_full = kwargs.get("df_full", df)
    role = kwargs.get("role")
    pgd_user = kwargs.get("pgd_user")
    username = kwargs.get("username")
    df_nq11 = kwargs.get("df_nq11")

    with tab:
            st.subheader("ðŸ“‘ Dá»¯ liá»‡u Nghá»‹ Quyáº¿t 11 (NQ11)")

            def fmt_vn_tien(x: float) -> str:
                """Format sá»‘ tiá»n cho metric display."""
                try:
                    x = float(x)
                    if x >= 1e9:
                        return f"{x/1e9:,.3f} tá»· Ä‘á»“ng".replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")
                    if x >= 1e6:
                        return f"{x/1e6:,.1f} triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng".replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")

def _kv_key(slug: str) -> str:
    return f"{_KV_PREFIX}{slug}"


def _doc_ds(slug: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Äá»c danh sÃ¡ch há»“ sÆ¡ QÄ62 cá»§a má»™t PGD. Tráº£ vá» list rá»—ng náº¿u chÆ°a cÃ³."""
    data = db.doc_kv(_kv_key(slug))
    if isinstance(data, list):
        return data
    if isinstance(data, dict) and "danh_sach" in data:
        return data["danh_sach"]
    return []


def _ghi_ds(slug: str, danh_sach: list[dict], username: str) -> None:
    db.ghi_kv(_kv_key(slug), danh_sach, username)


def _lay_pgd_slug(pgd_filter: str | None, role: str) -> str | None:
    """XÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh slug PGD tá»« filter hoáº·c role."""
    if pgd_filter:
        return pgd_slug(pgd_filter)
    return None


def _lay_ten_pgd_tu_slug(slug: str) -> str:
    """Tra ngÆ°á»£c slug â†’ tÃªn PGD tá»« DS_PGD."""
    for ten in DS_PGD:
        if pgd_slug(ten) == slug:
            return ten
    return slug


def _lay_ds_xa(slug: str) -> list[str]:
    """Láº¥y danh sÃ¡ch xÃ£ cá»§a PGD tá»« config."""
    ten_pgd = _lay_ten_pgd_tu_slug(slug)
    return PGD_XA_MAP.get(ten_pgd, [])


def _lay_ct_registry(slug: str) -> list[str]:
    """Äá»c danh sÃ¡ch chÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh tÃ­n dá»¥ng tá»« registry cá»§a PGD."""
    data = db.doc_kv(f"ct_registry_{slug}")
    if isinstance(data, list):
        return data
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        return list(data.keys())
    return []


def _badge(trang_thai: str) -> str:
    return TRANG_THAI_BADGE.get(trang_thai, trang_thai)

# LUá»’NG 1 â€” PGD
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

def _render_pgd(pgd_filter: str, username: str) -> None:
    slug = pgd_slug(pgd_filter)
    ten_pgd = pgd_filter

    # â”€â”€ A. Metrics â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    ds = _doc_ds(slug)
    tong_so = len(ds)
    tong_goc = sum(r.get("du_no_goc", 0) for r in ds)
    tong_lai = sum(r.get("du_no_lai", 0) for r in ds)

    so_duyet = sum(1 for r in ds if r.get("trang_thai") == "da_duyet")

    c1, c2, c3, c4 = st.columns(4)
    c1.metric("ðŸ“‹ Tá»•ng há»“ sÆ¡", f"{tong_so}")
    c2.metric("ðŸ’° DÆ° ná»£ gá»‘c", fmt_ty(tong_goc) if tong_goc else "0")
    c3.metric("â³ Chá» duyá»‡t", f"{so_cho}")
    c4.metric("âœ… ÄÃ£ duyá»‡t", f"{so_duyet}")

    # â”€â”€ B. Form nháº­p há»“ sÆ¡ má»›i â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    with st.expander("âž• ThÃªm há»“ sÆ¡ má»›i", expanded=True):
        with st.form("form_qd62_pgd", clear_on_submit=True):
            col_a, col_b = st.columns(2)
            with col_a:
                ho_ten = st.text_input("Há» tÃªn khÃ¡ch hÃ ng *", placeholder="Nguyá»…n VÄƒn A")
                so_cccd = st.text_input("Sá»‘ CCCD/CMND *", placeholder="0790xxxxxx")
                ds_xa = _lay_ds_xa(slug)
                xa = st.selectbox("XÃ£/PhÆ°á»ng *", ds_xa if ds_xa else [""])
            with col_b:
                ds_ct = _lay_ct_registry(slug)
                chuong_trinh = st.selectbox(
                    "ChÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh tÃ­n dá»¥ng",
                    ds_ct if ds_ct else ["-- ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u --"],

                du_no_goc = st.number_input(
                    "DÆ° ná»£ gá»‘c (triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng) *",
                    min_value=0.0, step=0.1, format="%.1f",
                )
                du_no_lai = st.number_input(
                    "DÆ° ná»£ lÃ£i (triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng)",

                )

            ly_do = st.selectbox("LÃ½ do rá»§i ro *", LY_DO_RUI_RO)
            ghi_chu = st.text_area("Ghi chÃº", placeholder="ThÃ´ng tin bá»• sung (náº¿u cÃ³)", height=80)

            file_ho_so = st.file_uploader(
                "File há»“ sÆ¡ Ä‘Ã­nh kÃ¨m (PDF/XLSX/DOCX)",
                type=["pdf", "xlsx", "docx"],
                accept_multiple_files=False,
            )

            submitted = st.form_submit_button("ðŸ’¾ LÆ°u há»“ sÆ¡", type="primary")

        if submitted:
            # Validate
            errs = []
            if not ho_ten.strip():
                errs.append("Há» tÃªn khÃ¡ch hÃ ng")
            if not so_cccd.strip():
                errs.append("Sá»‘ CCCD/CMND")
            if du_no_goc <= 0:
                errs.append("DÆ° ná»£ gá»‘c pháº£i > 0")
            if not xa or xa == "":
                errs.append("XÃ£/PhÆ°á»ng")
            if errs:
                st.error(f"âš ï¸ Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p: {', '.join(errs)}")
                st.stop()

            # Chuyá»ƒn triá»‡u â†’ VND
            du_no_goc_vnd = int(du_no_goc * 1_000_000)

            ten_file_dinh_kem = ""

                try:
                    thu_muc = thu_muc_pgd(ten_pgd) / "qd62"

                    duong_dan = thu_muc / ten_file_dinh_kem
                    with open(duong_dan, "wb") as f:

                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Lá»—i lÆ°u file Ä‘Ã­nh kÃ¨m QÄ62: {e}")
                    st.error(f"âš ï¸ KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ lÆ°u file Ä‘Ã­nh kÃ¨m: {e}")

            record = {
                "id": f"{slug}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f')}",

                "du_no_goc": du_no_goc_vnd,
                "du_no_lai": du_no_lai_vnd,
                "ly_do": ly_do,
                "ghi_chu": ghi_chu.strip(),

def _doc_toan_cn() -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Gá»™p táº¥t cáº£ há»“ sÆ¡ QÄ62 tá»« cÃ¡c PGD trong DS_PGD thÃ nh 1 DataFrame."""
    all_rows = []
    for ten_pgd in DS_PGD:

    return pd.DataFrame(all_rows)

    tong_goc_loc = int(df_loc["du_no_goc"].sum()) if "du_no_goc" in df_loc.columns else 0
    tong_lai_loc = int(df_loc["du_no_lai"].sum()) if "du_no_lai" in df_loc.columns else 0

def render(mode: str, pgd_filter: str | None = None) -> None:
    """
    Äiá»ƒm vÃ o chÃ­nh cho tab QÄ62.

    Args:
        mode: "pgd" â€” luá»“ng PGD (CBTD nháº­p há»“ sÆ¡)
              "cn"  â€” luá»“ng Chi nhÃ¡nh (manager/admin kiá»ƒm soÃ¡t)
        pgd_filter: TÃªn PGD (báº¯t buá»™c náº¿u mode="pgd", bá» qua náº¿u mode="cn")
    """
    if mode not in ("pgd", "cn"):
        st.error(f"âš ï¸ mode khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡: {mode}. Chá»‰ cháº¥p nháº­n 'pgd' hoáº·c 'cn'.")
        return

    username = st.session_state.get("username", "unknown")
    role = st.session_state.get("user_info", {}).get("role", "user")

    st.subheader("âš ï¸ Theo dÃµi ná»£ rá»§i ro â€” QÄ62/QÄ-HÄQT NHCSXH")
    st.caption(
        "Quáº£n lÃ½ há»“ sÆ¡ Ä‘á» nghá»‹ xá»­ lÃ½ ná»£ rá»§i ro. "
        "PGD nháº­p Ä‘á» nghá»‹ â†’ Chi nhÃ¡nh kiá»ƒm soÃ¡t vÃ  phÃª duyá»‡t."
    )

    if mode == "pgd":
        if not pgd_filter:
            # Fallback: láº¥y tá»« session
            pgd_filter = st.session_state.get("user_info", {}).get("pgd")
        if not pgd_filter:
            st.error("âš ï¸ KhÃ´ng xÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh Ä‘Æ°á»£c PGD. Vui lÃ²ng chá»n tá»« sidebar.")
            return
        _render_pgd(pgd_filter, username)
    else:
        _render_cn(username, role)

def _resolve_pgd_key(pgd_user: str) -> str:

    'PGD BiÃªn HÃ²a' â†’ DON_VI_CHI_NHANH vÃ¬ dgd_map lÆ°u key ná»™i bá»™.

def _hostname() -> str:

    except Exception:

def _df_hstd(kwargs: dict[str, Any]) -> pd.DataFrame:

    if df is None:

def _render_tong_quan(df_h: pd.DataFrame, username: str, hn: str) -> None:
    _ = df_h, username, hn
    st.markdown("### ðŸ“‹ Tá»•ng quan")
    st.caption("So sÃ¡nh dgd_map vá»›i danh má»¥c xÃ£ trong config.PGD_XA_MAP.")
    dgd_map = db.doc_dgd_map()
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for ten_pgd in sorted(PGD_XA_MAP.keys()):
        block = dgd_map.get(ten_pgd, {})
        if not isinstance(block, dict):
            block = {}
        so_xa = len(block)
        so_dgd = 0
        so_ap = 0
        for xa_d in block.values():
            if isinstance(xa_d, dict):
                so_dgd += len(xa_d)
                for lst in xa_d.values():
                    if isinstance(lst, list):
                        so_ap += len(lst)
        stt, note = trang_thai_pgd_vs_map(ten_pgd, dgd_map)
        rows.append(
            {
                "PGD": ten_pgd,
                "Sá»‘ xÃ£": fmt_so(so_xa),
                "Sá»‘ ÄGD": fmt_so(so_dgd),
                "Sá»‘ áº¥p/KP": fmt_so(so_ap),
                "Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i": stt,
                "Ghi chÃº": note,
            }
        )
    df_o = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if df_o.empty:
        st.info("KhÃ´ng cÃ³ PGD trong PGD_XA_MAP.")
        return
    def _uu_tien(r: pd.Series) -> int:
        chua = (
            str(r["Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i"]).startswith("âš ï¸")
            or r["PGD"] not in dgd_map
            or not dgd_map.get(r["PGD"])
        )
        return 0 if chua else 1

    df_o["_uu"] = df_o.apply(_uu_tien, axis=1)
    df_o = df_o.sort_values(["_uu", "PGD"]).drop(columns=["_uu"])
    hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang(df_o, key="dgd_tongquan_tbl", height=420)

            c_s, c_d = st.columns(2)
            with c_s:

                    tm = ten_moi.strip()
                    if not tm:
                        st.error("TÃªn ÄGD khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c Ä‘á»ƒ trá»‘ng.")
                    elif dgd_dang_dung_trong_hstd(df_h, _resolve_pgd_key(ten_pgd), chon_xa, ten_dgd) and (
                        tm != ten_dgd.strip()

                    elif tm != ten_dgd and tm in xa_dgd:

                                db.ghi_audit(

            with c_d:

                                f"[{hn}] PGD={ten_pgd} xa={chon_xa} ÄGD={ten_dgd!r}",
                            )
                            st.cache_data.clear()

    st.divider()

    st_thon = st.multiselect("Chá»n thÃ´n/áº¥p", pool, key="dgd_add_thon")

"""Tab Tá»•ng quan."""
from __future__ import annotations
