@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)
def _cache_kpi_tongquan(
    _df: pd.DataFrame,
    ts: float,
    pgd_user: str,
    pgd_filter: str,
    cot_tdn: str,
    cot_dth: str,
    cot_dqh: str,
    cot_nk: str,
    cot_ku: str,
    cot_ma_kh: str,
) -> dict:
    _ = (ts, pgd_user, pgd_filter)  # tham gia cache key; trÃ¡nh unused-argument
    tdn = _df[cot_tdn].sum() if cot_tdn in _df.columns else 0
    dth = _df[cot_dth].sum() if cot_dth in _df.columns else 0
    dqh = _df[cot_dqh].sum() if cot_dqh in _df.columns else 0
    dnk = _df[cot_nk].sum() if cot_nk in _df.columns else 0
    n_mon_vay = _df[cot_ku].nunique() if cot_ku in _df.columns else len(_df)
    n_kh = _df[cot_ma_kh].nunique() if cot_ma_kh in _df.columns else 0
    try:
        from data import danh_dau_khong_hd

        df_kh = danh_dau_khong_hd(_df)
        n_3m = int(df_kh["is_3m_inactive"].sum()) if "is_3m_inactive" in df_kh.columns else 0
        dn_3m = (
            df_kh.loc[df_kh["is_3m_inactive"], cot_tdn].sum()
            if ("is_3m_inactive" in df_kh.columns and cot_tdn in df_kh.columns)
            else 0
        )
    except Exception as e:
        n_3m = 0
        dn_3m = 0
        logging.warning(
            "[tongquan_kpi] danh_dau_khong_hd lá»—i: %s",
            e,
        )
    return dict(
        tdn=tdn,
        dth=dth,
        dqh=dqh,
        dnk=dnk,
        n_mon_vay=n_mon_vay,
        n_kh=n_kh,
        n_3m=n_3m,
        dn_3m=dn_3m,
    )


@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)
def _cache_heatmap_pgd(
    _df: pd.DataFrame,
    ts: float,
    pgd_user: str,
    pgd_filter: str,
    cot_pgd: str,
    cot_tdn: str,
    cot_ma_kh: str,
    cot_dqh: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    _ = (ts, pgd_user, pgd_filter)  # tham gia cache key; trÃ¡nh unused-argument
    return _df.groupby(cot_pgd, as_index=False).agg(
        du_no=(cot_tdn, "sum"),
        so_kh=(cot_ma_kh, "nunique"),
        nqh=(cot_dqh, "sum"),
    )

        )
        if os.path.exists(CACHE_HSTD):

        else:

        st.divider()

        try:
            # Thá»­ load theo tá»«ng thÃ¡ng trong ds_thang_nam(), láº¥y cÃ¡i Ä‘áº§u tiÃªn cÃ³ data

            # Fallback: gá»™p trá»±c tiáº¿p tá»« pgd_data náº¿u ds_thang khÃ´ng cÃ³ gÃ¬
            if df_to_raw is None or df_to_raw.empty:
                from data.cdtotkvv import doc_cdtotkvv_toan_cn_pgd
                df_to_raw = doc_cdtotkvv_toan_cn_pgd()

                tong_to = int(th["tong_to"].sum())
                to_tot = int(th["to_tot"].sum())
                to_kha = int(th["to_kha"].sum())
                to_tb = int(th["to_tb"].sum())
                to_yeu = int(th["to_yeu"].sum())

                tl_tot = (to_tot / tong_to * 100) if tong_to else 0

                tl_tb = (to_tb / tong_to * 100) if tong_to else 0
                tl_yeu = (to_yeu / tong_to * 100) if tong_to else 0
                _tong_to = fmt_so(tong_to)

                _to_kha = fmt_so(to_kha)
                _to_tb = fmt_so(to_tb)

                _tl_kha = vn(tl_kha, 1)
                _tl_tb = vn(tl_tb, 1)
                _tl_yeu = vn(tl_yeu, 1)
                st.markdown(
                        f"""
                        <div class="totkvv-wrap">
                            <div class="totkvv-head">
                                <div class="totkvv-title">Xáº¿p loáº¡i Tá»• TK&amp;VV toÃ n Chi nhÃ¡nh</div>
                                <div class="totkvv-chip">{f"ThÃ¡ng {thang_hien}" if thang_hien else "Dá»¯ liá»‡u tá»•ng há»£p"}</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="totkvv-grid">
                                <div class="totkvv-item tot-a">
                                    <div class="v">{_tong_to}</div>
                                    <div class="l">Tá»•ng Tá»•</div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="totkvv-item tot-b">
                                    <div class="v">{_to_tot}</div>
                                    <div class="l">Tá»‘t Â· <span class="s">{_tl_tot}%</span></div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="totkvv-item tot-c">
                                    <div class="v">{_to_kha}</div>
                                    <div class="l">KhÃ¡ Â· <span class="s">{_tl_kha}%</span></div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="totkvv-item tot-d">
                                    <div class="v">{_to_tb}</div>
                                    <div class="l">Trung bÃ¬nh Â· <span class="s">{_tl_tb}%</span></div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="totkvv-item tot-e">
                                    <div class="v">{_to_yeu}</div>
                                    <div class="l">Yáº¿u Â· <span class="s">{_tl_yeu}%</span></div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        """,
                        unsafe_allow_html=True,
                )
                st.divider()
        except Exception:
            pass

        st.markdown("**ðŸ“‚ CÆ¡ cáº¥u dÆ° ná»£ theo chÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh tÃ­n dá»¥ng**")
        if COT_TEN_CT in df.columns and COT_TONG_DU_NO in df.columns:

            # TÃ­nh toÃ¡n
            df_ct = (
                df.groupby(COT_TEN_CT)[COT_TONG_DU_NO]
                .sum()
                .sort_values(ascending=False)
                .reset_index()
            )
            df_ct.columns = ["ten_ct", "du_no"]
            df_ct = df_ct[df_ct["du_no"] > 0]
            tong = df_ct["du_no"].sum()
            df_ct["ty_trong"] = (df_ct["du_no"] / tong * 100) if tong > 0 else 0

            # Báº£ng mÃ u xoay vÃ²ng theo thá»© tá»±
            _MAUS = [
                "#1565C0", "#2E7D32", "#6A1B9A", "#E65100",
                "#00695C", "#AD1457", "#4527A0", "#558B2F",
            ]

"""Tab Tra cá»©u há»“ sÆ¡ â€” nÃ¢ng cao."""
from __future__ import annotations

import unicodedata
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd

from config import (
    COT_TEN_PGD, COT_MA_KH, COT_TEN_KH, COT_SO_KU,

)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from streamlit.delta_generator import DeltaGenerator


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# HELPERS
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

def _bo_dau(s: str) -> str:
    """Loáº¡i bá» dáº¥u tiáº¿ng Viá»‡t Ä‘á»ƒ tÃ¬m kiáº¿m khÃ´ng phÃ¢n biá»‡t dáº¥u."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s)
    return "".join(c for c in s if unicodedata.category(c) != "Mn").lower()


def _tim_mem(df: pd.DataFrame, cols: list[str], tu_khoa: str) -> pd.Series:
    """
    TÃ¬m kiáº¿m má»m: khÃ´ng phÃ¢n biá»‡t hoa/thÆ°á»ng, cÃ³ dáº¥u/khÃ´ng dáº¥u.
    
    Args:
        df: DataFrame chá»©a dá»¯ liá»‡u cáº§n tÃ¬m
        cols: Danh sÃ¡ch tÃªn cá»™t cáº§n tÃ¬m kiáº¿m
        tu_khoa: Tá»« khÃ³a tÃ¬m kiáº¿m
    
    Returns:
        pd.Series boolean mask cho cÃ¡c dÃ²ng khá»›p tá»« khÃ³a
    """
    kw = tu_khoa.strip().lower()
    kw_bdau = _bo_dau(tu_khoa.strip())
    mask = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    for col in cols:
        if col not in df.columns:
            continue
        s = df[col].fillna("").astype(str).str.lower()
        # Vectorized bá» dáº¥u cho toÃ n cá»™t
        s_bdau = s.str.normalize("NFD").str.replace(r"[^\w\s]", "", regex=False)
        mask |= s.str.contains(kw, regex=False, na=False)
        mask |= s_bdau.str.contains(kw_bdau, regex=False, na=False)
    return mask


def _xay_nq11_set(df_nq11: pd.DataFrame | None) -> set[str]:
    """
    XÃ¢y dá»±ng táº­p há»£p Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c thuá»™c NQ11 cÃ³ dÆ° ná»£ > 0 (tá»« sao kÃª NQ11).
    
    Args:
        df_nq11: DataFrame sao kÃª NQ11
    
    Returns:
        Set chá»©a cÃ¡c Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c cÃ³ dÆ° ná»£ NQ11 > 0
    """
    if df_nq11 is None or len(df_nq11) == 0:
        return set()
    col_ku = "Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c"
    col_dno = "DNO NQ11"
    if col_ku not in df_nq11.columns or col_dno not in df_nq11.columns:
        return set()
    mask = pd.to_numeric(df_nq11[col_dno], errors="coerce").fillna(0) > 0
    return set(df_nq11.loc[mask, col_ku].astype(str).str.strip())


def _xay_gqvl_nq11_set(df_sk_gqvl: pd.DataFrame | None) -> set[str]:
    """
    XÃ¢y dá»±ng táº­p há»£p Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c cÃ³ ghi chÃº NQ11 tá»« file sao kÃª GQVL.
    DÃ¹ng Ä‘á»ƒ xÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh nhÃ£n NQ11 cho cÃ¡c mÃ³n vay dÆ° ná»£ = 0.
    
    Args:
        df_sk_gqvl: DataFrame sao kÃª GQVL
    
    Returns:
        Set chá»©a cÃ¡c Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c cÃ³ ghi chÃº NQ11
    """
    if df_sk_gqvl is None or len(df_sk_gqvl) == 0:
        return set()
    col_ku = "Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c"
    col_nq = "NQ11"
    if col_ku not in df_sk_gqvl.columns or col_nq not in df_sk_gqvl.columns:
        return set()
    mask = df_sk_gqvl[col_nq].astype(str).str.strip() == "NQ11"
    return set(df_sk_gqvl.loc[mask, col_ku].astype(str).str.strip())

def _kiem_tra_nq11(
    so_ku: str,
    tong_du_no: float,
    nq11_so_ku_set: set[str],
    gqvl_nq11_set: set[str]
) -> bool:
    """
    Kiá»ƒm tra mÃ³n vay cÃ³ thuá»™c NQ11 khÃ´ng.
    
    Logic:
    - Náº¿u dÆ° ná»£ > 0: so khá»›p vá»›i táº­p há»£p tá»« sao kÃª NQ11 (DNO NQ11 > 0).
    - Náº¿u dÆ° ná»£ = 0: so khá»›p vá»›i táº­p há»£p tá»« sao kÃª GQVL (cá»™t NQ11 = 'NQ11').
    
    Args:
        so_ku: Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c cáº§n kiá»ƒm tra
        tong_du_no: Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£ hiá»‡n táº¡i
        nq11_so_ku_set: Set Sá»‘ KU tá»« sao kÃª NQ11 cÃ³ dÆ° ná»£ > 0
        gqvl_nq11_set: Set Sá»‘ KU tá»« sao kÃª GQVL cÃ³ ghi chÃº NQ11
    
    Returns:
        True náº¿u mÃ³n vay thuá»™c NQ11
    """
    ku = str(so_ku).strip()
    if tong_du_no > 0:
        return ku in nq11_so_ku_set
    return ku in gqvl_nq11_set


def _nv_str(val) -> str:
    """Chuyá»ƒn mÃ£ nguá»“n vá»‘n thÃ nh tÃªn hiá»ƒn thá»‹."""
    if pd.isna(val):
        return "â€”"
    return NGUON_VON_LABEL.get(val, NGUON_VON_LABEL.get(str(val), str(val)))


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# CARD CHI TIáº¾T
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

def _render_card(
    hs: pd.Series,
    df_nq11: pd.DataFrame | None,
    nq11_so_ku_set: set[str],
    gqvl_nq11_set: set[str]
) -> None:
    """
    Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ card chi tiáº¿t há»“ sÆ¡ khÃ¡ch hÃ ng.
    
    Args:
        hs: Series chá»©a thÃ´ng tin má»™t há»“ sÆ¡
        df_nq11: DataFrame sao kÃª NQ11 Ä‘á»ƒ hiá»ƒn thá»‹ chi tiáº¿t
        nq11_so_ku_set: Set Sá»‘ KU NQ11 (dÆ° ná»£ > 0)
        gqvl_nq11_set: Set Sá»‘ KU NQ11 (dÆ° ná»£ = 0)
    """
    so_ku       = str(hs.get(COT_SO_KU, "")).strip()
    tong_du_no  = float(hs.get(COT_TONG_DU_NO, 0) or 0)
    nq11        = _kiem_tra_nq11(so_ku, tong_du_no, nq11_so_ku_set, gqvl_nq11_set)
    ten_ct  = str(hs.get(COT_TEN_CT, ""))
    dqh     = float(hs.get(COT_DU_NO_QH, 0) or 0)
    nv_val  = hs.get(COT_NGUON_VON)
    la_dp   = str(nv_val) in ("2", "2.0") or nv_val == 2

    # TiÃªu Ä‘á»
    ten_kh   = str(hs.get(COT_TEN_KH, "â€”"))
    badge_nq = ' <span style="background:#fff3e0;color:#e65100;border:1px solid #ffb74d;border-radius:10px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700">âœ¨ NQ11</span>' if nq11 else ""
    badge_qh = ' <span style="background:#ffebee;color:#c62828;border:1px solid #ef9a9a;border-radius:10px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700">âš ï¸ QuÃ¡ háº¡n</span>' if dqh > 0 else ""
    border   = "#c62828" if dqh > 0 else "#1565c0"

    st.markdown(
        f'<div style="background:#f8f9fa;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 18px;'
        f'border-left:4px solid {border};margin-bottom:6px">'
        f'<span style="font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700">{ten_kh}</span>'
        f'{badge_nq}{badge_qh}</div>',
        unsafe_allow_html=True,
    )

    c1, c2, c3 = st.columns(3)

    with c1:
        st.markdown("**ðŸ‘¤ KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng**")
        for lbl, col in [("MÃ£ KH", COT_MA_KH), ("CMND/CCCD", COT_CMND),
                          ("SÄT", COT_SDT), ("Äá»‹a chá»‰", COT_DIA_CHI),
                          ("Tá»•", COT_TEN_TO), ("XÃ£", COT_TEN_XA), ("PGD", COT_TEN_PGD)]:
            v = hs.get(col)
            if pd.notna(v) and str(v).strip() not in ("", "nan"):
                st.caption(f"**{lbl}:** {v}")
        for lbl, col in [("TÃªn HSSV", COT_TEN_HSSV), ("Vá»£/chá»“ng", COT_TEN_VC)]:
            v = hs.get(col)
            if pd.notna(v) and str(v).strip() not in ("", "nan"):
                st.caption(f"**{lbl}:** {v}")

    with c2:
        st.markdown("**ðŸ“„ Khoáº£n vay**")
        ct_html = ten_ct + (badge_nq if nq11 else "")
        st.markdown(f"**ChÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh:** {ct_html}", unsafe_allow_html=True)
        nv_color = "#e65100" if la_dp else "#1565c0"
        st.markdown(
            f'**Nguá»“n vá»‘n:** <span style="color:{nv_color};font-weight:600">{_nv_str(nv_val)}</span>',
            unsafe_allow_html=True,
        )
        if la_dp:
            ma_ndt = hs.get(COT_MA_NHA_DAU_TU)
            if pd.notna(ma_ndt) and str(ma_ndt).strip() not in ("", "nan"):
                st.caption(f"**MÃ£ NÄT:** {ma_ndt}")
        for lbl, col in [("Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c", COT_SO_KU), ("NgÃ y vay", COT_NGAY_VAY),
                          ("Äáº¿n háº¡n", COT_NGAY_DH), ("Thá»i háº¡n", COT_THOI_HAN),
                          ("LÃ£i suáº¥t", COT_LAI_SUAT), ("TÃ¬nh tráº¡ng", COT_TINH_TRANG)]:
            v = hs.get(col)
            if pd.notna(v) and str(v).strip() not in ("", "nan"):
                st.caption(f"**{lbl}:** {v}")
        v_mv = hs.get(COT_MUC_VAY)
        if pd.notna(v_mv):
            st.caption(f"**Má»©c vay:** {fmt_tien(v_mv)}")

    with c3:
        st.markdown("**ðŸ’° DÆ° ná»£**")
        for lbl, col in [("Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£", COT_TONG_DU_NO),
                          ("DÆ° ná»£ trong háº¡n", COT_DU_NO_TH),
                          ("Gá»‘c Ä‘Ã£ tráº£", COT_GOC_TRA)]:
            v = hs.get(col)
            if pd.notna(v):
                st.caption(f"**{lbl}:** {fmt_tien(v)}")
        # NQH â€” tÃ´ Ä‘á»
        if dqh > 0:
            st.markdown(
                f'<div style="background:#ffebee;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;margin-top:4px">'
                f'âš ï¸ <b>DÆ° ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n:</b> '
                f'<span style="color:#c62828;font-weight:700">{fmt_tien(dqh)}</span></div>',
                unsafe_allow_html=True,
            )
        else:
            st.caption("**DÆ° ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n:** â€”")

    # Chi tiáº¿t NQ11 tá»« file NQ11
    if nq11 and df_nq11 is not None and len(df_nq11):
        so_ku = str(hs.get(COT_SO_KU, ""))
        row_nq = None
        for col_nq in ["Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c", "MÃ£ khÃ¡ch hÃ ng"]:
            if col_nq in df_nq11.columns:
                val_tim = so_ku if col_nq == "Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c" else str(hs.get(COT_MA_KH, ""))
                tim = df_nq11[df_nq11[col_nq].astype(str) == val_tim]
                if not tim.empty:
                    row_nq = tim.iloc[0]
                    break
        if row_nq is not None:
            with st.expander("âœ¨ Chi tiáº¿t sá»‘ dÆ° NQ11", expanded=False):
                nc1, nc2 = st.columns(2)
                for i, (lbl, col) in enumerate([
                    ("DÆ° ná»£ NQ11", "DNO NQ11"),
                    ("Ná»£ trong háº¡n", "Ná»£ trong háº¡n"),
                    ("Ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n", "Ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n"),
                    ("Äáº¿n háº¡n sau cÃ¹ng", "Äáº¿n háº¡n sau cÃ¹ng"),
                ]):
                    if col in row_nq.index:
                        cell = nc1 if i % 2 == 0 else nc2
                        v = row_nq[col]
                        cell.metric(lbl, fmt_tien(v) if col != "Äáº¿n háº¡n sau cÃ¹ng" else str(v))


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# Báº¢NG RÃšT Gá»ŒN
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

def _render_bang(
    df_kq: pd.DataFrame,
    nq11_so_ku_set: set[str],
    gqvl_nq11_set: set[str]
) -> None:
    """
    Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ báº£ng rÃºt gá»n káº¿t quáº£ tra cá»©u.
    
    Args:
        df_kq: DataFrame káº¿t quáº£ tÃ¬m kiáº¿m
        nq11_so_ku_set: Set Sá»‘ KU NQ11 (dÆ° ná»£ > 0)
        gqvl_nq11_set: Set Sá»‘ KU NQ11 (dÆ° ná»£ = 0)
    """
    COLS_HIEN = [
        COT_TEN_KH, COT_CMND, COT_TEN_CT, COT_TONG_DU_NO,
        COT_DU_NO_QH, COT_TEN_TO, COT_TEN_XA, COT_NGAY_DH,
        COT_NGUON_VON, COT_MA_NHA_DAU_TU
    ]
    cols = [c for c in COLS_HIEN if c in df_kq.columns]
    df_hien = df_kq[cols].copy()

    # ThÃªm badge NQ11 vÃ o tÃªn chÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh
    if COT_TEN_CT in df_kq.columns and COT_SO_KU in df_kq.columns:
        def them_badge(row: pd.Series) -> str:
            ten = str(row[COT_TEN_CT])
            so_ku = str(row[COT_SO_KU]).strip()
            tong_dn = float(row.get(COT_TONG_DU_NO, 0) or 0) \
                if COT_TONG_DU_NO in row.index else 0.0
            la_nq11 = _kiem_tra_nq11(so_ku, tong_dn, nq11_so_ku_set, gqvl_nq11_set)
            return ten + (" âœ¨NQ11" if la_nq11 else "")
        df_hien[COT_TEN_CT] = df_kq.apply(them_badge, axis=1)

    # XÃ¢y dá»±ng column_config cho st.dataframe
    column_config: dict[str, st.column_config.Column] = {}
    
    if COT_TONG_DU_NO in df_hien.columns:
        column_config[COT_TONG_DU_NO] = st.column_config.NumberColumn(
            "Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£",
            format="%.0f â‚«",
            help="Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£ hiá»‡n táº¡i"
        )
    
    if COT_DU_NO_QH in df_hien.columns:
        column_config[COT_DU_NO_QH] = st.column_config.NumberColumn(
            "DÆ° ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n",
            format="%.0f â‚«",
            help="DÆ° ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n (sáº½ tÃ´ Ä‘á» náº¿u > 0)"
        )
    
    if COT_MA_NHA_DAU_TU in df_hien.columns:
        column_config[COT_MA_NHA_DAU_TU] = st.column_config.TextColumn("MÃ£ NÄT")
    
    # Highlight NQH Ä‘á» báº±ng style
    def hl(row: pd.Series) -> list[str]:
        styles = [""] * len(row)
        if COT_DU_NO_QH in df_hien.columns:
            idx = list(df_hien.columns).index(COT_DU_NO_QH)
            try:
                raw = df_kq.iloc[row.name][COT_DU_NO_QH]
                if float(raw) > 0:
                    styles[idx] = "color:#c62828;font-weight:700"
            except Exception:
                pass
        return styles

    hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang(
        df_hien.reset_index(drop=True).style.apply(hl, axis=1),
        key="tracuu_ket_qua",
        column_config=column_config,
        height=min(420, 60 + len(df_hien) * 36),
    )


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# ENTRY POINT
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

def render(tab: DeltaGenerator, **kwargs: dict) -> None:
    """
    Render tab Tra cá»©u há»“ sÆ¡.
    
    Args:
        tab: Streamlit DeltaGenerator cho tab nÃ y
        **kwargs: Chá»©a df (HSTD), df_nq11 (sao kÃª NQ11), df_sk_gqvl (sao kÃª GQVL)
    """
    df          = kwargs.get("df")
    df_nq11     = kwargs.get("df_nq11")
    df_sk_gqvl  = kwargs.get("df_sk_gqvl")

    # Táº­p há»£p Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c NQ11 cÃ³ dÆ° ná»£ > 0 (tá»« sao kÃª NQ11)
    nq11_so_ku_set  = _xay_nq11_set(df_nq11)
    # Táº­p há»£p Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c cÃ³ ghi chÃº NQ11 trong sao kÃª GQVL (dÃ¹ng cho mÃ³n dÆ° ná»£ = 0)
    gqvl_nq11_set   = _xay_gqvl_nq11_set(df_sk_gqvl)

    # Chá»‰ giá»¯ cá»™t cáº§n thiáº¿t â†’ tiáº¿t kiá»‡m RAM
    COLS_CAN = [
        COT_TEN_PGD, COT_MA_KH, COT_TEN_KH, COT_CMND,
        COT_SO_KU, COT_SDT, COT_DIA_CHI, COT_TEN_TO, COT_TEN_XA, COT_TEN_THON,
        COT_TEN_HSSV, COT_TEN_VC,
        COT_NGAY_VAY, COT_NGAY_DH, COT_THOI_HAN, COT_LAI_SUAT,
        COT_MUC_VAY, COT_DU_NO_TH, COT_DU_NO_QH, COT_TONG_DU_NO, COT_GOC_TRA,
        COT_TEN_CT, COT_MA_CHUONG_TRINH, COT_TINH_TRANG,
        COT_NGUON_VON, COT_MA_NHA_DAU_TU,
    ]
    df_work = df[[c for c in COLS_CAN if c in df.columns]].copy()

    with tab:
        st.subheader("ðŸ” Tra cá»©u há»“ sÆ¡ khÃ¡ch hÃ ng")

        # â”€â”€ Search box â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        sb1, sb2 = st.columns([5, 1])
        with sb1:
            tu_khoa = st.text_input(
                "keyword", label_visibility="collapsed",
                placeholder="ðŸ”  TÃªn KH Â· CMND/CCCD Â· Sá»‘ kháº¿ Æ°á»›c Â· TÃªn HSSV Â· TÃªn vá»£/chá»“ng...",
                key="tc_keyword",
            )
        with sb2:
            st.button("TÃ¬m", type="primary", use_container_width=True)

        # â”€â”€ Filter buttons â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        f_opts = ["Táº¥t cáº£", "Nguá»“n TW", "Nguá»“n ÄP", "NQ11", "QuÃ¡ háº¡n", "MÃ£ NÄT"]
        if "tc_filter" not in st.session_state:
            st.session_state.tc_filter = "Táº¥t cáº£"

        fc = st.columns(len(f_opts))
        for i, f in enumerate(f_opts):
            is_active = st.session_state.tc_filter == f
            label = f"**{f}**" if is_active else f
            if fc[i].button(label, key=f"fb_{i}", use_container_width=True):
                st.session_state.tc_filter = f
                st.rerun()
        active_filter = st.session_state.tc_filter
        st.divider()

        # â”€â”€ Thá»±c hiá»‡n tÃ¬m kiáº¿m & lá»c â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        if not tu_khoa.strip() and active_filter == "Táº¥t cáº£":
            st.info("ðŸ’¡ Nháº­p tá»« khÃ³a hoáº·c chá»n bá»™ lá»c nhanh bÃªn trÃªn.")
            return

        if tu_khoa.strip():
            COLS_TIM = [COT_TEN_KH, COT_CMND, COT_SO_KU,
                        COT_TEN_HSSV, COT_TEN_VC, COT_MA_KH]
            mask    = _tim_mem(df_work, COLS_TIM, tu_khoa)
            df_kq   = df_work[mask].copy()
        else:
            df_kq = df_work.copy()

    """Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ chi tiáº¿t tráº¡ng thÃ¡i theo tá»«ng PGD."""

def _hien_thi_trang_thai_card(loai: str, label: str, tt: dict) -> None:
    """Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ card tráº¡ng thÃ¡i cho má»™t loáº¡i file."""
    st.markdown(f"**{label}**")

    if not tt.get("co_file"):

        st.caption(f"File: `{loai}_latest.xlsx` chÆ°a cÃ³ trong thÆ° má»¥c PGD")
        return

    trang_thai = tt.get("canh_bao", "")
    ngay_upload = tt.get("ngay_upload")
    ngay_so_lieu = tt.get("ngay_so_lieu")
    so_ngay_cu = tt.get("so_ngay_cu", 0)

    if trang_thai == "ok":
        st.success("ðŸŸ¢ Dá»¯ liá»‡u má»›i")
    else:
        st.warning(f"ðŸŸ¡ Dá»¯ liá»‡u cÅ© ({so_ngay_cu} ngÃ y chÆ°a cáº­p nháº­t)")

    if ngay_upload:
        st.caption(f"ðŸ“… Upload: {ngay_upload.strftime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M')}")

    if ngay_so_lieu:
        st.caption(f"ðŸ“† Sá»‘ liá»‡u: {ngay_so_lieu.strftime('%d/%m/%Y')}")
    else:
        st.caption("ðŸ“† Sá»‘ liá»‡u: KhÃ´ng xÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh")


def _tinh_thong_ke(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    """TÃ­nh thá»‘ng kÃª tá»« DataFrame tráº¡ng thÃ¡i upload."""
    tong = len(df)
    if tong == 0:
        return {
            "tong_don_vi": 0,
            "da_upload_hstd": 0, "ty_le_hstd": 0,
            "da_upload_nq11": 0, "ty_le_nq11": 0,
            "da_upload_gqvl": 0, "ty_le_gqvl": 0,
        }

    def dem_co_file(col: str) -> int:
        return int(df[col].apply(lambda x: "âœ…" in str(x) or "âš ï¸" in str(x)).sum())

    da_hstd = dem_co_file("HSTD")
    da_nq11 = dem_co_file("NQ11")
    da_gqvl = dem_co_file("GQVL")

    return {
        "tong_don_vi": tong,
        "da_upload_hstd": da_hstd, "ty_le_hstd": da_hstd / tong * 100,
        "da_upload_nq11": da_nq11, "ty_le_nq11": da_nq11 / tong * 100,
        "da_upload_gqvl": da_gqvl, "ty_le_gqvl": da_gqvl / tong * 100,
    }

"""

Giao diá»‡n:
  - Selectbox chá»n Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹: ["Há»™i sá»Ÿ Chi nhÃ¡nh tá»‰nh"] + DS_PGD (22 Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹)
  - 4 uploader theo cá»™t ngang: HSTD | NQ11 | GQVL | CDTOTKVV
  - NÃºt "ðŸ“¤ Upload" â€” xá»­ lÃ½ cáº£ 4 file cÃ¹ng lÃºc
  - Kiá»ƒm tra tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ trong file trÆ°á»›c khi lÆ°u
  - Tá»± Ä‘á»™ng merge toÃ n CN sau khi lÆ°u HSTD/NQ11/GQVL
  - Báº£ng tráº¡ng thÃ¡i 22 hÃ ng Ã— 5 cá»™t
"""
from io import BytesIO
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import streamlit as st

import db
from auth import la_phan_he_cn
from config import DS_PGD, DON_VI_CHI_NHANH, MA_PGD_MAP

)
from utils import fmt_so, hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang


def _md5_bytes(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest()


def _md5_file(path: str) -> str:
    try:
        return hashlib.md5(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    except Exception:
        return ""


# Báº£ng alias tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹: tÃªn trong file Excel â†’ tÃªn ná»™i bá»™ há»‡ thá»‘ng  
# DÃ¹ng Ä‘á»ƒ so sÃ¡nh "upload nháº§m Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹" khÃ´ng bá»‹ lá»—i do tÃªn khÃ¡c nhau
# "PGD BiÃªn HÃ²a" lÃ  alias â€” trong HSTD tÃªn thá»±c lÃ  "Há»™i sá»Ÿ Chi nhÃ¡nh tá»‰nh"
_TEN_DV_ALIAS: dict[str, str] = {
    "Há»™i sá»Ÿ CN Äá»“ng Nai":      DON_VI_CHI_NHANH,
    "Há»™i sá»Ÿ CN tá»‰nh":          DON_VI_CHI_NHANH,
    "CN Äá»“ng Nai":             DON_VI_CHI_NHANH,
    "PGD BiÃªn HÃ²a":            DON_VI_CHI_NHANH,
    # ThÃªm alias khÃ¡c náº¿u phÃ¡t sinh
}

def _chuan_hoa_ten(ten: str) -> str:
    """Chuáº©n hÃ³a tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ tá»« file vá» tÃªn ná»™i bá»™ (tra _TEN_DV_ALIAS, fallback giá»¯ nguyÃªn)."""
    return _TEN_DV_ALIAS.get(ten.strip(), ten.strip())


def _ten_doc_ve_don_vi_chuan(val: str) -> str | None:
    """Map tÃªn Ä‘á»c tá»« file â†’ Ä‘Ãºng má»™t pháº§n tá»­ trong DS_DON_VI (Ä‘á»ƒ `in DS_DON_VI` khi quÃ©t thÆ° má»¥c)."""
    if not val or str(val).strip().lower() in ("nan", "none", ""):
        return None
    t = _chuan_hoa_ten(str(val).strip())
    if t in DS_DON_VI:
        return t
    tl = t.lower()
    for ten_dv in DS_DON_VI:
        if ten_dv.lower() in tl:
            return ten_dv
    return None


# â”€â”€ Danh sÃ¡ch 22 Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
DS_DON_VI: list[str] = [DON_VI_CHI_NHANH] + DS_PGD


# â”€â”€ Äá»c tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ tá»« file upload (kiá»ƒm tra trÆ°á»›c khi lÆ°u) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _lay_ten_don_vi_trong_file(file_bytes: bytes, loai: str) -> str | None:
    """
    Äá»c tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ tá»« file Excel theo tá»«ng loáº¡i.
    Tráº£ vá» tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ (str) hoáº·c None náº¿u khÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c.

    HSTD/GQVL : header=4, cá»™t "TÃªn PGD" (sheet BCQUERY / Sheet1)
    NQ11       : header=4, cá»™t "MÃ£ PGD" â†’ tra MA_PGD_MAP
    CDTOTKVV   : header=7, dropna("MÃ£ Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹"), cá»™t "TÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹"
    """
    try:
        buf = BytesIO(file_bytes)
        if loai == "hstd":
            df = pd.read_excel(buf, sheet_name="BCQUERY", header=4, nrows=5)
            df = df.iloc[:, 1:]
            cot = next((c for c in df.columns if "tÃªn pgd" in str(c).lower()), None)
            if cot is None:
                return None
            vals = df[cot].dropna().astype(str).unique()
            return str(vals[0]).strip() if len(vals) > 0 else None

        elif loai == "nq11":
            df = pd.read_excel(buf, sheet_name="BCQUERY", header=4, nrows=5)
            df = df.iloc[:, 1:]
            cot = next((c for c in df.columns if "mÃ£ pgd" in str(c).lower()), None)
            if cot is None:
                return None
            ma_pgd = str(df[cot].dropna().iloc[0]).strip().zfill(6) if not df[cot].dropna().empty else None
            if ma_pgd is None:
                return None
            return MA_PGD_MAP.get(ma_pgd)

        elif loai == "gqvl":
            df = pd.read_excel(buf, sheet_name="Sheet1", header=4, nrows=5)
            df = df.iloc[:, 1:]
            cot = next((c for c in df.columns if "tÃªn pgd" in str(c).lower()), None)
            if cot is None:
                return None
            vals = df[cot].dropna().astype(str).unique()
            return str(vals[0]).strip() if len(vals) > 0 else None

        elif loai == "cdtotkvv":
            df = pd.read_excel(buf, header=7, nrows=10)
            # TÃ¬m cá»™t "MÃ£ Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹"
            cot_ma = next((c for c in df.columns if "mÃ£ Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹" in str(c).lower()), None)
            cot_ten = next((c for c in df.columns if "tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹" in str(c).lower()), None)
            if cot_ten is None:
                return None
            if cot_ma is not None:
                df = df.dropna(subset=[cot_ma])
            vals = df[cot_ten].dropna().astype(str).unique()
            return str(vals[0]).strip() if len(vals) > 0 else None

    except Exception:
        return None


def _kiem_tra_don_vi(file_bytes: bytes, loai: str, ten_dv_chon: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    Kiá»ƒm tra tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ trong file cÃ³ khá»›p vá»›i Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ Ä‘ang chá»n khÃ´ng.
    Tráº£ vá» (khop: bool, thong_bao: str).
    """
    ten_trong_file = _lay_ten_don_vi_trong_file(file_bytes, loai)
    if ten_trong_file is None:
        # KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c tÃªn â†’ cho phÃ©p qua (cáº£nh bÃ¡o nháº¹)
        return True, "âš ï¸ KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ tá»« file â€” tiáº¿p tá»¥c lÆ°u."
    if _chuan_hoa_ten(ten_trong_file) == _chuan_hoa_ten(ten_dv_chon):
        return True, f"âœ… ÄÆ¡n vá»‹ khá»›p: **{_chuan_hoa_ten(ten_trong_file)}**"
    return False, (
        f"âš ï¸ Upload nháº§m Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹! File chá»©a: **{ten_trong_file}** | Äang chá»n: **{ten_dv_chon}**"
    )

def _hien_thi_bang_trang_thai() -> None:
    """Báº£ng tráº¡ng thÃ¡i 22 hÃ ng Ã— 5 cá»™t: ÄÆ¡n vá»‹ | HSTD | NQ11 | GQVL | CDTOTKVV."""

    )

    # TÃ´ mÃ u badge theo tiá»n tá»‘: âœ… xanh | âš ï¸ vÃ ng | âŒ Ä‘á»
    def style_trang_thai(val: str) -> str:
        v = str(val)
        if v.startswith("âœ…"):
            return "background-color: #d4edda; color: #155724; font-weight: bold"
        if v.startswith("âš ï¸"):
            return "background-color: #fff3cd; color: #856404"
        if v.startswith("âŒ"):
            return "background-color: #f8d7da; color: #721c24"
        return ""

    cols_loai = ["HSTD", "NQ11", "GQVL", "CDTOTKVV"]
    styled = df_tt.style.map(style_trang_thai, subset=cols_loai)
    hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang(styled, key="upload_khnv_trang_thai", height=800)

    with c3:

def _xu_ly_upload(
    ten_dv: str,
    username: str,
    f_hstd, f_nq11, f_gqvl, f_cdtotkvv,
    prefix: str,
) -> None:
    """Xá»­ lÃ½ upload, kiá»ƒm tra Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹, lÆ°u file vÃ  merge toÃ n CN."""
    danh_sach_file = [
        ("hstd",     f_hstd,     "ðŸ“Š HSTD"),
        ("nq11",     f_nq11,     "ðŸ“‘ NQ11"),
        ("gqvl",     f_gqvl,     "ðŸ“‹ GQVL"),
        ("cdtotkvv", f_cdtotkvv, "ðŸ† CDTOTKVV"),
    ]

    ket_qua_upload: dict[str, KetQuaUpload] = {}
    can_merge = False

    for loai, f_obj, ten_hien in danh_sach_file:
        if f_obj is None:
            continue

        file_bytes = f_obj.read()

        # Kiá»ƒm tra cÆ¡ báº£n
        ok_kt, msg_kt = kiem_tra_file(f_obj.name, file_bytes)
        if not ok_kt:
            ket_qua_upload[loai] = KetQuaUpload(False, msg_kt)
            continue

        # Kiá»ƒm tra tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ trong file
        khop, msg_khop = _kiem_tra_don_vi(file_bytes, loai, ten_dv)
        if not khop:
            ket_qua_upload[loai] = KetQuaUpload(False, msg_khop)
            continue

        # Kiá»ƒm tra cháº¥t lÆ°á»£ng dá»¯ liá»‡u táº­p trung
        _, _msg_dq, bao_cao_dq = danh_gia_chat_luong_file_upload(loai, file_bytes)
        # DQ chá»‰ cáº£nh bÃ¡o, khÃ´ng cháº·n upload

        # LÆ°u file (khÃ´ng tá»± Ä‘á»™ng merge á»Ÿ Ä‘Ã¢y, merge sau khi táº¥t cáº£ xong)
        from data.pgd import luu_file_pgd as _luu_pgd
        try:
            mb = len(file_bytes) / 1024 / 1024
            if loai == "cdtotkvv":
                from data.cdtotkvv import doc_thang_nam_tu_file
                from data.pgd import luu_file_pgd_voi_lich_su

                thang_tu_file = doc_thang_nam_tu_file(file_bytes)
                if thang_tu_file:
                    # Tá»± Ä‘á»™ng nháº­n diá»‡n Ä‘Æ°á»£c thÃ¡ng -> lÆ°u cÃ³ lá»‹ch sá»­
                    path = luu_file_pgd_voi_lich_su(
                        ten_dv, loai, file_bytes, thang_tu_file
                    )
                    ket_qua_upload[loai] = KetQuaUpload(
                        True,
                        f"âœ… {ten_hien} ({mb:.1f} MB) "
                        f"Â· ThÃ¡ng {thang_tu_file} Â· DQ {bao_cao_dq.get('ti_le_dat_chuan', 0)}%",
                        path,
                    )
                else:
                    # KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c thÃ¡ng -> fallback lÆ°u latest bÃ¬nh thÆ°á»ng
                    path = _luu_pgd(ten_dv, loai, file_bytes)
                    ket_qua_upload[loai] = KetQuaUpload(
                        True,
                        f"âœ… {ten_hien} ({mb:.1f} MB) "
                        f"Â· âš ï¸ KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c thÃ¡ng tá»« file Â· DQ {bao_cao_dq.get('ti_le_dat_chuan', 0)}%",
                        path,
                    )
                db.ghi_audit(
                    username, "upload_pgd_khnv",
                    f"CDTOTKVV â€” {ten_dv} "
                    f"thÃ¡ng={thang_tu_file or 'unknown'} ({mb:.1f} MB)"
                )
            else:
                path = _luu_pgd(ten_dv, loai, file_bytes)
                db.ghi_audit(username, "upload_pgd_khnv",
                             f"{loai.upper()} â€” {ten_dv} ({mb:.1f} MB)")
                ket_qua_upload[loai] = KetQuaUpload(
                    True,
                    f"âœ… {ten_hien} ({mb:.1f} MB) Â· DQ {bao_cao_dq.get('ti_le_dat_chuan', 0)}%",
                    path,
                )
                if loai in ("hstd", "nq11", "gqvl"):
                    can_merge = True
        except Exception as e:
            ket_qua_upload[loai] = KetQuaUpload(False, f"Lá»—i lÆ°u: {e}")

    # Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ káº¿t quáº£ tá»«ng file trÆ°á»›c rerun (sáº½ máº¥t sau rerun)
    cols = st.columns(4)
    loai_list = ["hstd", "nq11", "gqvl", "cdtotkvv"]
    nhan_list  = ["ðŸ“Š HSTD", "ðŸ“‘ NQ11", "ðŸ“‹ GQVL", "ðŸ† CDTOTKVV"]
    for col, loai, nhan in zip(cols, loai_list, nhan_list):
        kq = ket_qua_upload.get(loai)
        if kq is None:
            col.info(f"**{nhan}**\n\nKhÃ´ng cÃ³ file")
        elif kq.thanh_cong:
            col.success(f"**{nhan}**\n\n{kq.thong_bao}")
        else:
            col.warning(f"**{nhan}**\n\n{kq.thong_bao}")

    # Ghi cá» cho fragment merge xá»­ lÃ½ sau (khÃ´ng merge Ä‘á»“ng bá»™ á»Ÿ Ä‘Ã¢y)
    if can_merge:
        for loai in ("hstd", "nq11", "gqvl"):
            if loai in ket_qua_upload and ket_qua_upload[loai].thanh_cong:
                st.session_state[f"can_merge_{loai}"] = True
        st.info("âœ… File Ä‘Ã£ lÆ°u. Nháº¥n nÃºt bÃªn dÆ°á»›i Ä‘á»ƒ cáº­p nháº­t dá»¯ liá»‡u.")

    st.cache_data.clear()
    # LÆ°u káº¿t quáº£ vÃ o session Ä‘á»ƒ render sau rerun
    st.session_state["khnv_ket_qua_upload"] = {
        k: {"thanh_cong": v.thanh_cong, "thong_bao": v.thong_bao}
        for k, v in ket_qua_upload.items()
    }
    st.rerun()


# â”€â”€ Nháº­n diá»‡n PGD tá»« ná»™i dung file (import hÃ ng loáº¡t) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€


def _nhan_dien_loai_tu_noi_dung(data: bytes) -> str | None:
    """
    Nháº­n diá»‡n loáº¡i file tá»« ná»™i dung â€” khÃ´ng phá»¥ thuá»™c tÃªn file.
      HSTD     : sheet BCQUERY, header row 5 cÃ³ cá»™t 'TÃªn PGD'
      NQ11     : sheet BCQUERY, header row 5 khÃ´ng cÃ³ 'TÃªn PGD', cÃ³ 'MÃ£ ÄVUT'
      GQVL     : khÃ´ng cÃ³ BCQUERY, cÃ³ Sheet1
      CDTOTKVV : khÃ´ng cÃ³ BCQUERY, khÃ´ng cÃ³ Sheet1,
                 row 10 cÃ³ cá»™t 'stt' + 'ma_dv' + 'tong_diem'
    """
    try:
        xl = pd.ExcelFile(BytesIO(data))
        sheets_upper = [s.upper() for s in xl.sheet_names]

        # â”€â”€ HSTD hoáº·c NQ11 â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        if "BCQUERY" in sheets_upper:
            real = xl.sheet_names[sheets_upper.index("BCQUERY")]
            df = pd.read_excel(
                BytesIO(data), sheet_name=real, header=4, nrows=1
            )
            cols = [str(c).strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
            if any("tÃªn pgd" in c for c in cols):
                return "hstd"
            if any(
                "mÃ£ Ä‘vut" in c or "mÃ£ dvut" in c or "táº¿n Ä‘vut" in c for c in cols
            ):
                return "nq11"
            # Fallback: BCQUERY nhÆ°ng khÃ´ng rÃµ â†’ coi lÃ  NQ11
            return "nq11"

        # â”€â”€ GQVL â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        if "SHEET1" in sheets_upper:
            return "gqvl"

        # â”€â”€ CDTOTKVV â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        df2 = pd.read_excel(BytesIO(data), header=None, skiprows=9, nrows=2)
        if not df2.empty:
            vals = [
                str(v).strip().lower()
                for v in df2.iloc[0].tolist()
                if pd.notna(v)
            ]
            if any("stt" in v for v in vals) and any(
                "ma_dv" in v or "mÃ£" in v for v in vals
            ):
                return "cdtotkvv"

    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


def _tim_ten_pgd_tu_noi_dung(file_bytes: bytes, loai: str) -> str | None:
    """
    Äá»c tá»‘i thiá»ƒu ná»™i dung file Ä‘á»ƒ nháº­n diá»‡n tÃªn PGD (quÃ©t thÆ° má»¥c / import hÃ ng loáº¡t).

    HSTD/NQ11: sheet BCQUERY, header á»Ÿ dÃ²ng 5 (pandas header=4), 1 dÃ²ng dá»¯ liá»‡u, cá»™t "TÃªn PGD".
    GQVL: Sheet1, header=7 (khá»›p data/hstd.doc_file_gqvl).
    CDTOTKVV: quÃ©t tá»‘i Ä‘a 15 dÃ²ng Ä‘áº§u (layout khÃ´ng cá»‘ Ä‘á»‹nh).
    """
    buf = BytesIO(file_bytes)
    try:
        if loai in ("hstd", "nq11"):
            df = None
            try:
                df = pd.read_excel(
                    buf,
                    sheet_name="BCQUERY",
                    header=4,
                    nrows=1,
                    usecols=["TÃªn PGD"],
                )
            except (ValueError, KeyError):
                buf.seek(0)
                df_wide = pd.read_excel(
                    buf, sheet_name="BCQUERY", header=4, nrows=5
                ).iloc[:, 1:]
                cot = next(
                    (c for c in df_wide.columns if "tÃªn pgd" in str(c).lower()),
                    None,
                )
                if cot is not None:
                    df = df_wide[[cot]].head(1)

            if df is not None and not df.empty:
                col = df.columns[0]
                raw = str(df[col].iloc[0]).strip()
                hit = _ten_doc_ve_don_vi_chuan(raw)
                if hit:
                    return hit

            if loai == "nq11":
                buf.seek(0)
                df_m = pd.read_excel(
                    buf, sheet_name="BCQUERY", header=4, nrows=5
                ).iloc[:, 1:]
                cot_ma = next(
                    (c for c in df_m.columns if "mÃ£ pgd" in str(c).lower()),
                    None,
                )
                if cot_ma is not None and not df_m[cot_ma].dropna().empty:
                    ma_pgd = str(df_m[cot_ma].dropna().iloc[0]).strip().zfill(6)
                    ten_ma = MA_PGD_MAP.get(ma_pgd)
                    if ten_ma and ten_ma in DS_DON_VI:
                        return ten_ma
            return None

        if loai == "gqvl":
            df = pd.read_excel(buf, sheet_name="Sheet1", header=7, nrows=1)
            if df.empty:
                return None
            for col in df.columns:
                hit = _ten_doc_ve_don_vi_chuan(str(df[col].iloc[0]).strip())
                if hit:
                    return hit
            return None

        if loai == "cdtotkvv":
            df = pd.read_excel(buf, header=None, nrows=15)
            for _, row in df.iterrows():
                for cell in row:
                    if cell is None or (isinstance(cell, float) and pd.isna(cell)):
                        continue
                    hit = _ten_doc_ve_don_vi_chuan(str(cell).strip())
                    if hit:
                        return hit
            return None

    except Exception:
        return None
    return None


def _folder_scan_trang_thai_row(r: dict) -> str:
    """Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i hiá»ƒn thá»‹ cho má»™t dÃ²ng quÃ©t thÆ° má»¥c (tÆ°Æ¡ng thÃ­ch session cÅ© thiáº¿u key)."""
    if r.get("trang_thai"):
        return str(r["trang_thai"])
    ten_p = r["ten_pgd"]
    if r["nhan_dien"] and ten_p not in (
        "â“ KhÃ´ng nháº­n diá»‡n Ä‘Æ°á»£c",
        "â“ Lá»—i Ä‘á»c file",
    ):
        return "ðŸ”„ Cáº­p nháº­t" if kiem_tra_file_ton_tai_pgd(ten_p, r["loai"]) else "ðŸ†• Má»›i"
    return "â“ KhÃ´ng nháº­n diá»‡n Ä‘Æ°á»£c"


def _xu_ly_import_folder(danh_sach: list[dict], username: str) -> None:
    """Import song song theo 3 bÆ°á»›c: Ä‘á»c file, ghi file, rá»“i merge 1 láº§n/loáº¡i."""
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
    from data.pgd import luu_file_pgd as _ghi_file_pgd

    danh_sach_import = [r for r in danh_sach if r.get("co_the_import", False)]

    if not danh_sach_import:
        st.info("âœ… KhÃ´ng cÃ³ file nÃ o cáº§n import")
        return

    thanh_cong: list[dict] = []
    that_bai: list[str] = []
    loai_da_luu: set[str] = set()

    def _doc_file(r: dict) -> tuple[dict, bytes | None, str | None]:
        try:
            return r, Path(r["path"]).read_bytes(), None
        except Exception as e:
            return r, None, str(e)

    progress = st.progress(0.0, text="â³ Äang Ä‘á»c file...")
    tat_ca_bytes: list[tuple[dict, bytes]] = []

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as ex:
        futures = {ex.submit(_doc_file, r): r for r in danh_sach_import}
        for i, future in enumerate(as_completed(futures)):
            r, data, err = future.result()
            if err:
                that_bai.append(f"{r['ten_file']}: {err}")
            elif data is not None:
                tat_ca_bytes.append((r, data))
            progress.progress(
                ((i + 1) / len(danh_sach_import)) * 0.4,
                text=f"â³ Äá»c file {i + 1}/{len(danh_sach_import)}...",
            )

    def _ghi(r: dict, data: bytes) -> tuple[dict, str | None]:
        try:
            if r["loai"] == "cdtotkvv":
                from data.cdtotkvv import doc_thang_nam_tu_file
                from data.pgd import luu_file_pgd_voi_lich_su

                thang = doc_thang_nam_tu_file(data)
                if thang:
                    _ghi_file_pgd(r["ten_pgd"], r["loai"], data)
                    luu_file_pgd_voi_lich_su(
                        r["ten_pgd"], r["loai"], data, thang
                    )
                    db.ghi_audit(
                        username,
                        "folder_import_file",
                        f"CDTOTKVV â€” {r['ten_pgd']} "
                        f"thÃ¡ng={thang} ({r['ten_file']})",
                    )
                else:
                    # KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c thÃ¡ng â†’ lÆ°u latest, cáº£nh bÃ¡o
                    _ghi_file_pgd(r["ten_pgd"], r["loai"], data)
                    db.ghi_audit(
                        username,
                        "folder_import_file",
                        f"CDTOTKVV â€” {r['ten_pgd']} "
                        f"thÃ¡ng=unknown ({r['ten_file']})",
                    )
                    # Ghi chÃº vÃ o row Ä‘á»ƒ hiá»ƒn thá»‹ cáº£nh bÃ¡o sau
                    r["canh_bao"] = "âš ï¸ KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c thÃ¡ng â€” chá»‰ lÆ°u latest"
            else:
                _ghi_file_pgd(r["ten_pgd"], r["loai"], data)
                db.ghi_audit(
                    username,
                    "folder_import_file",
                    f"{r['loai'].upper()} â€” {r['ten_pgd']} ({r['ten_file']})",
                )
            return r, None
        except Exception as e:
            return r, str(e)

    if tat_ca_bytes:
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as ex:
            futures = {ex.submit(_ghi, r, data): r for r, data in tat_ca_bytes}
            for i, future in enumerate(as_completed(futures)):
                r, err = future.result()
                if err:
                    that_bai.append(f"{r['ten_file']}: {err}")
                else:
                    thanh_cong.append(r)
                    loai_da_luu.add(r["loai"])
                progress.progress(
                    0.4 + ((i + 1) / len(tat_ca_bytes)) * 0.4,
                    text=f"ðŸ’¾ LÆ°u file {i + 1}/{len(tat_ca_bytes)}...",
                )

    loai_can_merge = sorted(loai_da_luu & {"hstd", "nq11", "gqvl"})
    ket_qua_merge: list[dict] = []
    for j, loai in enumerate(loai_can_merge):
        progress.progress(
            0.8 + ((j + 1) / max(len(loai_can_merge), 1)) * 0.2,
            text=f"ðŸ”„ Tá»•ng há»£p {loai.upper()} toÃ n Chi nhÃ¡nh...",
        )
        kq_m = merge_du_lieu_toan_cn(loai)
        meta_m = lay_meta_merge(loai) if kq_m.thanh_cong else None
        ket_qua_merge.append(
            {
                "loai": loai,
                "thanh_cong": kq_m.thanh_cong,
                "thong_bao": kq_m.thong_bao,
                "so_pgd": (meta_m or {}).get("so_pgd"),
                "so_dong": (meta_m or {}).get("so_dong"),
            }
        )

    progress.empty()
    st.cache_data.clear()

    # Force refresh báº£ng tráº¡ng thÃ¡i upload sau khi import
    from data.pgd import lay_trang_thai_upload_pgd as _lay_tt_upload
    from config import DS_PGD as _DS_PGD, DON_VI_CHI_NHANH as _DON_VI_CN

    ds_don_vi = [_DON_VI_CN] + _DS_PGD
    st.session_state["trang_thai_upload_pgd"] = _lay_tt_upload(ds_don_vi)

    db.ghi_audit(
        username,

    st.session_state.pop("folder_scan_meta", None)

def _render_upload_hang_loat(role: str, username: str) -> None:
    """Upload hÃ ng loáº¡t qua trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t â€” thay tháº¿ quÃ©t thÆ° má»¥c server."""
    _ = role

    with st.expander("ðŸ“¦ Import hÃ ng loáº¡t", expanded=True):

        # â”€â”€ HÆ°á»›ng dáº«n â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        st.info(
            "**CÃ¡ch chá»n nhiá»u file:**  \n"
            "â€¢ Windows: giá»¯ **Ctrl** rá»“i click tá»«ng file, hoáº·c **Ctrl+A** "
            "Ä‘á»ƒ chá»n táº¥t cáº£ trong thÆ° má»¥c  \n"
            "â€¢ Mac: giá»¯ **âŒ˜ Cmd** rá»“i click tá»«ng file  \n"
            "â€¢ Há»— trá»£ tá»‘i Ä‘a 66 file (22 PGD Ã— HSTD + NQ11 + GQVL)"
        )

        # â”€â”€ Multi-file uploader â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        uploaded = st.file_uploader(
            "Chá»n file",
            type=["xlsx", "xls"],
            accept_multiple_files=True,
            key="khnv_bulk_upload",
            label_visibility="collapsed",
        )

        if not uploaded:
            st.caption("ChÆ°a cÃ³ file nÃ o Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»n.")
            return

        # â”€â”€ Fallback: prefix tÃªn file khi khÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c loáº¡i tá»« ná»™i dung â”€â”€
        PREFIX_MAP = {
            "hstd":     ("HSTD", "CT_CDTO"),
            "nq11":     ("NQ11", "SAO_KE_CT"),
            "gqvl":     ("GQVL", "SK_GQVL", "SAO_KE_GQVL"),
            "cdtotkvv": ("CDTOTKVV", "CT_CDTOTKVV"),
        }

        def _nhan_dien_loai_ten_file(ten_file: str) -> str | None:
            upper = ten_file.upper()
            for loai, prefixes in PREFIX_MAP.items():
                if any(upper.startswith(p.upper()) for p in prefixes):
                    return loai
            return None

        # â”€â”€ XÃ¢y dá»±ng danh sÃ¡ch rows Ä‘á»ƒ preview â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        cache_key = "khnv_bulk_bytes"
        file_names_now = [f.name for f in uploaded]
        if st.session_state.get("khnv_bulk_names") != file_names_now:
            st.session_state["khnv_bulk_names"] = file_names_now
            st.session_state[cache_key] = {f.name: f.read() for f in uploaded}

        bytes_map: dict[str, bytes] = st.session_state.get(cache_key, {})

        rows: list[dict] = []
        seen: dict[str, int] = {}

        with st.spinner("ðŸ” Äang nháº­n diá»‡n file..."):
            for ten_file, data in bytes_map.items():
                loai = _nhan_dien_loai_tu_noi_dung(data)
                if loai is None:
                    loai = _nhan_dien_loai_ten_file(ten_file)
                if loai is None:
                    rows.append({
                        "ten_file": ten_file, "loai": "â“",
                        "ten_pgd": "â€”", "nhan_dien": False,
                        "trang_thai": "â“ KhÃ´ng rÃµ loáº¡i",
                        "co_the_import": False, "data": data,
                    })
                    continue

                ten_pgd = _tim_ten_pgd_tu_noi_dung(data, loai)
                if ten_pgd:
                    ten_pgd = _chuan_hoa_ten(ten_pgd)
                if ten_pgd is None or ten_pgd not in DS_DON_VI:
                    rows.append({
                        "ten_file": ten_file, "loai": loai.upper(),
                        "ten_pgd": "â“ KhÃ´ng nháº­n diá»‡n Ä‘Æ°á»£c",
                        "nhan_dien": False,
                        "trang_thai": "â“ KhÃ´ng rÃµ PGD",
                        "co_the_import": False, "data": data,
                    })
                    continue

                dk = f"{ten_pgd}|{loai}"
                if dk in seen:
                    rows[seen[dk]]["trang_thai"] = "âš ï¸ TrÃ¹ng â€” bá» qua (giá»¯ file sau)"
                    rows[seen[dk]]["co_the_import"] = False
                    trang_thai = "âš ï¸ TrÃ¹ng â€” sáº½ import (file nÃ y)"
                else:
                    trang_thai = "âœ… Sáºµn sÃ ng"

                co_the_import = trang_thai in (
                    "âœ… Sáºµn sÃ ng",
                    "âš ï¸ TrÃ¹ng â€” sáº½ import (file nÃ y)",
                )

                path_ht = duong_dan_pgd(ten_pgd, loai.lower())
                if not os.path.exists(path_ht):
                    so_sanh = "ðŸ†• ChÆ°a cÃ³"
                    md5_co_the_import = True
                elif _md5_bytes(data) != _md5_file(path_ht):
                    so_sanh = "ðŸ”„ CÃ³ thay Ä‘á»•i"
                    md5_co_the_import = True
                else:
                    so_sanh = "âœ… Giá»‘ng há»‡t"
                    md5_co_the_import = False

                co_the_import = co_the_import and md5_co_the_import

                idx = len(rows)
                seen[dk] = idx
                rows.append({
                    "ten_file": ten_file, "loai": loai.upper(),
                    "ten_pgd": ten_pgd, "nhan_dien": True,
                    "trang_thai": trang_thai,
                    "co_the_import": co_the_import,
                    "so_sanh": so_sanh,
                    "data": data,
                })

        def _style_preview(val: str) -> str:
            if val.startswith("âœ…"):
                return "background-color:#d4edda;color:#155724;font-weight:bold"
            if val.startswith("âš ï¸"):
                return "background-color:#fff3cd;color:#856404"
            if val.startswith("â“"):
                return "background-color:#f8d7da;color:#721c24"
            return ""

        def _style_so_sanh(val: str) -> str:
            if val.startswith("ðŸ†•"):
                return "background-color:#d4edda;color:#155724;font-weight:bold"
            if val.startswith("ðŸ”„"):
                return "background-color:#fff3cd;color:#856404;font-weight:bold"
            if val.startswith("âœ…"):
                return "background-color:#e9ecef;color:#495057"
            return ""

        df_preview = pd.DataFrame([
            {
                "Loáº¡i": r["loai"],
                "TÃªn file": r["ten_file"],
                "PGD": r["ten_pgd"],
                "So sÃ¡nh": r.get("so_sanh", "â€”"),
                "Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i": r["trang_thai"],
            }
            for r in rows
        ])
        styled = df_preview.style.map(_style_preview, subset=["Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i"]).map(
            _style_so_sanh, subset=["So sÃ¡nh"]
        )
        st.dataframe(
            styled,
            use_container_width=True, hide_index=True,
        )

        co_the_import = [r for r in rows if r["co_the_import"]]
        khong_nhan_dien = [r for r in rows if not r["nhan_dien"]]
        trung = [r for r in rows
                 if "TrÃ¹ng" in r["trang_thai"] and not r["co_the_import"]]
        bo_qua = [r for r in rows if not r["co_the_import"] and r["nhan_dien"]]
        st.caption(
            f"ðŸ“Š Tá»•ng **{len(rows)}** file Â· "
            f"âœ… Sáºµn sÃ ng **{len(co_the_import)}** Â· "
            f"â© Bá» qua **{len(bo_qua)}** (giá»‘ng há»‡t) Â· "
            f"â“ KhÃ´ng nháº­n diá»‡n **{len(khong_nhan_dien)}** Â· "
            f"âš ï¸ TrÃ¹ng bá» qua **{len(trung)}**"
        )

        if not co_the_import:
            st.warning("âš ï¸ KhÃ´ng cÃ³ file nÃ o há»£p lá»‡ Ä‘á»ƒ import.")
            return

        if st.button(
            f"ðŸ“¥ Import {len(co_the_import)} file",
            type="primary",
            key="btn_bulk_import",
        ):
            import tempfile

            danh_sach_for_import: list[dict] = []
            tmp_files: list[str] = []
            try:
                for r in co_the_import:
                    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
                        delete=False, suffix=".xlsx"
                    )
                    tmp.write(r["data"])
                    tmp.close()
                    tmp_files.append(tmp.name)
                    danh_sach_for_import.append({
                        "path": tmp.name,
                        "ten_file": r["ten_file"],
                        "ten_pgd": r["ten_pgd"],
                        "loai": r["loai"].lower(),
                        "phuong_phap": "ná»™i dung",
                        "nhan_dien": True,
                        "co_the_import": True,
                    })
                _xu_ly_import_folder(danh_sach_for_import, username)
            finally:
                for p in tmp_files:
                    try:
                        os.unlink(p)
                    except Exception:
                        pass


# â”€â”€ XÃ³a dá»¯ liá»‡u PGD â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _xoa_du_lieu_pgd(ten_pgd: str, loai: str, username: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    XÃ³a file gá»‘c + cache parquet cá»§a 1 PGD cho 1 loáº¡i dá»¯ liá»‡u.
    Tráº£ vá» (thanh_cong: bool, thong_bao: str).
    """
    import socket
    hostname = socket.gethostname()
    path_excel   = Path(duong_dan_pgd(ten_pgd, loai))
    path_parquet = path_excel.with_suffix(".parquet")

    if not path_excel.exists():
        return False, f"KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y file {loai.upper()} cá»§a {ten_pgd}"

    try:
        path_excel.unlink()
        if path_parquet.exists():
            path_parquet.unlink()
        db.ghi_audit(username, "xoa_du_lieu_pgd",
                     f"[{hostname}] {loai.upper()} â€” {ten_pgd}")
        return True, f"âœ… ÄÃ£ xÃ³a {loai.upper()} â€” {ten_pgd}"
    except Exception as e:
        db.ghi_audit(username, "loi_xoa_du_lieu_pgd",
                     f"[{hostname}] {loai.upper()} â€” {ten_pgd}: {e}")
        return False, f"âŒ Lá»—i xÃ³a: {e}"


def _thuc_hien_xoa(
    ds_don_vi: list[str],
    loai_xoa: list[str],
    username: str,
) -> None:
    """Thá»±c hiá»‡n xÃ³a, hiá»ƒn thá»‹ káº¿t quáº£, rebuild CACHE, clear cache."""
    ket_qua = []
    can_merge_loai: set[str] = set()

    with st.spinner("ðŸ—‘ï¸ Äang xÃ³a dá»¯ liá»‡u..."):
        for ten_pgd in ds_don_vi:
            for loai in loai_xoa:
                ok, msg = _xoa_du_lieu_pgd(ten_pgd, loai, username)
                ket_qua.append((ten_pgd, loai, ok, msg))
                if ok and loai in ("hstd", "nq11", "gqvl"):
                    can_merge_loai.add(loai)

    so_thanh_cong = sum(1 for _, _, ok, _ in ket_qua if ok)
    so_loi = len(ket_qua) - so_thanh_cong

    if so_thanh_cong:
        st.success(
            f"âœ… ÄÃ£ xÃ³a **{so_thanh_cong}** file thÃ nh cÃ´ng"
            + (f" Â· âš ï¸ {so_loi} lá»—i" if so_loi else "")
        )
    for _, _, ok, msg in ket_qua:
        if not ok:
            st.warning(msg)

    # Rebuild CACHE cho cÃ¡c loáº¡i Ä‘Ã£ xÃ³a
    if can_merge_loai:
        st.divider()
        for loai in sorted(can_merge_loai):
            with st.spinner(f"ðŸ”„ Äang rebuild CACHE {loai.upper()}..."):
                try:
                    kq_merge = merge_du_lieu_toan_cn(loai)
                    if kq_merge.thanh_cong:
                        meta = lay_meta_merge(loai)
                        so_pgd  = (meta or {}).get("so_pgd", "?")
                        so_dong = (meta or {}).get("so_dong", 0)
                        st.success(
                            f"âœ… Rebuild **{loai.upper()}** â€” "
                            f"**{so_pgd}** Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ Â· **{fmt_so(so_dong)}** dÃ²ng"
                        )
                    else:
                        st.warning(f"âš ï¸ Rebuild {loai.upper()}: {kq_merge.thong_bao}")
                except Exception as e:
                    st.error(f"âŒ Lá»—i rebuild {loai.upper()}: {e}")

    st.cache_data.clear()
    # LÃ m má»›i báº£ng tráº¡ng thÃ¡i
    st.session_state.pop("trang_thai_upload_pgd", None)
    st.rerun()

            "**ðŸ“– HÆ°á»›ng dáº«n Äiá»‡n bÃ¡o**. "
            "Upload file Äiá»‡n bÃ¡o thá»±c hiá»‡n táº¡i tab **ðŸ“¡ Äiá»‡n BÃ¡o** (má»¥c *Upload file Äiá»‡n bÃ¡o*), "

        _render_upload_hang_loat(role, username)

        with st.expander("ðŸ”„ Tá»•ng há»£p toÃ n Chi nhÃ¡nh thá»§ cÃ´ng",

"""

# â”€â”€ Danh sÃ¡ch 22 Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
DS_DON_VI: list[str] = [DON_VI_CHI_NHANH] + DS_PGD

# NhÃ£n ngáº¯n cho thÃ´ng bÃ¡o sau upload (khÃ´ng kÃ¨m icon cá»™t)
NHAN_LOAI: dict[str, str] = {
    "hstd": "HSTD",

# â”€â”€ Äá»c tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ tá»« file upload â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _lay_ten_don_vi_trong_file(file_bytes: bytes, loai: str) -> str | None:
    """
    Äá»c tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ tá»« file Excel theo tá»«ng loáº¡i.

    HSTD/GQVL : header=4, cá»™t "TÃªn PGD"
    NQ11       : header=4, cá»™t "MÃ£ PGD" â†’ tra MA_PGD_MAP
    CDTOTKVV   : header=7, dropna("MÃ£ Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹"), cá»™t "TÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹"
    """
    try:
        buf = BytesIO(file_bytes)
        if loai == "hstd":
            df = pd.read_excel(buf, sheet_name="BCQUERY", header=4, nrows=5)
            df = df.iloc[:, 1:]
            cot = next((c for c in df.columns if "tÃªn pgd" in str(c).lower()), None)
            if cot is None:
                return None
            vals = df[cot].dropna().astype(str).unique()
            return str(vals[0]).strip() if len(vals) > 0 else None

        elif loai == "nq11":
            df = pd.read_excel(buf, sheet_name="BCQUERY", header=4, nrows=5)
            df = df.iloc[:, 1:]
            cot = next((c for c in df.columns if "mÃ£ pgd" in str(c).lower()), None)
            if cot is None:
                return None
            ma_pgd = str(df[cot].dropna().iloc[0]).strip().zfill(6) if not df[cot].dropna().empty else None
            if ma_pgd is None:
                return None
            return MA_PGD_MAP.get(ma_pgd)

        elif loai == "gqvl":
            # GQVL dÃ¹ng sheet="Sheet1", header=7 (khÃ¡c HSTD/NQ11)
            df = pd.read_excel(buf, sheet_name="Sheet1", header=7, nrows=10)
            df = df.iloc[:, 1:].dropna(how="all")
            cot = next(
                (c for c in df.columns
                 if any(k in str(c).lower()
                        for k in ["tÃªn pgd", "ten pgd", "tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹", "Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹"])),
                None
            )
            if cot is not None:
                vals = df[cot].dropna().astype(str).unique()
                return str(vals[0]).strip() if len(vals) > 0 else None
            return None

        elif loai == "cdtotkvv":
            df = pd.read_excel(buf, header=7, nrows=10)
            cot_ma = next((c for c in df.columns if "mÃ£ Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹" in str(c).lower()), None)
            cot_ten = next((c for c in df.columns if "tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹" in str(c).lower()), None)
            if cot_ten is None:
                return None
            if cot_ma is not None:
                df = df.dropna(subset=[cot_ma])
            vals = df[cot_ten].dropna().astype(str).unique()
            return str(vals[0]).strip() if len(vals) > 0 else None

    except Exception:
        return None


def _kiem_tra_loai_file(file_bytes: bytes, loai: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    Kiá»ƒm tra file cÃ³ Ä‘Ãºng loáº¡i khai bÃ¡o khÃ´ng (HSTD/NQ11/GQVL/CDTOTKVV).
    Dá»±a vÃ o sheet name Ä‘áº·c trÆ°ng.
    Tráº£ vá» (ok, thong_bao).
    """
    try:
        import openpyxl
        wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(
            BytesIO(file_bytes), read_only=True, data_only=True
        )
        sheet_names = [s.lower() for s in wb.sheetnames]

        if loai in ("hstd", "nq11"):
            # HSTD vÃ  NQ11 báº¯t buá»™c cÃ³ sheet "bcquery"
            if "bcquery" not in sheet_names:
                return False, (
                    f"âŒ File khÃ´ng pháº£i **{loai.upper()}**! "
                    f"Thiáº¿u sheet â€˜BCQUERYâ€™. "
                    f"Sheets cÃ³ trong file: {', '.join(wb.sheetnames)}"
                )

        elif loai == "gqvl":
            # GQVL báº¯t buá»™c cÃ³ sheet "sheet1", KHÃ”NG cÃ³ sheet "bcquery"
            if "bcquery" in sheet_names:
                return False, (
                    "âŒ Báº¡n Ä‘ang upload file **HSTD/NQ11** vÃ o Ã´ **GQVL**! "
                    "Vui lÃ²ng chá»n Ä‘Ãºng file Sao kÃª GQVL."
                )
            if "sheet1" not in sheet_names:
                return False, (
                    f"âŒ File khÃ´ng pháº£i **GQVL**! "
                    f"Thiáº¿u sheet â€˜Sheet1â€™. "
                    f"Sheets cÃ³ trong file: {', '.join(wb.sheetnames)}"
                )

        elif loai == "cdtotkvv":
            # CDTOTKVV khÃ´ng cÃ³ sheet bcquery â€” chá»‰ kiá»ƒm tra KHÃ”NG pháº£i HSTD
            if "bcquery" in sheet_names:
                return False, (
                    "âŒ Báº¡n Ä‘ang upload file **HSTD/NQ11** vÃ o Ã´ **CDTOTKVV**! "
                    "Vui lÃ²ng chá»n Ä‘Ãºng file Cháº¥m Ä‘iá»ƒm Tá»• TK&VV."
                )

        return True, "OK"
    except Exception:
        # KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c â†’ fail-open, khÃ´ng cháº·n upload
        return True, "Bá» qua kiá»ƒm tra loáº¡i file."


def _kiem_tra_don_vi(file_bytes: bytes, loai: str, ten_dv_chon: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    Kiá»ƒm tra tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ trong file cÃ³ khá»›p vá»›i Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ Ä‘ang chá»n.
    Tráº£ vá» (khop: bool, thong_bao: str).
    """
    ten_trong_file = _lay_ten_don_vi_trong_file(file_bytes, loai)
    if ten_trong_file is None:
        return True, (
            f"âš ï¸ KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ tá»« file **{loai.upper()}**"
            f" â€” há»‡ thá»‘ng tin tÆ°á»Ÿng báº¡n Ä‘ang upload Ä‘Ãºng file cá»§a "
            f"**{ten_dv_chon}**."
        )
    
    # Chuáº©n hÃ³a tÃªn Ä‘á»ƒ so sÃ¡nh (loáº¡i bá» khoáº£ng tráº¯ng, chuyá»ƒn thÆ°á»ng, loáº¡i bá» kÃ½ tá»± Ä‘áº·c biá»‡t)
    def chuan_hoa_ten(ten: str) -> str:
        import re
        ten = ten.strip().lower()
        # Loáº¡i bá» cÃ¡c tá»« khÃ´ng quan trá»ng
        ten = re.sub(r'\b(pgd|phÃ²ng|giao|dá»‹ch|há»™i|sá»Ÿ|chi|nhÃ¡nh|tá»‰nh)\b', '', ten)
        # Loáº¡i bá» kÃ½ tá»± Ä‘áº·c biá»‡t vÃ  khoáº£ng tráº¯ng thá»«a
        ten = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', ' ', ten)
        ten = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', ten).strip()
        return ten
    
    ten_file_chuan = chuan_hoa_ten(ten_trong_file)
    ten_chon_chuan = chuan_hoa_ten(ten_dv_chon)
    
    # Kiá»ƒm tra khá»›p chÃ­nh xÃ¡c
    if ten_trong_file.strip() == ten_dv_chon.strip():
        return True, f"âœ… ÄÆ¡n vá»‹ khá»›p: **{ten_trong_file}**"
    
    # Kiá»ƒm tra khá»›p sau chuáº©n hÃ³a
    if ten_file_chuan == ten_chon_chuan:
        return True, f"âœ… ÄÆ¡n vá»‹ khá»›p (chuáº©n hÃ³a): **{ten_trong_file}**"
    
    # Kiá»ƒm tra chá»©a tá»« khÃ³a chÃ­nh
    if ten_file_chuan and ten_chon_chuan and len(ten_file_chuan) > 2:
        if ten_file_chuan in ten_chon_chuan or ten_chon_chuan in ten_file_chuan:
            return True, f"âœ… ÄÆ¡n vá»‹ tÆ°Æ¡ng tá»±: **{ten_trong_file}**"
    
    return False, (
        f"âš ï¸ Upload nháº§m Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹! File chá»©a: **{ten_trong_file}** | Äang chá»n: **{ten_dv_chon}**"
    )


# â”€â”€ Form upload â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _render_upload_form(ten_dv: str, prefix: str, username: str) -> None:
    """Form upload 4 file cho Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹. KhÃ´ng merge toÃ n CN (viá»‡c cá»§a KH-NV)."""
    st.markdown(f"##### ðŸ“¤ Upload file cho: **{ten_dv}**")

    c1, c2, c3, c4 = st.columns(4)
    with c1:
        st.caption("ðŸ“Š HSTD Chi tiáº¿t")
        f_hstd = st.file_uploader("HSTD", type=["xlsx", "xls"],
                                   key=f"{prefix}_hstd", label_visibility="collapsed")
    with c2:
        st.caption("ðŸ“‘ Sao kÃª NQ11")
        f_nq11 = st.file_uploader("NQ11", type=["xlsx", "xls"],
                                   key=f"{prefix}_nq11", label_visibility="collapsed")
    with c3:
        st.caption("ðŸ“‹ Sao kÃª GQVL")
        f_gqvl = st.file_uploader("GQVL", type=["xlsx", "xls"],
                                   key=f"{prefix}_gqvl", label_visibility="collapsed")
    with c4:
        st.caption("ðŸ† Cháº¥m Ä‘iá»ƒm Tá»• TK&VV")
        f_cdtotkvv = st.file_uploader("CDTOTKVV", type=["xlsx", "xls"],
                                       key=f"{prefix}_cdtotkvv", label_visibility="collapsed")

    co_file = any(f is not None for f in [f_hstd, f_nq11, f_gqvl, f_cdtotkvv])
    if not co_file:
        st.info("Chá»n Ã­t nháº¥t 1 file Ä‘á»ƒ báº¯t Ä‘áº§u upload.")
        return

    if st.button("ðŸ“¤ Upload", type="primary", key=f"{prefix}_btn_upload"):
        _xu_ly_upload(ten_dv, username,
                      f_hstd, f_nq11, f_gqvl, f_cdtotkvv)


def _xu_ly_upload(
    ten_dv: str,
    username: str,
    f_hstd, f_nq11, f_gqvl, f_cdtotkvv,
) -> None:
    """Xá»­ lÃ½ upload, kiá»ƒm tra Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹, lÆ°u file."""
    danh_sach_file = [
        ("hstd",     f_hstd),
        ("nq11",     f_nq11),
        ("gqvl",     f_gqvl),
        ("cdtotkvv", f_cdtotkvv),
    ]

    co_luu_thanh_cong = False

    for loai, f_obj in danh_sach_file:
        if f_obj is None:
            continue

        file_bytes = f_obj.read()

        # Kiá»ƒm tra cÆ¡ báº£n (Ä‘á»‹nh dáº¡ng, kÃ­ch thÆ°á»›c)
        ok_kt, msg_kt = kiem_tra_file(f_obj.name, file_bytes)
        if not ok_kt:
            nhan_kt = NHAN_LOAI.get(loai, loai.upper())
            st.error(f"âŒ {nhan_kt}: {msg_kt}")
            continue

        # Kiá»ƒm tra loáº¡i file (sheet name)
        ok_loai, msg_loai = _kiem_tra_loai_file(file_bytes, loai)
        if not ok_loai:
            st.error(msg_loai)
            continue

        # Kiá»ƒm tra tÃªn Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ trong file
        khop, msg_khop = _kiem_tra_don_vi(file_bytes, loai, ten_dv)
        if not khop:
            st.warning(msg_khop)
            continue

        path_excel = duong_dan_pgd(ten_dv, loai)
        pq = Path(path_excel).with_suffix(".parquet")
        if pq.exists():
            pq.unlink()

        try:
            kq = luu_pgd_file(ten_dv, loai, file_bytes)
        except Exception as e:
            kq = KetQuaUpload(False, f"Lá»—i lÆ°u: {e}")

        nhan = NHAN_LOAI.get(loai, loai.upper())

        if kq.thanh_cong:
            co_luu_thanh_cong = True
            mb = len(file_bytes) / 1024 / 1024
            db.ghi_audit(
                username,
                "upload_pgd_dia_ban",
                f"{loai.upper()} â€” {ten_dv} ({mb:.1f} MB)",
            )
            st.success(f"âœ… ÄÃ£ lÆ°u **{nhan}** â€” {ten_dv}")

            meta_dq = lay_meta_chat_luong(loai)
            bao_cao = meta_dq.get("bao_cao", []) if meta_dq else []
            don_vi_loi = [
                r
                for r in bao_cao
                if r.get("don_vi") == ten_dv and r.get("so_loi", 0) > 0
            ]

            if don_vi_loi:
                r = don_vi_loi[0]
                st.warning(
                    f"âš ï¸ **Dá»¯ liá»‡u Ä‘Ã£ lÆ°u nhÆ°ng cÃ³ {r['so_loi']} váº¥n Ä‘á» cháº¥t lÆ°á»£ng "
                    f"cáº§n kiá»ƒm tra:**\n\n"
                    + "\n".join(f"â€¢ {e}" for e in r.get("errors", []))
                    + "\n\n_Dá»¯ liá»‡u váº«n Ä‘Æ°á»£c há»‡ thá»‘ng sá»­ dá»¥ng bÃ¬nh thÆ°á»ng._"
                )
        else:
            st.error(

def _bang_trang_thai_don_vi(ten_dv: str) -> None:
    """Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ tráº¡ng thÃ¡i 4 loáº¡i file cá»§a má»™t Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹."""
    LOAI_MAP = {
        "hstd":     "ðŸ“Š HSTD",

def render(tab=None, **kwargs) -> None:
    """
    Render tab Upload Dá»¯ liá»‡u cho CBTD Ä‘á»‹a bÃ n.
    Nháº­n tab (st.tab object) hoáº·c render trá»±c tiáº¿p trong context hiá»‡n táº¡i.
    """
    role     = kwargs.get("role", "user")
    username = kwargs.get("username", "unknown")
    pgd_user = kwargs.get("pgd_user", "")

    # Kiá»ƒm tra quyá»n upload
    if not co_quyen_upload_pgd(role):
        st.warning("âš ï¸ Báº¡n khÃ´ng cÃ³ quyá»n upload.")
        return

    ctx = tab if tab is not None else st

    with ctx:
        st.markdown("### ðŸ“¤ Upload Dá»¯ liá»‡u â€” PhÃ²ng Giao Dá»‹ch")
        st.caption(
            "Upload file dá»¯ liá»‡u cá»§a PGD â€” dÃ¹ng riÃªng cho Há»— trá»£ Ä‘á»‹a bÃ n"
        )

        st.info(
            "ðŸ“Œ Dá»¯ liá»‡u upload táº¡i Ä‘Ã¢y chá»‰ dÃ¹ng cho **Há»— trá»£ Ä‘á»‹a bÃ n** "
            "(tra cá»©u, bÃ¡o cÃ¡o giao ban, máº«u biá»ƒu). "
            "KhÃ´ng áº£nh hÆ°á»Ÿng sá»‘ liá»‡u tá»•ng há»£p cá»§a **PhÃ²ng KH-NV**."
        )

        # â”€â”€ Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i theo Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ (khÃ´ng cÃ²n upload thá»§ cÃ´ng tá»«ng Ã´) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        st.markdown("**ðŸ“‹ Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i dá»¯ liá»‡u hiá»‡n táº¡i**")
        if role == "user":
            ten_dv = pgd_user or (DS_PGD[0] if DS_PGD else DON_VI_CHI_NHANH)
            st.info(f"ðŸ¢ ÄÆ¡n vá»‹ cá»§a báº¡n: **{ten_dv}**")
            _bang_trang_thai_don_vi(ten_dv)
        else:
            ten_xem = st.selectbox(
                "ðŸ¢ ÄÆ¡n vá»‹ (xem tráº¡ng thÃ¡i)",
                DS_DON_VI,
                key="pgd_trang_thai_chon_dv",
            )
            _bang_trang_thai_don_vi(ten_xem)

        st.divider()
        # Form upload riÃªng cho phÃ¢n há»‡ Há»— trá»£ Ä‘á»‹a bÃ n
        # KhÃ´ng dÃ¹ng form cá»§a KH-NV â€” 2 luá»“ng Ä‘á»™c láº­p
        # PhÃ¢n há»‡ PGD (admin_pgd, manager_pgd, user_pgd) chá»‰ upload cho PGD cá»§a mÃ¬nh
        if role in ["admin_pgd", "manager_pgd", "user_pgd"]:
            ten_dv = pgd_user or ""
            if ten_dv:
                st.info(f"ðŸ“ ÄÆ¡n vá»‹ upload: **{pgd_user}**")
                _render_upload_form(ten_dv, "pgd_op", username)
            else:
                st.warning("âš ï¸ KhÃ´ng xÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh Ä‘Æ°á»£c PGD. LiÃªn há»‡ Admin.")
        elif role == "user":
            ten_dv = pgd_user or ""
            if ten_dv:
                _render_upload_form(ten_dv, "pgd_op", username)
            else:
                st.warning("âš ï¸ KhÃ´ng xÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh Ä‘Æ°á»£c PGD. LiÃªn há»‡ Admin.")
        else:
            # admin_cn, admin Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»n tá»± do
            ten_dv = st.selectbox(
                "ðŸ¢ Chá»n PGD cáº§n upload",

            _render_upload_form(ten_dv, f"pgd_op_{ten_dv[:8]}", username)

# CACHE FUNCTIONS
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False, ttl=300)
def _tinh_theo_dvut(_df_bytes: bytes) -> bytes:
    df = pickle.loads(_df_bytes)
    if COT_DVUT not in df.columns:
        return pickle.dumps(pd.DataFrame())
    agg = {}
    if COT_TEN_TO      in df.columns: agg["so_to"]   = (COT_TEN_TO,     "nunique")
    if COT_SO_KU       in df.columns: agg["so_kh"]   = (COT_SO_KU,      "nunique")
    if COT_TONG_DU_NO  in df.columns: agg["tong_dn"] = (COT_TONG_DU_NO, "sum")
    if COT_DU_NO_QH    in df.columns: agg["nqh"]     = (COT_DU_NO_QH,   "sum")
    if COT_LAI_TON     in df.columns: agg["lai_ton"] = (COT_LAI_TON,    "sum")
    if not agg:
        return pickle.dumps(pd.DataFrame())
    t = df.groupby(COT_DVUT).agg(**agg).reset_index()
    t["_ord"] = t[COT_DVUT].apply(
        lambda x: DVUT_ORDER.index(x) if x in DVUT_ORDER else 99)
    return pickle.dumps(t.sort_values("_ord").drop(columns="_ord"))


@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False, ttl=300)
def _loc_mau06(_df_bytes: bytes, ngay_tu: str, ngay_den: str) -> bytes:
    df = pickle.loads(_df_bytes)
    if COT_NGAY_VAY not in df.columns:
        return pickle.dumps(pd.DataFrame())
    ngay_vay = pd.to_datetime(df[COT_NGAY_VAY], errors="coerce")
    mask = (ngay_vay >= pd.Timestamp(ngay_tu)) & \
           (ngay_vay <= pd.Timestamp(ngay_den))
    cols = [c for c in [
        COT_TEN_TO, COT_DVUT, COT_TEN_XA, COT_TEN_KH,
        COT_SO_KU, COT_TEN_CT, COT_NGAY_VAY, COT_MUC_VAY,
        COT_TONG_DU_NO, COT_DU_NO_QH, COT_LAI_TON,
    ] if c in df.columns]
    result = df.loc[mask, cols].copy()
    return pickle.dumps(result.sort_values(COT_NGAY_VAY, ascending=False))


@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False, ttl=300)
def _loc_mau15(_df_bytes: bytes, ten_to: str) -> bytes:
    df = pickle.loads(_df_bytes)
    if COT_TEN_TO not in df.columns:
        return pickle.dumps(pd.DataFrame())
    df_to = df[df[COT_TEN_TO] == ten_to].copy()
    # TÃ­nh ná»£ lÃ£i = LÃ£i tá»“n TH + LÃ£i tá»“n QH
    if COT_LAI_TON in df_to.columns and COT_LAI_TON_QH in df_to.columns:
        df_to["Ná»£ lÃ£i"] = df_to[COT_LAI_TON].fillna(0) + \
                           df_to[COT_LAI_TON_QH].fillna(0)
    elif COT_LAI_TON in df_to.columns:
        df_to["Ná»£ lÃ£i"] = df_to[COT_LAI_TON].fillna(0)
    else:
        df_to["Ná»£ lÃ£i"] = 0
    cols = [c for c in [
        COT_TEN_KH, COT_TEN_CT, COT_SO_KU,
        COT_TONG_DU_NO, "Ná»£ lÃ£i", COT_SO_DU_TG,
    ] if c in df_to.columns or c == "Ná»£ lÃ£i"]
    return pickle.dumps(df_to[cols].reset_index(drop=True))

def _style_doc(doc: Document) -> None:
    """Thiáº¿t láº­p font máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh cho toÃ n bá»™ document."""

def _add_header_quoc_hieu(doc: Document, don_vi: str, so_vb: str,
                           dia_danh: str, ngay_ky: date) -> None:
    """ThÃªm pháº§n Quá»‘c hiá»‡u, TiÃªu ngá»¯, sá»‘ VB chuáº©n hÃ nh chÃ­nh."""
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    # Bá» border
    from docx.oxml.ns import qn
    from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
    for cell in t.rows[0].cells:
        tc = cell._tc
        tcPr = tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
        tcBorders = OxmlElement("w:tcBorders")
        for border_name in ["top", "left", "bottom", "right"]:
            border = OxmlElement(f"w:{border_name}")
            border.set(qn("w:val"), "none")
            tcBorders.append(border)
        tcPr.append(tcBorders)

    # Cá»™t trÃ¡i: ÄÆ¡n vá»‹ + Sá»‘ VB
    cell_l = t.rows[0].cells[0]
    p = cell_l.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run = p.add_run((don_vi or "").upper())
    run.bold = True
    run.font.size = Pt(12)
    p2 = cell_l.add_paragraph(f"Sá»‘: {so_vb}")
    p2.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

    # Cá»™t pháº£i: Quá»‘c hiá»‡u
    cell_r = t.rows[0].cells[1]
    p3 = cell_r.paragraphs[0]
    p3.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run3 = p3.add_run("Cá»˜NG HÃ’A XÃƒ Há»˜I CHá»¦ NGHÄ¨A VIá»†T NAM")
    run3.bold = True
    run3.font.size = Pt(12)
    p4 = cell_r.add_paragraph("Äá»™c láº­p - Tá»± do - Háº¡nh phÃºc")
    p4.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run4 = p4.runs[0] if p4.runs else p4.add_run("Äá»™c láº­p - Tá»± do - Háº¡nh phÃºc")
    run4.bold = True

    p5 = cell_r.add_paragraph(
        f"{dia_danh}, ngÃ y {ngay_ky.day} thÃ¡ng {ngay_ky.month} "
        f"nÄƒm {ngay_ky.year}"
    )
    p5.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    doc.add_paragraph()

def _tao_word_mau15(du_lieu: dict, df_to: pd.DataFrame) -> bytes:
