def _render_theo_dvut(df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    st.markdown("#### ðŸ“Š Thá»‘ng kÃª theo Há»™i Ä‘oÃ n thá»ƒ")
    if df is None or df.empty:
        st.warning("ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u."); return
    try:
        t = pickle.loads(_tinh_theo_dvut(pickle.dumps(df)))
    except Exception as e:
        st.error(f"Lá»—i: {e}"); return
    if t.empty:
        st.info("KhÃ´ng cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u."); return

    c1, c2, c3, c4 = st.columns(4)
    c1.metric("Há»™i Ä‘oÃ n thá»ƒ", len(t))
    c2.metric("Tá»•ng Tá»• TK&VV", fmt_so(int(t.get("so_to", pd.Series([0])).sum())))
    c3.metric("Tá»•ng KH", fmt_so(int(t.get("so_kh", pd.Series([0])).sum())))
    c4.metric("Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£ (tr.Ä‘)", fmt(t.get("tong_dn", pd.Series([0])).sum()))
    st.divider()
    hien = t.rename(columns={
        COT_DVUT: "Há»™i Ä‘oÃ n thá»ƒ", "so_to": "Sá»‘ Tá»•",
        "so_kh": "Sá»‘ KH", "tong_dn": "DÆ° ná»£ (tr.Ä‘)",
        "nqh": "NQH (tr.Ä‘)", "lai_ton": "LÃ£i tá»“n (tr.Ä‘)",
    })
    for col in ["DÆ° ná»£ (tr.Ä‘)", "NQH (tr.Ä‘)", "LÃ£i tá»“n (tr.Ä‘)"]:
        if col in hien.columns:
            hien[col] = hien[col].apply(fmt)
    st.dataframe(hien, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)


def _render_ke_hoach(df: pd.DataFrame, pgd_user: str) -> None:
    st.markdown("#### ðŸ“‹ Káº¿ hoáº¡ch kiá»ƒm tra giÃ¡m sÃ¡t á»§y thÃ¡c")
    st.caption("Há»™i Ä‘oÃ n thá»ƒ cáº¥p xÃ£ láº­p (PGD) hoáº·c cáº¥p tá»‰nh láº­p (CN). "
               "Danh sÃ¡ch Tá»• TK&VV tá»± Ä‘á»™ng láº¥y tá»« há»‡ thá»‘ng.")

    # Láº¥y danh sÃ¡ch Tá»• tá»« df
    ds_to = []
    if df is not None and not df.empty:
        grp = [c for c in [COT_DVUT, COT_TEN_XA, COT_TEN_TO] if c in df.columns]
        if grp:
            ds_to = (df[grp].drop_duplicates()
                     .sort_values(grp).to_dict("records"))

    with st.form("form_ke_hoach_kt"):
        c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
        don_vi_kt = c1.selectbox(
            "Há»™i Ä‘oÃ n thá»ƒ kiá»ƒm tra",
            options=DVUT_ORDER,
            key="kh_don_vi_kt"
        )
        so_vb      = c1.text_input("Sá»‘ vÄƒn báº£n", placeholder="VD: 12/KH-HND")
        ds_xa_kh = sorted(df[COT_TEN_XA].dropna().unique().tolist()) \
                   if df is not None and COT_TEN_XA in df.columns else []
        dia_danh = c1.selectbox(
            "Äá»‹a danh (xÃ£/phÆ°á»ng)",
            options=ds_xa_kh,
            key="kh_dia_danh",
            help="XÃ£/phÆ°á»ng nÆ¡i Há»™i Ä‘Ã³ng trá»¥ sá»Ÿ â€” dÃ¹ng lÃ m Ä‘á»‹a danh kÃ½ vÄƒn báº£n"
        )
        nam_kh     = c2.number_input("NÄƒm káº¿ hoáº¡ch",
                                      value=date.today().year,
                                      min_value=2020, max_value=2035, step=1)
        ngay_ky    = c2.date_input("NgÃ y kÃ½", value=date.today())
        chu_tich   = c2.text_input("Chá»§ tá»‹ch kÃ½",
                                    placeholder="Há» vÃ  tÃªn Chá»§ tá»‹ch Há»™i")

        st.markdown("**I. Má»¥c Ä‘Ã­ch, yÃªu cáº§u**")
        muc_dich   = st.text_area("Má»¥c Ä‘Ã­ch", height=70)
        yeu_cau    = st.text_area("YÃªu cáº§u", height=70)

        st.markdown("**II. Káº¿ hoáº¡ch kiá»ƒm tra**")
        noi_dung_kt = st.text_area("Ná»™i dung, thá»i hiá»‡u kiá»ƒm tra", height=70)
        thanh_phan  = st.text_area("ThÃ nh pháº§n ÄoÃ n kiá»ƒm tra", height=60)
        st.info(f"ðŸ“‹ Há»‡ thá»‘ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y **{len(ds_to)}** Tá»• TK&VV "
                f"â€” sáº½ tá»± Ä‘á»™ng Ä‘iá»n vÃ o báº£ng Äá»‘i tÆ°á»£ng kiá»ƒm tra.")

        st.markdown("**III. Káº¿ hoáº¡ch giÃ¡m sÃ¡t**")
        noi_dung_gs  = st.text_area("Ná»™i dung, thá»i hiá»‡u giÃ¡m sÃ¡t", height=70)
        phan_cong_gs = st.text_area("PhÃ¢n cÃ´ng cÃ¡n bá»™ giÃ¡m sÃ¡t", height=60)

        st.markdown("**IV. Tá»• chá»©c thá»±c hiá»‡n**")
        to_chuc = st.text_area("Tá»• chá»©c thá»±c hiá»‡n", height=60)

        submitted = st.form_submit_button("ðŸ“„ Táº¡o Word")

    if submitted:
        # Build context cho template Káº¿ hoáº¡ch kiá»ƒm tra
        context = {
            "don_vi_kt":   don_vi_kt,
            "so_vb":       so_vb,
            "dia_danh":    dia_danh,
            "nam_kh":      int(nam_kh),
            "ngay_ky":     ngay_ky.strftime("%d/%m/%Y"),
            "ngay":        ngay_ky.day,
            "thang":       ngay_ky.month,
            "nam":         ngay_ky.year,
            "muc_dich":    muc_dich,
            "yeu_cau":     yeu_cau,
            "noi_dung_kt": noi_dung_kt,
            "thanh_phan":  thanh_phan,
            "noi_dung_gs": noi_dung_gs,
            "phan_cong_gs": phan_cong_gs,
            "to_chuc":     to_chuc,
            "chu_tich":    chu_tich,
            "so_to":       len(ds_to),
            "ds_to":       ds_to,
        }

        if co_template(TMPL_KH_KT):
            with st.spinner("Äang táº¡o file..."):
                docx_bytes = dien_template(TMPL_KH_KT, context)
            ten_file = f"KH_KiemTra_UyThac_{int(nam_kh)}_{don_vi_kt[:20].replace(' ','_')}"
            col1, col2 = st.columns(2)
            with col1:
                st.download_button(
                    "â¬‡ï¸ Táº£i Word (.docx)",
                    data=docx_bytes,
                    file_name=ten_file + ".docx",
                    mime="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument"
                         ".wordprocessingml.document",
                    key="kh_docx",

def auto_audit(action: str = "", clear_cache: bool = True):
    """
    Decorator cho cÃ¡c hÃ m ghi dá»¯ liá»‡u trong VBSP-SCM.

    Tá»± Ä‘á»™ng thá»±c hiá»‡n sau khi hÃ m Ä‘Æ°á»£c bá»c cháº¡y thÃ nh cÃ´ng:
      1. Gá»i db.ghi_audit(username, action, detail)
      2. Gá»i st.cache_data.clear() náº¿u clear_cache=True

    Quy Æ°á»›c tham sá»‘ hÃ m Ä‘Æ°á»£c bá»c:
      - Tham sá»‘ `username` (str): báº¯t buá»™c, dÃ¹ng Ä‘á»ƒ ghi audit.
        CÃ³ thá»ƒ lÃ  positional hoáº·c keyword argument.
      - GiÃ¡ trá»‹ tráº£ vá» cá»§a hÃ m Ä‘Æ°á»£c bá»c sáº½ Ä‘Æ°á»£c truyá»n nguyÃªn vÃ o `detail`.

    CÃ¡ch dÃ¹ng:
        @auto_audit(action="luu_khtd_pgd")
        def luu_khtd_pgd(pgd: str, data: dict, username: str) -> bool:
            db.ghi_kv(f"khtd_{pgd}", data, username)
            return True

    Náº¿u hÃ m raise exception, decorator KHÃ”NG ghi audit (Ä‘á»ƒ trÃ¡nh log sai).
    """

    def decorator(func):
        @functools.wraps(func)
        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
            import db as _db
            import streamlit as _st

            # XÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh action label
            _action = action or func.__name__

            # Láº¥y username tá»« kwargs hoáº·c args theo tÃªn tham sá»‘
            sig = inspect.signature(func)
            params = list(sig.parameters.keys())
            _username = kwargs.get("username", "system")
            if _username == "system" and "username" in params:
                idx = params.index("username")
                if idx < len(args):
                    _username = args[idx]

            # Cháº¡y hÃ m gá»‘c
            result = func(*args, **kwargs)

            # Ghi audit â€” detail lÃ  repr ngáº¯n cá»§a result
            try:
                _detail = str(result)[:200] if result is not None else ""
                _db.ghi_audit(_username, _action, _detail)
            except Exception:
                pass  # KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»ƒ lá»—i audit phÃ¡ vá»¡ luá»“ng chÃ­nh

            # XÃ³a cache Streamlit
            if clear_cache:
                try:
                    _st.cache_data.clear()
                except Exception:
                    pass

            return result

        return wrapper

    return decorator


# â”€â”€ Helper Ä‘á»c cáº¥u hÃ¬nh Ä‘á»™ng â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def lay_config(key: str, fallback):
    """
    Äá»c cáº¥u hÃ¬nh Ä‘á»™ng theo key:
      1. Æ¯u tiÃªn kv_store (Admin cÃ³ thá»ƒ chá»‰nh sá»­a qua giao diá»‡n).
      2. Fallback vá» giÃ¡ trá»‹ máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh tá»« config.py náº¿u kv_store chÆ°a cÃ³.

    Params
    ------
    key      : key trong báº£ng kv_store (vd: "ds_pgd", "pgd_xa_map")
    fallback : giÃ¡ trá»‹ máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh láº¥y tá»« config.py

    Returns
    -------
    Dá»¯ liá»‡u Ä‘Ã£ parse tá»« JSON (list / dict) hoáº·c fallback.
    """
    try:
        import db
        val = db.doc_kv(key)
        return val if val is not None else fallback
    except Exception:
        return fallback


def format_df_vn(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Tá»± Ä‘á»™ng format táº¥t cáº£ cá»™t sá»‘ trong DataFrame sang chuáº©n Viá»‡t Nam.
    - Sá»‘ nguyÃªn lá»›n: dáº¥u cháº¥m phÃ¢n cÃ¡ch hÃ ng nghÃ¬n (1.234.567)
    - Sá»‘ tháº­p phÃ¢n: dáº¥u pháº©y cho tháº­p phÃ¢n (1.234,56)
    - Cá»™t tÃªn chá»©a % / "tá»· lá»‡" / pct: thÃªm kÃ½ hiá»‡u %
    """
    df = df.copy()
    for col in df.columns:
        if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col]):
            continue
        if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(df[col]):
            continue
        col_str = str(col)
        col_lower = col_str.lower()
        if "%" in col_str or "tá»· lá»‡" in col_lower or "pct" in col_lower:
            df[col] = df[col].map(
                lambda x: (
                    f"{float(x):,.2f}%".replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")
                    if pd.notna(x)
                    else ""
                )
            )
        elif "tá»·" in col_lower:
            df[col] = df[col].map(
                lambda x: (
                    f"{float(x):,.3f}".replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")
                    if pd.notna(x)
                    else ""
                )
            )
        elif "triá»‡u" in col_lower:
            df[col] = df[col].map(
                lambda x: (
                    f"{float(x):,.1f}".replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")
                    if pd.notna(x)
                    else ""
                )
            )
        else:
            df[col] = df[col].map(
                lambda x: (
                    f"{float(x):,.0f}".replace(",", ".")
                    if pd.notna(x)
                    else ""
                )
            )
    return df


def hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang(df, so_dong_moi_trang=500, key="df", **kwargs):
    """Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ dataframe cÃ³ phÃ¢n trang, máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh 500 dÃ²ng/trang.

    ``kwargs`` truyá»n thÃªm cho ``st.dataframe`` (vd: ``height``, ``column_config``,
    ``hide_index``). Vá»›i ``Styler``, khÃ´ng phÃ¢n trang (hiá»ƒn thá»‹ má»™t láº§n).
    """
    try:
        from pandas.io.formats.style import Styler
    except ImportError:
        Styler = None  # type: ignore[misc, assignment]

    opts = {"use_container_width": True, "hide_index": True}
    opts.update(kwargs)

    if Styler is not None and isinstance(df, Styler):
        st.dataframe(df, **opts)
        return

    def _disp(chunk: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
        st.dataframe(format_df_vn(chunk), **opts)

    tong = len(df)
    if tong <= so_dong_moi_trang:
        _disp(df)
        return

    tong_trang = max(1, (tong + so_dong_moi_trang - 1) // so_dong_moi_trang)
    trang = st.number_input(
        f"Trang (1-{tong_trang}) Â· Tá»•ng {tong:,} dÃ²ng",
        min_value=1,
        max_value=tong_trang,
        value=1,
        key=f"{key}_trang",
    )
    start = (trang - 1) * so_dong_moi_trang
    end = start + so_dong_moi_trang
    _disp(df.iloc[start:end])


# â”€â”€ Äá»‹nh dáº¡ng sá»‘ kiá»ƒu Viá»‡t Nam â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def vn(x, d=1, show_sign: bool = False):
    """Sá»‘ thá»±c â†’ chuá»—i VN (dáº¥u . nghÃ¬n, dáº¥u , tháº­p phÃ¢n). show_sign=True â†’ +/- rÃµ rÃ ng."""
    try:
        x = float(x)
        s = f"{x:,.{d}f}".replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")
        s = s.rstrip("0").rstrip(",") if "," in s else s
        if show_sign and x > 0:
            return f"+{s}"
        return s
    except:
        return "â€”"


def fmt_tien(x):
    """Äá»“ng â†’ tá»·/triá»‡u, Ä‘á»‹nh dáº¡ng VN."""
    try:
        x = float(x)
        if abs(x) >= 1e9:
            s = f"{x/1e9:,.3f}".replace(",","X").replace(".",",").replace("X",".")
            return f"{s.rstrip('0').rstrip(',') if ',' in s else s} tá»· Ä‘á»“ng"
        if abs(x) >= 1e6:
            s = f"{x/1e6:,.1f}".replace(",","X").replace(".",",").replace("X",".")
            return f"{s} triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng"
        if abs(x) > 0:
            return f"{x:,.0f}".replace(",",".") + " Ä‘á»“ng"
        return "â€”"
    except:
        return "â€”"


def fmt_ty(x):
    """Äá»“ng â†’ tá»· ngáº¯n gá»n (dÃ¹ng trong báº£ng so sÃ¡nh Äiá»‡n bÃ¡o)."""
    try:
        x = float(x)
        ty = x / 1e9
        if abs(ty) >= 1:
            return f"{vn(ty, 3)} tá»·"
        if abs(x) >= 1e6:
            return f"{vn(x/1e6, 1)} triá»‡u"
        if abs(x) > 0:
            return f"{vn(x/1e6, 3)} triá»‡u"
        return "â€”"
    except:
        return "â€”"


def fmt_cl(x):
    """ChÃªnh lá»‡ch tá»· cÃ³ dáº¥u + / -."""
    try:
        x = float(x)
        s = fmt_ty(x)
        return ("+" + s if x > 0 else s) if s != "â€”" else "â€”"
    except:
        return "â€”"


def fmt_pct(x):
    """Tá»· lá»‡ % cÃ³ dáº¥u +/-."""
    try:
        x = float(x)
        return (f"+{vn(x,1)}%" if x > 0 else f"{vn(x,1)}%") if x != 0 else "0%"
    except:
        return "â€”"


def fmt_so(x):
    """Sá»‘ nguyÃªn dáº¥u . nghÃ¬n."""
    try:
        return f"{int(x):,}".replace(",",".")
    except:
        return "â€”"


def fmt(x):
    """
    Format sá»‘ tiá»n (Ä‘á»“ng) â†’ tá»·/triá»‡u ngáº¯n gá»n.
    DÃ¹ng thay cho cÃ¡c _fmt() Ä‘á»‹nh nghÄ©a ráº£i rÃ¡c á»Ÿ cÃ¡c tab.
      >= 1 tá»·  â†’ "1,234 tá»·"
      >= 1 triá»‡u â†’ "123,4 triá»‡u"
      > 0      â†’ "123.456"
      0 / lá»—i  â†’ "â€”"
    Há»— trá»£ sá»‘ Ã¢m (dÃ¹ng trong cá»™t chÃªnh lá»‡ch).
    """
    try:
        x = float(x)
        if abs(x) >= 1e9:
            s = f"{x/1e9:,.3f}".replace(",","X").replace(".",",").replace("X",".")
            return f"{s.rstrip('0').rstrip(',')} tá»·"
        if abs(x) >= 1e6:
            s = f"{x/1e6:,.1f}".replace(",","X").replace(".",",").replace("X",".")
            return f"{s} triá»‡u"
        if abs(x) > 0:
            return f"{x:,.0f}".replace(",",".")
        return "â€”"
    except:
        return "â€”"


def fmt_tl(th, kh):
    """Tá»· lá»‡ thá»±c hiá»‡n/káº¿ hoáº¡ch â†’ chuá»—i '87,5%' hoáº·c 'â€”'."""
    try:
        if float(kh) <= 0:
            return "â€”"
        return f"{float(th)/float(kh)*100:,.1f}%".replace(",","X").replace(".",",").replace("X",".")
    except:
        return "â€”"


# â”€â”€ Xuáº¥t Excel BytesIO â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def xuat_excel(sheets: dict) -> bytes:
    """
    sheets = {"TÃªn sheet": dataframe, ...}
    Tráº£ vá» bytes Ä‘á»ƒ dÃ¹ng vá»›i st.download_button.
    """
    buf = BytesIO()
    with pd.ExcelWriter(buf, engine="openpyxl") as w:
        for sheet_name, df in sheets.items():
            df.to_excel(w, index=False, sheet_name=sheet_name[:31])
    return buf.getvalue()

# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# AUTO FILL DOCUMENT â€” Ä‘iá»n dá»¯ liá»‡u vÃ o file Word template
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime as _dt
import copy


def _replace_in_para(para, replacements: dict):
    """Thay tháº¿ tag trong 1 paragraph, giá»¯ nguyÃªn Ä‘á»‹nh dáº¡ng."""
    full = "".join(r.text for r in para.runs)
    if not any(tag in full for tag in replacements):
        return
    for tag, val in replacements.items():
        full = full.replace(tag, str(val))
    # Ghi láº¡i vÃ o run Ä‘áº§u tiÃªn, xÃ³a runs cÃ²n láº¡i
    if para.runs:
        para.runs[0].text = full
        for r in para.runs[1:]:
            r.text = ""


def _build_replacements(data_row, tag_map: dict, extra: dict = None) -> dict:
    """
    Táº¡o dict {tag â†’ giÃ¡ trá»‹ thá»±c} tá»« 1 dÃ²ng dá»¯ liá»‡u (pd.Series hoáº·c dict).
    extra: cÃ¡c tag tá»± do khÃ´ng cÃ³ trong tag_map (vd: ngÃ y in, tÃªn cÃ¡n bá»™...)
    """
    repl = {}
    for tag, col in tag_map.items():
        if hasattr(data_row, "get"):
            val = data_row.get(col, "")
        else:
            val = getattr(data_row, col, "")
        if val is None or (hasattr(val, "__class__") and val.__class__.__name__ == "float"
                           and str(val) == "nan"):
            val = ""
        repl[tag] = val
    # LuÃ´n bá»• sung ngÃ y in tá»± Ä‘á»™ng
    repl["{{ngay_in}}"]     = _dt.today().strftime("%d/%m/%Y")
    repl["{{ngay_in_day}}"] = _dt.today().strftime("%d")
    repl["{{ngay_in_mon}}"] = _dt.today().strftime("%m")
    repl["{{ngay_in_yr}}"]  = _dt.today().strftime("%Y")
    if extra:
        repl.update(extra)
    return repl


def auto_fill_document(data_row, template_path: str, tag_map: dict,
                       extra: dict = None) -> bytes:
    """
    Äiá»n dá»¯ liá»‡u vÃ o file Word template (.docx).

    Params
    ------
    data_row      : pd.Series hoáº·c dict â€” 1 hÃ ng dá»¯ liá»‡u khÃ¡ch hÃ ng
    template_path : Ä‘Æ°á»ng dáº«n tá»›i file .docx máº«u
    tag_map       : dict {tag â†’ tÃªn cá»™t}, láº¥y tá»« config.TAG_MAP
    extra         : dict tag bá»• sung tá»± do

    Returns
    -------
    bytes â€” ná»™i dung file .docx Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘iá»n, dÃ¹ng trá»±c tiáº¿p vá»›i st.download_button
    """
    try:
        from docx import Document
        from io import BytesIO
    except ImportError:
        raise ImportError("Cáº§n cÃ i: pip install python-docx")

    doc  = Document(str(template_path))
    repl = _build_replacements(data_row, tag_map, extra)

    # Xá»­ lÃ½ táº¥t cáº£ paragraphs (ká»ƒ cáº£ trong header/footer)
    for para in doc.paragraphs:
        _replace_in_para(para, repl)

    # Xá»­ lÃ½ báº£ng trong document
    for table in doc.tables:
        for row in table.rows:
            for cell in row.cells:
                for para in cell.paragraphs:
                    _replace_in_para(para, repl)

    # Header / Footer
    for section in doc.sections:
        for hdr_ftr in [section.header, section.footer,
                        section.even_page_header, section.even_page_footer,
                        section.first_page_header, section.first_page_footer]:
            if hdr_ftr:
                for para in hdr_ftr.paragraphs:
                    _replace_in_para(para, repl)

    buf = BytesIO()
    doc.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()


def auto_fill_batch(df_rows, template_path: str, tag_map: dict,
                    extra: dict = None) -> bytes:
    """
    Äiá»n nhiá»u há»“ sÆ¡ vÃ o 1 file Word â€” má»—i há»“ sÆ¡ 1 trang (page break giá»¯a cÃ¡c trang).
    Tráº£ vá» bytes file .docx tá»•ng há»£p.
    """
    try:
        from docx import Document
        from docx.oxml.ns import qn
        from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
        from io import BytesIO
        import lxml.etree as etree
    except ImportError:
        raise ImportError("Cáº§n cÃ i: pip install python-docx lxml")

    def add_page_break(doc):
        para = doc.add_paragraph()
        run  = para.add_run()
        br   = OxmlElement("w:br")
        br.set(qn("w:type"), "page")
        run._r.append(br)

    master = None
    for i, (_, row) in enumerate(df_rows.iterrows()):
        doc  = Document(str(template_path))
        repl = _build_replacements(row, tag_map, extra)
        for para in doc.paragraphs:
            _replace_in_para(para, repl)
        for table in doc.tables:
            for tr in table.rows:
                for cell in tr.cells:
                    for para in cell.paragraphs:
                        _replace_in_para(para, repl)
        if master is None:
            master = doc
        else:
            add_page_break(master)
            for elem in doc.element.body:
                master.element.body.append(copy.deepcopy(elem))

    if master is None:
        return b""
    buf = BytesIO()
    master.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()


def quet_templates(templates_dir) -> list:
    """QuÃ©t thÆ° má»¥c templates/, tráº£ vá» list (tÃªn_hien_thi, path)."""
    p = Path(str(templates_dir))
    if not p.exists():
        return []
    files = sorted(p.glob("*.docx"))
    return [(f.stem.replace("_", " ").title(), f) for f in files]


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# AUTO-FILL MáºªU KL GIAO BAN â€” Báº£ng II cá»™t 3 thÃ¡ng khÃ´ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

def _tinh_so_lieu_klgb(df: "pd.DataFrame") -> dict:
    """
    TÃ­nh toÃ¡n cÃ¡c chá»‰ sá»‘ cáº§n Ä‘iá»n vÃ o máº«u KL giao ban.
    Tráº£ vá» dict {tag_key: giÃ¡_trá»‹_chuá»—i} Ä‘á»ƒ merge vÃ o replacements.

    TÃªn ÄVUT thá»±c táº¿ trong HSTD (Ä‘Ã£ xÃ¡c nháº­n vá»›i dá»¯ liá»‡u):
        "Há»™i nÃ´ng dÃ¢n", "Há»™i liÃªn hiá»‡p phá»¥ ná»¯",
        "Há»™i cá»±u chiáº¿n binh", "ÄoÃ n thanh niÃªn"
    """
    from datetime import date
    from data import danh_dau_khong_hd, tong_hop_khong_hd, canh_bao_migration
    from config import (COT_TONG_DU_NO, COT_DU_NO_TH, COT_DU_NO_QH,
                        DVUT_TAG_KEY)

    today = date.today()
    so_lieu = {
        "ngay_in":       today.strftime("%d/%m/%Y"),
        "thang_bao_cao": today.strftime("%m/%Y"),
    }

    if df is None or df.empty:
        return so_lieu

    # Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£ toÃ n PGD
    tdn = df[COT_TONG_DU_NO].sum() if COT_TONG_DU_NO in df.columns else 0
    dqh = df[COT_DU_NO_QH].sum()   if COT_DU_NO_QH   in df.columns else 0
    so_lieu["ty_le_nqh"] = f"{dqh/tdn*100:.3f}%" if tdn > 0 else "0.000%"

    # 3 thÃ¡ng khÃ´ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng â€” tá»•ng há»£p theo ÄVUT
    df_kh = danh_dau_khong_hd(df)
    khd   = tong_hop_khong_hd(df_kh, nhom_theo="TÃªn ÄVUT")

    # Äiá»n tá»«ng ÄVUT theo Ä‘Ãºng tÃªn thá»±c táº¿ trong file HSTD
    tong_3m = 0
    for ten_dvut_thuc, tag_key in DVUT_TAG_KEY.items():
        so_mon = 0
        if not khd.empty and "TÃªn ÄVUT" in khd.columns:
            r = khd[khd["TÃªn ÄVUT"].str.lower() == ten_dvut_thuc.lower()]
            so_mon = int(r["MÃ³n_3m_KHÄ"].sum()) if not r.empty else 0
        so_lieu[tag_key] = str(so_mon)
        tong_3m += so_mon
    so_lieu["mon_3m_tong"] = str(tong_3m)

    # Cáº£nh bÃ¡o amber
    try:
        df_amber = canh_bao_migration(df_kh)
        so_lieu["mon_amber_tong"] = str(len(df_amber))
    except Exception:
        so_lieu["mon_amber_tong"] = "0"

    return so_lieu


def auto_fill_klgb(df: "pd.DataFrame", template_path: str,
                   ten_pgd: str = "") -> bytes:
    """
    Táº¡o file Word KL giao ban Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘iá»n Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ sá»‘ liá»‡u Báº£ng II.

    Params
    ------
    df            : DataFrame HSTD cá»§a PGD (Ä‘Ã£ lá»c theo PGD náº¿u cáº§n)
    template_path : Ä‘Æ°á»ng dáº«n file .docx máº«u KL giao ban
    ten_pgd       : tÃªn PGD Ä‘á»ƒ Ä‘iá»n vÃ o {{ten_pgd}}

    Returns
    -------
    bytes â€” ná»™i dung file .docx Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘iá»n
    """
    try:
        from docx import Document
        from io import BytesIO
    except ImportError:
        raise ImportError("Cáº§n cÃ i: pip install python-docx")

    from config import TAG_MAP_KLGB

    # TÃ­nh sá»‘ liá»‡u
    so_lieu = _tinh_so_lieu_klgb(df)
    if ten_pgd:
        so_lieu["ten_pgd_override"] = ten_pgd

    # Build replacements tá»« TAG_MAP_KLGB
    repl = {}
    for tag, key in TAG_MAP_KLGB.items():
        # Náº¿u key trá» vÃ o cá»™t DataFrame
        if df is not None and key in df.columns:
            val = df[key].sum() if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[key]) \
                  else df[key].iloc[0] if len(df) > 0 else ""
            repl[tag] = fmt(val) if isinstance(val, (int, float)) else str(val)
        # Náº¿u key lÃ  computed value
        elif key in so_lieu:
            repl[tag] = str(so_lieu[key])
        else:
            repl[tag] = "â€”"

    # Ghi Ä‘Ã¨ ten_pgd náº¿u truyá»n thá»§ cÃ´ng
    if ten_pgd:
        repl["{{ten_pgd}}"] = ten_pgd

    # Äiá»n vÃ o Word
    doc = Document(str(template_path))
    for para in doc.paragraphs:
        _replace_in_para(para, repl)
    for table in doc.tables:
        for row in table.rows:
            for cell in row.cells:
                for para in cell.paragraphs:
                    _replace_in_para(para, repl)
    for section in doc.sections:
        for hdr_ftr in [section.header, section.footer]:
            if hdr_ftr:
                for para in hdr_ftr.paragraphs:
                    _replace_in_para(para, repl)

    buf = BytesIO()
    doc.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()


def pick_hstd_column(df: pd.DataFrame, *candidates: str) -> str | None:
    """
    TÃ¬m tÃªn cá»™t Ä‘áº§u tiÃªn khá»›p (case-insensitive, strip) trong candidates.
    DÃ¹ng Ä‘á»ƒ chá»‹u lá»‡ch "TÃªn ThÃ´n" vs "TÃªn thÃ´n", "TÃªn xÃ£" vs "TÃªn XÃ£"â€¦
    """
    cols_stripped = {str(c).strip(): c for c in df.columns}
    for cand in candidates:
        key = cand.strip()
        if key in cols_stripped:
            return cols_stripped[key]
        for col_s, col_orig in cols_stripped.items():
            if col_s.lower() == key.lower():
                return col_orig
    return None

# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# HELPER â€” Format ná»™i bá»™
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
def _fmt(v) -> str:
    """Format sá»‘ tiá»n (Ä‘á»“ng) â†’ tá»·/triá»‡u ngáº¯n gá»n dÃ¹ng trong báº£ng (chuáº©n VN: . nghÃ¬n, , tháº­p phÃ¢n)."""
    try:
        v = float(v)
        if abs(v) >= 1e9:
            s = f"{v/1e9:,.3f}".replace(",","X").replace(".",",").replace("X",".")
            return f"{s.rstrip('0').rstrip(',')} tá»·"
        if abs(v) >= 1e6:
            s = f"{v/1e6:,.1f}".replace(",","X").replace(".",",").replace("X",".")
            return f"{s} tr"
        return f"{v:,.0f}".replace(",",".")
    except Exception:
        return "â€”"


def _mau_nqh(tlqh: float) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    """Tráº£ vá» (mÃ u_hex, nhÃ£n_tráº¡ng_thÃ¡i, icon) theo má»©c NQH."""
    if tlqh < _NGUONG_AN_TOAN:
        return "#2e7d32", "AN TOÃ€N", "âœ…"
    if tlqh < _NGUONG_CANH_BAO:
        return "#f57f17", "Cáº¦N THEO DÃ•I", "âš ï¸"
    return "#c62828", "VÆ¯á»¢T NGÆ¯á» NG", "ðŸš¨"


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# GAUGE â€” Äá»“ng há»“ Ä‘o Tá»· lá»‡ NQH ToÃ n Tá»‰nh
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
def _gauge_nqh(tlqh: float) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Táº¡o biá»ƒu Ä‘á»“ Ä‘á»“ng há»“ Ä‘o (Gauge + Number) Tá»· lá»‡ NQH.
    VÃ¹ng mÃ u: xanh [0â€“1%] | cam [1â€“2%] | Ä‘á» [2â€“5%].
    """
    mau, tinh_trang, _ = _mau_nqh(tlqh)
    gio_han = 5.0  # Trá»¥c gauge tá»‘i Ä‘a 5%

    fig = go.Figure(go.Indicator(
        mode="gauge+number+delta",
        value=round(tlqh, 3),
        number={
            "suffix": "%",
            "font": {"size": 40, "color": mau, "family": "Arial"},
            "valueformat": ".3f",
        },
        delta={
            "reference": _NGUONG_AN_TOAN,
            "increasing": {"color": "#c62828"},
            "decreasing": {"color": "#2e7d32"},
            "suffix": "% so ngÆ°á»¡ng",
            "valueformat": ".3f",
        },
        gauge={
            "axis": {
                "range": [0, gio_han],
                "tickwidth": 1,
                "tickcolor": "#666",
                "ticksuffix": "%",
                "nticks": 6,
            },
            "bar": {"color": mau, "thickness": 0.28},
            "bgcolor": "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
            "borderwidth": 0,
            "steps": [
                {"range": [0, _NGUONG_AN_TOAN],  "color": "rgba(46,125,50,0.12)"},
                {"range": [_NGUONG_AN_TOAN, _NGUONG_CANH_BAO], "color": "rgba(245,127,23,0.12)"},
                {"range": [_NGUONG_CANH_BAO, gio_han], "color": "rgba(198,40,40,0.12)"},
            ],
            "threshold": {
                "line": {"color": "#e65100", "width": 3},
                "thickness": 0.82,
                "value": _NGUONG_AN_TOAN,
            },
        },
        title={
            "text": (
                f"Tá»· lá»‡ NQH ToÃ n Tá»‰nh<br>"
                f"<span style='font-size:14px;color:{mau};font-weight:bold'>"
                f"{tinh_trang}</span>"
            ),
            "font": {"size": 16},
        },
    ))
    fig.update_layout(
        height=270,
        margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=50, b=10),
        paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        font_family="Arial",
    )
    return fig


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# FRAGMENTS â€” Gauge / KPI (rerun Ä‘á»™c láº­p khi tÆ°Æ¡ng tÃ¡c widget bÃªn trong)
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
@st.fragment
def _render_gauge_du_no(**kwargs) -> None:
    """Äá»“ng há»“ Ä‘o Tá»· lá»‡ NQH (gauge Plotly)."""
    tlqh = kwargs["tlqh"]
    st.plotly_chart(_gauge_nqh(tlqh), use_container_width=True)


@st.fragment
def _render_metric_cards(**kwargs) -> None:
    """Metric cards + thanh tiáº¿n trÃ¬nh sá»©c khá»e tÃ­n dá»¥ng."""
    tdn = kwargs["tdn"]
    dth = kwargs["dth"]
    dqh = kwargs["dqh"]
    tlqh = kwargs["tlqh"]
    n_hs = kwargs["n_hs"]
    n_kh = kwargs["n_kh"]
    mau = kwargs["mau"]
    tinh_trang = kwargs["tinh_trang"]
    icon = kwargs["icon"]

    st.markdown(f"### {icon} Chá»‰ sá»‘ TÃ­n dá»¥ng")
    r1c1, r1c2 = st.columns(2)
    r2c1, r2c2 = st.columns(2)

    r1c1.metric(
        label="ðŸ’° Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£",
        value=fmt_tien(tdn),
    )
    r1c2.metric(
        label="âœ… DÆ° ná»£ trong háº¡n",
        value=fmt_tien(dth),
        help="DÆ° ná»£ chÆ°a Ä‘áº¿n háº¡n thanh toÃ¡n",
    )
    r2c1.metric(
        label="âš ï¸ Ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n",
        value=fmt_ty(dqh),
        delta=(f"{icon} {tinh_trang}" if dqh > 0 else "âœ… KhÃ´ng cÃ³ NQH"),
        delta_color="inverse" if tlqh >= _NGUONG_AN_TOAN else "normal",
    )
    r2c2.metric(
        label="ðŸ‘¥ Sá»‘ khÃ¡ch hÃ ng",
        value=fmt_so(n_kh),
        help=f"Tá»•ng {fmt_so(n_hs)} há»“ sÆ¡ trong há»‡ thá»‘ng",
    )

    st.markdown("---")
    pct_th = dth / tdn * 100 if tdn > 0 else 100
    st.markdown(
        f"**Tá»· lá»‡ DÆ° ná»£ trong háº¡n:** "
        f"<span style='color:#1565C0;font-weight:bold'>{pct_th:.1f}%</span> "
        f"&nbsp;|&nbsp; **NQH:** "
        f"<span style='color:{mau};font-weight:bold'>{tlqh:.3f}%</span>",
        unsafe_allow_html=True,
    )
    st.progress(
        min(pct_th / 100, 1.0),
        text=f"Sá»©c khá»e: {pct_th:.1f}% dÆ° ná»£ Ä‘ang trong háº¡n",
    )


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# SECTION 1 â€” Sá»©c Khá»e TÃ­n Dá»¥ng (Gauge + KPI tá»•ng há»£p)
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
def _the_suc_khoe(df_full: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    """
    Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ section 'Sá»©c Khá»e TÃ­n Dá»¥ng' gá»“m:
      â€¢ Äá»“ng há»“ Ä‘o NQH (gauge)
      â€¢ 4 KPI chÃ­nh Ä‘Æ°á»£c format báº±ng utils.py
      â€¢ Thanh chá»‰ sá»‘ sá»©c khá»e tá»•ng há»£p
    """
    st.markdown("## ðŸ¥ Sá»©c Khá»e TÃ­n Dá»¥ng â€” ToÃ n Chi NhÃ¡nh")

    # TÃ­nh chá»‰ sá»‘
    tdn  = df_full[COT_TONG_DU_NO].sum() if COT_TONG_DU_NO in df_full.columns else 0
    dth  = df_full[COT_DU_NO_TH].sum()   if COT_DU_NO_TH   in df_full.columns else 0
    dqh  = df_full[COT_DU_NO_QH].sum()   if COT_DU_NO_QH   in df_full.columns else 0
    tlqh = dqh / tdn * 100 if tdn > 0 else 0.0
    n_hs = len(df_full)
    n_kh = df_full[COT_MA_KH].nunique() if COT_MA_KH in df_full.columns else 0

    mau, tinh_trang, icon = _mau_nqh(tlqh)

    col_gauge, col_kpi = st.columns([2, 3], gap="large")

    with col_gauge:
        _render_gauge_du_no(tlqh=tlqh)

    with col_kpi:
        _render_metric_cards(
            tdn=tdn,
            dth=dth,
            dqh=dqh,
            tlqh=tlqh,
            n_hs=n_hs,
            n_kh=n_kh,
            mau=mau,
            tinh_trang=tinh_trang,
            icon=icon,
        )


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# SECTION 2 â€” Biá»ƒu Ä‘á»“ TÄƒng TrÆ°á»Ÿng & So SÃ¡nh Sá»©c Khá»e TÃ­n Dá»¥ng theo PGD
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
@st.fragment
def _render_heatmap_pgd(**kwargs) -> None:
    """
    Biá»ƒu Ä‘á»“ so sÃ¡nh dÆ° ná»£ vÃ  sá»©c khá»e tÃ­n dá»¥ng giá»¯a cÃ¡c PGD:
      â€¢ Stacked Bar: DÆ° ná»£ trong háº¡n + NQH theo PGD (sáº¯p xáº¿p giáº£m dáº§n)
      â€¢ Scatter: Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£ (x) vs Tá»· lá»‡ NQH (y), kÃ­ch thÆ°á»›c = sá»‘ KH
      â€¢ Báº£ng xáº¿p háº¡ng Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ (expander)
    """
    df_full = kwargs.get("df_full")
    if df_full is None:
        return
    if COT_TEN_PGD not in df_full.columns:
        st.info("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y cá»™t TÃªn PGD â€” khÃ´ng thá»ƒ váº½ biá»ƒu Ä‘á»“ so sÃ¡nh PGD.")
        return

    # Tá»•ng há»£p theo PGD
    t_pgd = (
        df_full.groupby(COT_TEN_PGD)
        .agg(
            Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£=(COT_TONG_DU_NO, "sum"),
            DÆ°_ná»£_TH=(COT_DU_NO_TH, "sum"),
            NQH=(COT_DU_NO_QH, "sum"),
            Sá»‘_KH=(COT_MA_KH, "nunique"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    t_pgd["TL_NQH"] = (t_pgd["NQH"] / t_pgd["Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£"] * 100).round(3).fillna(0)
    t_pgd["TL_TH"]  = (t_pgd["DÆ°_ná»£_TH"] / t_pgd["Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£"] * 100).round(1).fillna(0)
    t_pgd["Tráº¡ng_thÃ¡i"] = t_pgd["TL_NQH"].apply(
        lambda x: "ðŸŸ¢ An toÃ n" if x < _NGUONG_AN_TOAN
        else ("ðŸŸ¡ Cáº§n theo dÃµi" if x < _NGUONG_CANH_BAO else "ðŸ”´ Nguy hiá»ƒm")
    )
    # Sáº¯p xáº¿p tÄƒng dáº§n Ä‘á»ƒ bar náº±m ngang hiá»ƒn thá»‹ Ä‘áº¹p
    t_pgd_sorted = t_pgd.sort_values("Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£", ascending=True)

    st.markdown("## ðŸ“ˆ So SÃ¡nh TÄƒng TrÆ°á»Ÿng & Sá»©c Khá»e TÃ­n Dá»¥ng theo PGD")

    chart_tab_names = ["ðŸ“Š CÆ¡ cáº¥u DÆ° ná»£", "ðŸŽ¯ PhÃ¢n tÃ­ch NQH", "ðŸ“‰ Tá»· lá»‡ NQH theo PGD"]
    nav_ex = "ws_executive_chart_tab"
    if nav_ex not in st.session_state or st.session_state[nav_ex] not in chart_tab_names:
        st.session_state[nav_ex] = chart_tab_names[0]
    st.radio(
        "Biá»ƒu Ä‘á»“ so sÃ¡nh PGD",
        options=chart_tab_names,
        horizontal=True,
        key=nav_ex,
        label_visibility="collapsed",
    )
    _chart_active = st.session_state[nav_ex]
    st.divider()

    # â”€â”€ TAB 1: Stacked Bar DÆ° ná»£ â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    if _chart_active == chart_tab_names[0]:
        chieu_cao = max(350, len(t_pgd) * 44)
        fig_bar = go.Figure()

        fig_bar.add_trace(go.Bar(
            name="DÆ° ná»£ trong háº¡n",
            y=t_pgd_sorted[COT_TEN_PGD],
            x=t_pgd_sorted["DÆ°_ná»£_TH"] / 1e9,
            orientation="h",
            marker_color="#1565C0",
            text=(t_pgd_sorted["DÆ°_ná»£_TH"] / 1e9).apply(
                lambda v: f"{v:,.2f}".replace(",","X").replace(".",",").replace("X",".") + " tá»·"
            ),
            textposition="inside",
            insidetextanchor="middle",
            hovertemplate=(
                "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
                "DÆ° ná»£ trong háº¡n: %{x:,.3f} tá»·<extra></extra>"
            ),
        ))
        fig_bar.add_trace(go.Bar(
            name="Ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n",
            y=t_pgd_sorted[COT_TEN_PGD],
            x=t_pgd_sorted["NQH"] / 1e9,
            orientation="h",
            marker_color="#C62828",
            text=(t_pgd_sorted["NQH"] / 1e9).apply(
                lambda v: (
                    f"{v:,.3f}".replace(",","X").replace(".",",").replace("X",".") + " tá»·"
                    if v >= 1e-3 else ""
                )
            ),
            textposition="inside",
            hovertemplate=(
                "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
                "Ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n: %{x:,.3f} tá»·<extra></extra>"
            ),
        ))
        fig_bar.update_layout(
            barmode="stack",
            height=chieu_cao,
            margin=dict(l=0, r=80, t=20, b=10),
            xaxis_title="Tá»· Ä‘á»“ng",
            yaxis=dict(title=""),
            legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.04, x=0),
            plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
            paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
            font_family="Arial",
        )
        st.plotly_chart(fig_bar, use_container_width=True)
        st.caption(
            "ðŸ“Œ Cá»™t xanh = DÆ° ná»£ trong háº¡n Â· Cá»™t Ä‘á» = Ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n. "
            "Sáº¯p xáº¿p theo Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£ tÄƒng dáº§n."
        )

    # â”€â”€ TAB 2: Scatter Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£ vs NQH â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    elif _chart_active == chart_tab_names[1]:
        fig_sc = px.scatter(
            t_pgd,
            x="Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£",
            y="TL_NQH",
            size="Sá»‘_KH",
            color="Tráº¡ng_thÃ¡i",
            text=COT_TEN_PGD,
            color_discrete_map={
                "ðŸŸ¢ An toÃ n":      "#2e7d32",
                "ðŸŸ¡ Cáº§n theo dÃµi": "#f57f17",
                "ðŸ”´ Nguy hiá»ƒm":    "#c62828",
            },
            hover_data={
                COT_TEN_PGD:    True,
                "Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£":   False,
                "Sá»‘_KH":        True,
                "TL_NQH":       ":.3f",
                "Tráº¡ng_thÃ¡i":   True,
            },
            labels={
                "Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£": "Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£ (Ä‘á»“ng)",
                "TL_NQH":     "Tá»· lá»‡ NQH (%)",
                "Sá»‘_KH":      "Sá»‘ khÃ¡ch hÃ ng",
            },
        )
        fig_sc.add_hline(
            y=_NGUONG_AN_TOAN,
            line_dash="dash",
            line_color="#e65100",
            line_width=2,
            annotation_text=f"âš ï¸ NgÆ°á»¡ng an toÃ n {_NGUONG_AN_TOAN}%",
            annotation_position="bottom right",
        )
        fig_sc.add_hline(
            y=_NGUONG_CANH_BAO,
            line_dash="dot",
            line_color="#c62828",
            line_width=1.5,
            annotation_text=f"ðŸš¨ NgÆ°á»¡ng cáº£nh bÃ¡o {_NGUONG_CANH_BAO}%",
            annotation_position="top right",
        )
        fig_sc.update_traces(
            textposition="top center",

        )
        fig_sc.update_layout(

            xaxis=dict(title="Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£ (Ä‘á»“ng)", tickformat=".3s"),
            yaxis=dict(title="Tá»· lá»‡ NQH (%)"),
            legend=dict(title="Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i", orientation="h", y=-0.18),
            plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
            paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
            font_family="Arial",
        )
        st.plotly_chart(fig_sc, use_container_width=True)
        st.caption(

        )

    # â”€â”€ TAB 3: Bar ngang Tá»· lá»‡ NQH â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    elif _chart_active == chart_tab_names[2]:
        t_nqh = t_pgd.sort_values("TL_NQH", ascending=True)
        mau_bars = [

@st.fragment
def _render_bieu_do_tron(**kwargs) -> None:
    """Biá»ƒu Ä‘á»“ Top 10 chÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh theo dÆ° ná»£ (bar ngang)."""

    t_ct["RÃºt gá»n"] = t_ct["ChÆ°Æ¡ng trÃ¬nh"].apply(
        lambda x: x[:32] + "â€¦" if len(str(x)) > 32 else x

    fig = px.bar(
        t_ct,

        y="RÃºt gá»n",

def _tien_do_ke_hoach() -> None:
    """Biá»ƒu Ä‘á»“ Tiáº¿n Ä‘á»™ Káº¿ hoáº¡ch vs Thá»±c hiá»‡n tá»« Äiá»‡n bÃ¡o."""
    path_ht = DB_HT_CACHE if os.path.exists(DB_HT_CACHE) else FILE_PATH_DB
    kh_data = doc_kehoach()

    if not (os.path.exists(path_ht) and kh_data):
        st.info("Upload file Äiá»‡n bÃ¡o & nháº­p Káº¿ hoáº¡ch trong tab âš–ï¸ vÃ  ðŸŽ¯ Ä‘á»ƒ xem tiáº¿n Ä‘á»™.")
        return

    db_rows = doc_dienbao(path_ht, ts_file(path_ht))
    CT_QUAN_TRONG = [
        "Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£", "DÆ° ná»£ Káº¿ hoáº¡ch A", "DÆ° ná»£ Káº¿ hoáº¡ch B",
        "Tá»•ng huy Ä‘á»™ng vá»‘n", "Nguá»“n vá»‘n cÃ¢n Ä‘á»‘i tá»« TW (KHA)",
    ]
    rows_kh = []
    for ten in CT_QUAN_TRONG:
        th  = db_lookup(db_rows, ten)

        rows_kh.append({"Chá»‰ tiÃªu": ten, "Káº¿ hoáº¡ch": kh, "Thá»±c hiá»‡n": th, "Tá»· lá»‡ %": tl})
    df_kh = pd.DataFrame(rows_kh)
    fig = px.bar(
        df_kh,
        x="Tá»· lá»‡ %",
        y="Chá»‰ tiÃªu",
        orientation="h",
        text=df_kh["Tá»· lá»‡ %"].apply(lambda x: f"{x:.1f}%"),
        color="Tá»· lá»‡ %",
        color_continuous_scale="RdYlGn",
        range_color=[0, 120],
    )
    fig.add_vline(x=100, line_dash="dash", line_color="green", line_width=2,
                  annotation_text="100%")
    fig.update_traces(textposition="outside")
    fig.update_layout(
        height=290,
        margin=dict(l=0, r=70, t=10, b=10),
        xaxis=dict(title="Tá»· lá»‡ thá»±c hiá»‡n (%)", range=[0, 140]),
        yaxis=dict(title="", autorange="reversed"),
        coloraxis_showscale=False,
        plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        font_family="Arial",
    )
    st.plotly_chart(fig, use_container_width=True)

# SECTION 4 â€” Cáº£nh bÃ¡o NQH tÄƒng Ä‘á»™t biáº¿n theo XÃ£
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
def _canh_bao_xa_nqh(df_full: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    """PhÃ¡t hiá»‡n vÃ  hiá»ƒn thá»‹ xÃ£/phÆ°á»ng cÃ³ tá»· lá»‡ NQH vÆ°á»£t ngÆ°á»¡ng."""
    if _COT_XA not in df_full.columns or COT_DU_NO_QH not in df_full.columns:
        st.info("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y cá»™t TÃªn xÃ£ hoáº·c DÆ° ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n trong dá»¯ liá»‡u.")
        return

    t_xa = df_full.groupby(_COT_XA).agg(
        Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£=(COT_TONG_DU_NO, "sum"),
        NQH=(COT_DU_NO_QH, "sum"),
        Sá»‘_KH=(COT_MA_KH, "nunique"),
    ).reset_index()
    t_xa["TL_NQH_%"] = (t_xa["NQH"] / t_xa["Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£"] * 100).round(3).fillna(0)

    canh_bao = t_xa[t_xa["TL_NQH_%"] >= _NGUONG_XA_NQH].sort_values("TL_NQH_%", ascending=False)

    if canh_bao.empty:
        st.success(f"âœ… Táº¥t cáº£ xÃ£/phÆ°á»ng cÃ³ tá»· lá»‡ NQH dÆ°á»›i ngÆ°á»¡ng {_NGUONG_XA_NQH}%")
        return

    st.error(f"ðŸš¨ PhÃ¡t hiá»‡n **{len(canh_bao)}** xÃ£/phÆ°á»ng cÃ³ tá»· lá»‡ NQH â‰¥ {_NGUONG_XA_NQH}%")
    df_cb = canh_bao.copy()
    df_cb["Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£"] = df_cb["Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£"].fillna(0).apply(_fmt)
    df_cb["NQH"]         = df_cb["NQH"].fillna(0).apply(_fmt)
    df_cb["TL_NQH_%"]    = df_cb["TL_NQH_%"].apply(lambda x: f"{x:.3f}%")
    hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang(
        df_cb[[_COT_XA, "Sá»‘_KH", "Tá»•ng_dÆ°_ná»£", "NQH", "TL_NQH_%"]],
        key="exec_canh_bao_xa_nqh",
    )

    top_xa = canh_bao.nlargest(min(10, len(canh_bao)), "TL_NQH_%")
    fig = px.bar(
        top_xa,
        x="TL_NQH_%",
        y=_COT_XA,
        orientation="h",
        color="TL_NQH_%",
        color_continuous_scale="Reds",
        text=top_xa["TL_NQH_%"].apply(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}%"),
    )
    fig.add_vline(x=_NGUONG_XA_NQH, line_dash="dash", line_color="red",
                  annotation_text=f"NgÆ°á»¡ng {_NGUONG_XA_NQH}%")
    fig.update_traces(textposition="outside")
    fig.update_layout(
        height=320,
        margin=dict(l=0, r=70, t=10, b=10),
        xaxis_title="Tá»· lá»‡ NQH (%)",
        yaxis=dict(title="", autorange="reversed"),
        coloraxis_showscale=False,
        plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        font_family="Arial",
    )
    st.plotly_chart(fig, use_container_width=True)


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# SECTION 5 â€” Cáº£nh bÃ¡o PhÃ¢n loáº¡i ná»£ Migration
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
def _canh_bao_migration(df_full: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    """Cáº£nh bÃ¡o mÃ³n vay Äá»§ tiÃªu chuáº©n (E) cÃ³ nguy cÆ¡ chuyá»ƒn sang NQH."""
    if df_full is None or len(df_full) == 0:
        st.info("ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u HSTD Ä‘á»ƒ phÃ¢n tÃ­ch.")
        return

    df_mg = canh_bao_migration(df_full)
    if df_mg.empty:
        st.success("âœ… KhÃ´ng cÃ³ mÃ³n vay nÃ o cÃ³ dáº¥u hiá»‡u rá»§i ro chuyá»ƒn NQH.")
        return

    n_khan = len(df_mg[df_mg["muc_canh_bao"].str.startswith("ðŸ”´")])
    n_cb   = len(df_mg) - n_khan
    tong_lai = df_mg[COT_LAI_TON].sum() if COT_LAI_TON in df_mg.columns else 0

    c1, c2, c3 = st.columns(3)
    c1.metric(
        "ðŸ”´ Kháº©n cáº¥p (â‰¥2.5 thÃ¡ng)", f"{n_khan:,} mÃ³n",
        delta="Cáº§n xá»­ lÃ½ ngay" if n_khan > 0 else None,
        delta_color="inverse",
    )
    c2.metric("âš ï¸ Cáº£nh bÃ¡o (1â€“2.5 thÃ¡ng)", f"{n_cb:,} mÃ³n")
    c3.metric("Tá»•ng lÃ£i tá»“n rá»§i ro", fmt_ty(tong_lai))

    if COT_TEN_PGD in df_mg.columns:
        top5 = (
            df_mg.groupby(COT_TEN_PGD)
            .agg(Sá»‘_mÃ³n=(COT_SO_KU, "nunique"), LÃ£i_tá»“n=(COT_LAI_TON, "sum"))
            .sort_values("Sá»‘_mÃ³n", ascending=False)
            .head(5)
            .reset_index()
        )
        top5["LÃ£i_tá»“n_tr"] = (top5["LÃ£i_tá»“n"] / 1e6).round(1)
        st.markdown("**Top 5 PGD cÃ³ nhiá»u mÃ³n vay rá»§i ro nháº¥t:**")
        hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang(
            top5[[COT_TEN_PGD, "Sá»‘_mÃ³n", "LÃ£i_tá»“n_tr"]].rename(columns={
                COT_TEN_PGD:    "PGD",
                "Sá»‘_mÃ³n":       "Sá»‘ mÃ³n rá»§i ro",
                "LÃ£i_tá»“n_tr":  "LÃ£i tá»“n (triá»‡u Ä‘)",
            }),
            key="exec_migration_top5_pgd",
        )


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# ENTRY POINT â€” render()
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
def render(**kwargs) -> None:
    """
    Äiá»ƒm vÃ o cá»§a Workspace LÃ£nh Ä‘áº¡o.

    Params (qua kwargs)
    â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    df      : DataFrame Ä‘Ã£ lá»c theo PGD/xÃ£ Ä‘ang chá»n (sidebar)
    df_full : DataFrame toÃ n chi nhÃ¡nh (khÃ´ng lá»c) â€” dÃ¹ng cho KPI tá»•ng
    """
    df      = kwargs.get("df")
    df_full = kwargs.get("df_full", df)

    # â”€â”€ Header â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    st.title("ðŸ“Š Tá»•ng Quan Chi NhÃ¡nh")
    if df_full is not None and COT_NGAY_SL in df_full.columns:
        sl = df_full[COT_NGAY_SL].dropna()
        if len(sl):
            st.caption(
                f"ðŸ“… Sá»‘ liá»‡u ngÃ y: **{sl.iloc[0]}** Â· "
                f"{fmt_so(len(df_full))} há»“ sÆ¡ toÃ n há»‡ thá»‘ng"
            )

    if df_full is None or df_full.empty:
        st.warning("âš ï¸ ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u HSTD. Vui lÃ²ng upload file trong tab Quáº£n trá»‹.")
        return

    role = kwargs.get("role", "executive")
    username = kwargs.get("username", "unknown")

    tab_phan_tich, tab_kiem_soat_cn, tab_no_rui_ro_cn = st.tabs(
        ["ðŸ“Š PhÃ¢n tÃ­ch & cáº£nh bÃ¡o", "ðŸ” Kiá»ƒm soÃ¡t CN", "ðŸ’³ Ná»£ rá»§i ro QÄ62"]
    )

    with tab_phan_tich:
        # â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• 1. Sá»¨C KHá»ŽE TÃN Dá»¤NG â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
        _the_suc_khoe(df_full)

        st.divider()

        # â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• 2. TÄ‚NG TRÆ¯á»žNG & SO SÃNH PGD â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

def _tim_cot(df: pd.DataFrame, *cac_ten: str) -> str | None:
    """Tim cot trong DataFrame voi fuzzy matching (Unicode NFC/NFD)."""
    if not cac_ten:
        return None
    for ten in cac_ten:
        if ten in df.columns:
            return ten
    ten_dau = cac_ten[0]
    import unicodedata
    for c in df.columns:
        if unicodedata.normalize("NFC", c) == unicodedata.normalize("NFC", ten_dau):
            return c
        if ten_dau.lower() in c.lower() or c.lower() in ten_dau.lower():
            return c
    return cac_ten[0] if cac_ten[0] in df.columns else None


def _hien_thi_nqh_tab(df_kh: pd.DataFrame, username: str):
    """Sub-tab: No qua han phat sinh - pre-filter NQH, bo loc thoi gian bang Ngay so lieu."""

    cot_nqh = _tim_cot(df_kh, "D\u01b0 n\u1ee3 qu\u00e1 h\u1ea1n", "N\u1ee3 qu\u00e1 h\u1ea1n")
    cot_ngay_sl = _tim_cot(df_kh, "Ng\u00e0y s\u1ed1 li\u1ec7u")

    if cot_nqh and cot_nqh in df_kh.columns:
        mask_nqh = pd.to_numeric(df_kh[cot_nqh], errors="coerce").fillna(0) > 0
        df_nqh_all = df_kh[mask_nqh].copy()
    else:
        st.warning("Khong tim thay cot du no qua han trong du lieu.")
        df_nqh_all = pd.DataFrame()

    if df_nqh_all.empty:
        st.success("Khong co no qua han phat sinh.")
        return

    # Kiem tra CQH columns co gia tri > 0 khong
    cot_cqh_thang = _tim_cot(df_nqh_all, "Chuy\u1ec3n QH trong th\u00e1ng", "Chuy\u1ec3n n\u1ee3 QH trong th\u00e1ng")
    co_cqh = False
    if cot_cqh_thang and cot_cqh_thang in df_nqh_all.columns:
        if pd.to_numeric(df_nqh_all[cot_cqh_thang], errors="coerce").fillna(0).sum() > 0:
            co_cqh = True

    # Xay dung tuy chon loc
    lua_chon = {}
    if co_cqh:
        lua_chon["Trong thang"] = ("cqh", cot_cqh_thang)
    if cot_ngay_sl and cot_ngay_sl in df_nqh_all.columns:
        lua_chon["Ky hien tai"] = ("date", cot_ngay_sl)
    lua_chon["Toan thoi gian"] = ("all", None)

    ds_lua_chon = list(lua_chon.keys())
    mac_dinh = 0 if co_cqh else (ds_lua_chon.index("Toan thoi gian") if "Toan thoi gian" in ds_lua_chon else 0)

    chon = st.radio(
        "Loc theo thoi gian",
        ds_lua_chon,
        index=mac_dinh,
        horizontal=True,
        key="nqh_loc_tg",
    )
    loai_loc, cot_loc = lua_chon[chon]

    # Ap dung loc
    df_nqh = df_nqh_all.copy()
    if loai_loc == "cqh" and cot_loc and cot_loc in df_nqh.columns:
        mask_cqh = pd.to_numeric(df_nqh[cot_loc], errors="coerce").fillna(0) > 0
        df_nqh = df_nqh[mask_cqh]
    elif loai_loc == "date" and cot_ngay_sl and cot_ngay_sl in df_nqh.columns:
        ngay_sl = pd.to_datetime(df_nqh[cot_ngay_sl], errors="coerce")
        from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta
        moc = ngay_sl.max()
        if pd.notna(moc):
            dau_ky = moc - relativedelta(months=1)
            df_nqh = df_nqh[ngay_sl >= dau_ky]

    if df_nqh.empty:
        st.info("Khong co ho so NQH trong ky da chon. Chon 'Toan thoi gian' de xem tat ca.")
        return

    # Metrics
    tong_nqh = df_nqh[cot_nqh].sum() if cot_nqh and cot_nqh in df_nqh.columns else 0
    cot_tong_dn = _tim_cot(df_nqh, "T\u1ed5ng d\u01b0 n\u1ee3")
    tong_dn = df_nqh[cot_tong_dn].sum() if cot_tong_dn and cot_tong_dn in df_nqh.columns else 0
    cot_so_ku = _tim_cot(df_nqh, "S\u1ed1 kh\u1ebf \u01b0\u1edbc")

    k1, k2, k3 = st.columns(3)
    k1.metric("So ho so NQH", fmt_so(len(df_nqh)))
    k2.metric("Du no QH", fmt_ty(tong_nqh) if tong_nqh else "0")
    k3.metric("Ty le NQH", f"{tong_nqh / tong_dn * 100:.2f}%" if tong_dn else "0%")

    # Tong hop theo PGD
    cot_pgd = _tim_cot(df_nqh, "T\u00ean PGD")
    if cot_pgd and cot_pgd in df_nqh.columns:
        agg_cols = {}
        if cot_so_ku:
            agg_cols["So_ho_so_NQH"] = (cot_so_ku, "nunique")
        if cot_nqh and cot_nqh in df_nqh.columns:
            agg_cols["Tong_du_no_QH"] = (cot_nqh, "sum")
        if cot_tong_dn:
            agg_cols["Tong_du_no"] = (cot_tong_dn, "sum")
        if agg_cols:
            nqh_pgd = df_nqh.groupby(cot_pgd, dropna=False).agg(**agg_cols).reset_index()
            if "Tong_du_no" in nqh_pgd.columns:
                tdn_nqh = nqh_pgd["Tong_du_no"].replace(0, pd.NA)
                nqh_pgd["Ty_le_QH_pct"] = (nqh_pgd["Tong_du_no_QH"] / tdn_nqh * 100).round(1).fillna(0)
            st.markdown("**Tong hop theo PGD**")
            hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang(nqh_pgd, key="nqh_pgd", height=280)

    # Chi tiet
    cols_mong_muon = [
        cot_pgd, "T\u00ean KH", cot_so_ku, "T\u00ean ch\u01b0\u01a1ng tr\u00ecnh",
        cot_nqh, cot_tong_dn,
        "Ng\u00e0y \u0110H theo h\u1ee3p \u0111\u1ed3ng", "Ng\u00e0y \u0110H theo Gia h\u1ea1n", "Ng\u00e0y \u0110H theo GDXA",
    ]
    cols_chi = [c for c in cols_mong_muon if c and c in df_nqh.columns]
    df_nqh_chi = df_nqh[cols_chi].reset_index(drop=True)

    st.markdown("**Danh sach chi tiet**")
    buf = xuat_excel({"NQH": df_nqh_chi})
    st.download_button(
        f"Xuat Excel ({len(df_nqh_chi)} ho so)", data=buf,
        file_name=f"DS_NQH_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.xlsx",
        mime="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
        key="nqh_xuat",
    )
    hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang(df_nqh_chi, key="nqh_chi", height=360)

def _render_dgd_to_tkvv(tab_parent, **kw):

def _render_ndt_dp(role: str, username: str) -> None:
    """Tab quáº£n lÃ½ MÃ£ NhÃ  Ä‘áº§u tÆ° Äá»‹a phÆ°Æ¡ng â€” dÃ¹ng phÃ¢n táº§ng GQVL ÄP."""
    from db import doc_ndt_dp_list, ghi_kv, ghi_audit

    st.subheader("ðŸ¦ MÃ£ NhÃ  Ä‘áº§u tÆ° Äá»‹a phÆ°Æ¡ng â€” Cáº¥p tá»‰nh")
    st.caption(
        "Danh sÃ¡ch nÃ y dÃ¹ng Ä‘á»ƒ phÃ¢n loáº¡i nguá»“n vá»‘n ÄP trong file GQVL. "
        "MÃ³n vay nÃ o cÃ³ MÃ£ NÄT khá»›p chÃ­nh xÃ¡c (exact match) vá»›i 1 mÃ£ trong "
        "danh sÃ¡ch â†’ xáº¿p vÃ o GQVL ÄP Cáº¥p tá»‰nh. CÃ²n láº¡i â†’ Cáº¥p xÃ£/khÃ¡c."
    )

    ds = doc_ndt_dp_list()   # list[dict] {"ma", "ghi_chu"}
    can_edit = role in ("admin", "admin_cn")

    # Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ báº£ng hiá»‡n táº¡i
    if ds:
        for i, item in enumerate(ds):
            c1, c2, c3 = st.columns([3, 4, 1])
            c1.code(item["ma"])
            c2.text(item.get("ghi_chu", ""))
            if can_edit:
                if c3.button("ðŸ—‘ï¸", key=f"xoa_ndt_{i}",
                             disabled=(len(ds) <= 1),
                             help="KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a mÃ£ duy nháº¥t"):
                    ds_moi = [x for j, x in enumerate(ds) if j != i]
                    ghi_kv("ndt_dp_list", ds_moi, username)
                    ghi_audit(username, "xoa_ndt_dp",
                              f"XÃ³a mÃ£ {item['ma']}")
                    st.cache_data.clear()
                    st.rerun()
    else:
        st.info("ChÆ°a cÃ³ mÃ£ nÃ o.")

    if not can_edit:
        st.caption("âš ï¸ Chá»‰ admin má»›i cÃ³ thá»ƒ thÃªm/xÃ³a.")
        return

    # Form thÃªm má»›i
    st.divider()
    st.markdown("##### âž• ThÃªm mÃ£ má»›i")
    with st.form("form_them_ndt", clear_on_submit=True):
        ma_moi = st.text_input(
            "MÃ£ NÄT Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§",
            placeholder="VD: INV0802140002662",
            help="Láº¥y chÃ­nh xÃ¡c tá»« cá»™t 'MÃ£ nhÃ  Ä‘áº§u tÆ°' trong file GQVL"
        )
        ghi_chu_moi = st.text_input(
            "Ghi chÃº",
            placeholder="VD: UBND tá»‰nh Äá»“ng Nai"
        )
        submitted = st.form_submit_button("âž• ThÃªm", type="primary")

    if submitted:
        ma_moi = ma_moi.strip()
        if not ma_moi:
            st.error("Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p mÃ£ NÄT.")
        elif any(x["ma"] == ma_moi for x in ds):
            st.warning(f"MÃ£ {ma_moi} Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³ trong danh sÃ¡ch.")
        else:
            ds_moi = ds + [{"ma": ma_moi, "ghi_chu": ghi_chu_moi.strip()}]
            ghi_kv("ndt_dp_list", ds_moi, username)
            ghi_audit(username, "them_ndt_dp",
                      f"ThÃªm mÃ£ {ma_moi} â€” {ghi_chu_moi}")
            st.cache_data.clear()
            st.success(f"âœ… ÄÃ£ thÃªm mÃ£ {ma_moi}")
            st.rerun()

    # TAB 1: UPLOAD MáºªU Má»šI

    # TAB 2: DANH SÃCH TEMPLATE
    # â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
    with tab_danh_sach:

                    'NgÃ y sá»­a': datetime.fromtimestamp(file_stat.st_mtime).strftime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M"),
                    'ÄÆ°á»ng dáº«n': str(file_path)
                })
            
            df_templates = pd.DataFrame(template_data)
            hien_thi_dataframe_phan_trang(

            with col_chon:

    # â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
    # TAB 3: TEST TEMPLATE
    # â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
    with tab_test:
        st.markdown("**ðŸ§ª Test Template vá»›i dá»¯ liá»‡u máº«u**")
        
        if df is None or df.empty:
            st.warning("âš ï¸ KhÃ´ng cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u HSTD Ä‘á»ƒ test. HÃ£y upload dá»¯ liá»‡u trÆ°á»›c.")
            return
        
        templates = quet_templates(TEMPLATES_DIR)
        if not templates:
            st.info("ðŸ“­ KhÃ´ng cÃ³ template Ä‘á»ƒ test.")
            return
        
        # Chá»n template vÃ  há»“ sÆ¡
        col_template, col_hoso = st.columns(2)
        
        with col_template:
            chon_template = st.selectbox(
                "Chá»n Template",
                options=[t[0] for t in templates],
                key="test_template_select"
            )
        
        with col_hoso:
            # Láº¥y 10 há»“ sÆ¡ Ä‘áº§u lÃ m máº«u
            df_sample = df.head(10) if len(df) >= 10 else df
            ds_khach_hang = [
                f"{row.get(COT_MA_KH, 'N/A')} - {row.get(COT_TEN_KH, 'KhÃ´ng tÃªn')[:20]}"
                for _, row in df_sample.iterrows()
            ]
            
            chon_hoso = st.selectbox(
                "Chá»n há»“ sÆ¡ test",
                options=ds_khach_hang,
                key="test_hoso_select"
            )
        
        # Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ thÃ´ng tin há»“ sÆ¡ Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»n
        idx_hoso = ds_khach_hang.index(chon_hoso)
        row_test = df_sample.iloc[idx_hoso]
        
        with st.expander("ðŸ“„ ThÃ´ng tin há»“ sÆ¡ test", expanded=True):
            col1, col2 = st.columns(2)
            with col1:
                st.write(f"**MÃ£ KH:** {row_test.get(COT_MA_KH, 'N/A')}")
                st.write(f"**TÃªn KH:** {row_test.get(COT_TEN_KH, 'N/A')}")
                st.write(f"**Sá»‘ khoáº£n vay:** {row_test.get(COT_SO_KU, 'N/A')}")
                st.write(f"**Má»©c vay:** {fmt(row_test.get(COT_MUC_VAY, 0))} Ä‘á»“ng")
            with col2:
                st.write(f"**DÆ° ná»£:** {fmt(row_test.get(COT_TONG_DU_NO, 0))} Ä‘á»“ng")
                st.write(f"**NgÃ y vay:** {row_test.get(COT_NGAY_VAY, 'N/A')}")
                st.write(f"**Thá»i háº¡n:** {row_test.get(COT_THOI_HAN, 'N/A')} thÃ¡ng")
                st.write(f"**LÃ£i suáº¥t:** {row_test.get(COT_LAI_SUAT, 'N/A')}%")
        
        # NÃºt test

def _init_gb2_session_for_doc_hub(kwargs: dict) -> None:
    """
    Khá»Ÿi táº¡o st.session_state gb2_xa / gb2_nam Ä‘á»ƒ tab ThÃ´ng bÃ¡o KL
    dÃ¹ng chung lá»±a chá»n vá»›i tab BiÃªn báº£n (cÃ¹ng key widget).
    """
    from config import (
        danh_sach_nam_baseline,
        danh_sach_nam_baseline_pgd,
    )

    df = kwargs.get("df")
    role = kwargs.get("role")
    pgd_user = kwargs.get("pgd_user")
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return
    if is_pgd_role(role) and pgd_user and COT_TEN_PGD in df.columns:
        df = df[df[COT_TEN_PGD] == pgd_user].copy()
    if "TÃªn xÃ£" not in df.columns:
        return
    ds_xa = sorted(df["TÃªn xÃ£"].dropna().unique().tolist())
    if not ds_xa:
        return
    if "gb2_xa" not in st.session_state or st.session_state.gb2_xa not in ds_xa:
        st.session_state.gb2_xa = ds_xa[0]
    ds_nam = danh_sach_nam_baseline_pgd() or danh_sach_nam_baseline()
    if ds_nam and (
        "gb2_nam" not in st.session_state or st.session_state.gb2_nam not in ds_nam
    ):
        st.session_state.gb2_nam = ds_nam[0]


def _render_thong_bao_ket_luan(tab, **kwargs):
    """Tab xuáº¥t ThÃ´ng bÃ¡o Káº¿t luáº­n giao ban (NÄ30) â€” dÃ¹ng gb2_xa / gb2_nam tá»« tab BiÃªn báº£n."""

        DON_VI_CHI_NHANH,
    )

            df = df[df[COT_TEN_PGD] == pgd_user].copy()

        default_xa = st.session_state.get("gb2_xa", ds_xa[0] if ds_xa else None)

        col_a, col_b = st.columns(2)

                help="Máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh lÃ  tÃªn xÃ£, chá»‰nh láº¡i náº¿u khÃ¡c",
            )
            tb_ngay = st.date_input("NgÃ y há»p", value=date.today(), key="tb_ngay_hop")
        with col_b:
            st.info(
                f"ðŸ“Š Sá»‘ liá»‡u tá»± Ä‘á»™ng tá»« HSTD\n\n"
                f"**XÃ£:** {chon_xa}  \n"
                f"**ThÃ¡ng:** {date.today().month}/{date.today().year}"
            )

        tb_cs = st.text_area(
            "I. ChÃ­nh sÃ¡ch má»›i trong thÃ¡ng",
            placeholder="Äá»ƒ trá»‘ng náº¿u khÃ´ng cÃ³ chÃ­nh sÃ¡ch má»›i...",
            height=100,
            key="tb_chinh_sach",
        )
        tb_tt = st.text_area(
            "II.2 Tá»“n táº¡i, háº¡n cháº¿",
            placeholder="NÃªu cá»¥ thá»ƒ tá»“n táº¡i cá»§a Há»™i, Tá»•, khÃ¡ch hÃ ng...",
            height=120,
            key="tb_ton_tai",
        )
        tb_nv = st.text_area(
            "III. Nhiá»‡m vá»¥ thÃ¡ng tiáº¿p theo",
            placeholder="Káº¿ hoáº¡ch kiá»ƒm tra, xá»­ lÃ½ ná»£ xáº¥u, ná»™i dung khÃ¡c...",
            height=120,
            key="tb_nhiem_vu",
        )

        if st.button("ðŸ–¨ï¸ Xuáº¥t ThÃ´ng bÃ¡o Káº¿t luáº­n Word", type="primary", key="tb_xuat"):
            df_xa_tb = df[df["TÃªn xÃ£"] == chon_xa].copy()
            try:
                data = xuat_thong_bao_ket_luan_giao_ban(
                    df_xa=df_xa_tb,
                    ten_pgd=pgd_user or "",
                    ten_xa=chon_xa,
                    ten_dgd=tb_dgd or chon_xa,
                    thang_bao_cao=date.today().month,
                    nam_bao_cao=date.today().year,
                    ngay_hop=tb_ngay.strftime("%d/%m/%Y"),
                    chinh_sach_moi=tb_cs,
                    ton_tai_han_che=tb_tt,
                    nhiem_vu_tiep=tb_nv,
                    df_baseline=df_bl,
                    nam_moc=chon_nam or date.today().year - 1,
                )
                ten_file = (
                    f"TB_KetLuan_{chon_xa.replace(' ', '_')}"
                    f"_{date.today().strftime('%m%Y')}.docx"
                )
                st.session_state["tb_data"] = data
                st.session_state["tb_ten_file"] = ten_file
                st.success("âœ… ÄÃ£ táº¡o ThÃ´ng bÃ¡o Káº¿t luáº­n! Nháº¥n nÃºt bÃªn dÆ°á»›i Ä‘á»ƒ táº£i vá».")

            except Exception as e:
                st.error(f"âŒ Lá»—i táº¡o file: {e}")

        if st.session_state.get("tb_data"):
            st.download_button(
                "â¬‡ï¸ Táº£i vá» Word",
                data=st.session_state["tb_data"],
                file_name=st.session_state["tb_ten_file"],
                mime="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument"
                ".wordprocessingml.document",
                key="tb_dl_word",
            )

        if st.session_state.get("tb_data") and st.button("ðŸ“„ Xuáº¥t PDF", type="secondary", key="tb_xuat_pdf"):
            try:
                import tempfile, os
                from docx2pdf import convert
                data_pdf = st.session_state["tb_data"]
                ten_file_pdf = st.session_state["tb_ten_file"]
                with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".docx", delete=False) as tmp:
                    tmp.write(data_pdf)
                    tmp_path = tmp.name
                pdf_path = tmp_path.replace(".docx", ".pdf")
                convert(tmp_path, pdf_path)
                with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
                    pdf_bytes = f.read()
                os.unlink(tmp_path)
                os.unlink(pdf_path)
                ten_pdf = ten_file_pdf.replace(".docx", ".pdf")
                st.session_state["_tb_pdf_bytes"] = pdf_bytes
                st.session_state["_tb_pdf_file"] = ten_pdf
            except ImportError:
                st.warning("âš ï¸ ChÆ°a cÃ i docx2pdf. Cháº¡y: pip install docx2pdf")
                st.info("ðŸ’¡ Má»Ÿ file Word rá»“i chá»n **Save As â†’ PDF** thá»§ cÃ´ng.")
                st.session_state["_tb_pdf_bytes"] = None
            except Exception as _e_pdf:
                st.error(f"âŒ Lá»—i chuyá»ƒn PDF: {_e_pdf}")
                st.session_state["_tb_pdf_bytes"] = None

        if st.session_state.get("_tb_pdf_bytes"):
            st.download_button(
                "â¬‡ï¸ Táº£i vá» PDF",
                data=st.session_state["_tb_pdf_bytes"],
                file_name=st.session_state.get("_tb_pdf_file", "output.pdf"),
                mime="application/pdf",
                key="tb_dl_pdf",
            )


def _render_bien_ban_giao_ban(tab, **kwargs):
    ctx = tab if tab is not None else st
    from config import (danh_sach_nam_baseline, baseline_path, TEMPLATES_DIR,
                        baseline_pgd_path, danh_sach_nam_baseline_pgd,
                        trang_thai_baseline_pgd, DON_VI_CHI_NHANH)
    from data.hstd import doc_baseline_merged
    from data.giao_ban import xuat_bien_ban_giao_ban
    from datetime import date

    df = kwargs.get("df")
    pgd_user = kwargs.get("pgd_user")
    role = kwargs.get("role")

    if df is not None and not df.empty and is_pgd_role(role) and pgd_user and COT_TEN_PGD in df.columns:
        df = df[df[COT_TEN_PGD] == pgd_user].copy()

    with ctx:
        st.subheader("ðŸ“‹ BiÃªn báº£n há»p giao ban xÃ£")

        if df is None or df.empty:
            st.warning("ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u HSTD.")
            return

        # 1. Chá»n xÃ£ thuá»™c PGD
        ds_xa = sorted(df["TÃªn xÃ£"].dropna().unique().tolist())
        chon_xa = st.selectbox("Chá»n xÃ£ / Ä‘iá»ƒm giao dá»‹ch", ds_xa,
                               key="gb2_xa")

        # 2. Chá»n nÄƒm má»‘c so sÃ¡nh â€” dÃ¹ng doc_baseline_merged() Ä‘á»ƒ tá»•ng há»£p tá»« 22 Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹
        ds_nam = danh_sach_nam_baseline_pgd()
        if not ds_nam:
            ds_nam = danh_sach_nam_baseline()  # fallback nÄƒm cÅ©
        if not ds_nam:
            st.info("â„¹ï¸ ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u má»‘c 31/12. "
                    "Váº«n xuáº¥t Ä‘Æ°á»£c â€” cá»™t so sÃ¡nh Ä‘áº§u nÄƒm sáº½ trá»‘ng.")
            chon_nam = None
            df_bl = None
        else:
            chon_nam = st.selectbox(
                "So sÃ¡nh vá»›i má»‘c nÄƒm", ds_nam,
                format_func=lambda n: f"31/12/{n}",
                key="gb2_nam")
            # Äá»c dá»¯ liá»‡u Ä‘Ã£ merge tá»« táº¥t cáº£ Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹
            fp_check = baseline_pgd_path(DON_VI_CHI_NHANH if not pgd_user else pgd_user, chon_nam)
            _ts = os.path.getmtime(fp_check) if os.path.exists(fp_check) else 0
            df_bl = doc_baseline_merged(chon_nam, _ts=_ts)

        # 3. Nháº­p giáº£i ngÃ¢n (tuá»³ chá»n)
        with st.expander("âœï¸ Nháº­p káº¿ hoáº¡ch giáº£i ngÃ¢n thÃ¡ng tá»›i (tuá»³ chá»n)"):
            st.caption("Äá»ƒ trá»‘ng náº¿u chÆ°a cÃ³ káº¿ hoáº¡ch.")
            gn_tong = st.number_input(
                "Tá»•ng giáº£i ngÃ¢n dá»± kiáº¿n (triá»‡u Ä‘á»“ng)", min_value=0.0,
                step=1.0, key="gb2_gn")
            # ÄÆ¡n giáº£n: nháº­p 1 sá»‘ tá»•ng â€” code Ä‘iá»n vÃ o dÃ²ng Cá»™ng
            # Náº¿u sau nÃ y cáº§n chi tiáº¿t theo Tá»• thÃ¬ má»Ÿ rá»™ng thÃªm

        # 4. Xuáº¥t
        template = str(TEMPLATES_DIR / "BB_giao_ban_xa_template.docx")
        if not os.path.exists(template):
            st.error("ChÆ°a cÃ³ file template BB_giao_ban_xa_template.docx "
                     "trong thÆ° má»¥c templates/")
            return

        if st.button("ðŸ–¨ï¸ Xuáº¥t BiÃªn báº£n Word", type="primary", key="gb2_xuat"):
            df_xa = df[df["TÃªn xÃ£"] == chon_xa].copy()
            gn_input = {"__tong__": gn_tong * 1_000_000} if gn_tong > 0 else None
            try:
                data = xuat_bien_ban_giao_ban(
                    df_xa=df_xa,
                    df_baseline=df_bl,
                    nam_moc=chon_nam or date.today().year - 1,
                    template_path=template,
                    giai_ngan_input=gn_input,
                )
                thang = date.today().strftime("%m%Y")
                ten_file = f"BB_GiaoBan_{chon_xa.replace(' ','_')}_{thang}.docx"
                st.session_state["_bytes_gb2"] = data
                st.session_state["_file_gb2"] = ten_file
                st.success("âœ… ÄÃ£ táº¡o biÃªn báº£n! Nháº¥n nÃºt bÃªn dÆ°á»›i Ä‘á»ƒ táº£i vá».")
            except Exception as e:
                st.error(f"âŒ Lá»—i xuáº¥t file: {e}")
                st.exception(e)

        if st.session_state.get("_bytes_gb2"):
            st.download_button(
                "â¬‡ï¸ Táº£i vá» Word",
                data=st.session_state["_bytes_gb2"],
                file_name=st.session_state["_file_gb2"],
                mime="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument"
                     ".wordprocessingml.document",
                key="gb2_dl_word",
            )


def _render_bao_cao_giao_ban(tab, **kwargs):
    """
    Render tab BÃ¡o cÃ¡o Giao ban - táº¡o bÃ¡o cÃ¡o tá»•ng há»£p theo xÃ£ vá»›i báº£ng tÃ³m táº¯t theo ÄVUT.
    """
    ctx = tab if tab is not None else st
    with ctx:
        st.subheader("ðŸ“ BÃ¡o cÃ¡o Giao ban")
        st.caption("Tá»•ng há»£p tÃ¬nh hÃ¬nh dÆ° ná»£, cho vay, thu ná»£ theo ÄVUT vÃ  XÃ£")
        
        df = kwargs.get("df")
        pgd_user = kwargs.get("pgd_user")
        role = kwargs.get("role")
        
        if df is None or df.empty:
            st.warning("ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u HSTD.")
            return
        
        # â‘  Bá»™ lá»c
        st.markdown("**â‘  Bá»™ lá»c dá»¯ liá»‡u**")
        
        # Lá»c theo PGD
        df_filtered = df.copy()
        if is_pgd_role(role) and pgd_user:
            if COT_TEN_PGD in df.columns:
                df_filtered = df[df[COT_TEN_PGD] == pgd_user].copy()
            st.info(f"Dá»¯ liá»‡u Ä‘Ã£ lá»c theo PGD: **{pgd_user}**")
        elif is_cn_role(role):
            if COT_TEN_PGD in df.columns:
                ds_pgd = sorted(df[COT_TEN_PGD].dropna().unique().tolist())
                if ds_pgd:
                    chon_pgd = st.selectbox("Chá»n PhÃ²ng Giao dá»‹ch", ds_pgd, key="gb_pgd")
                    df_filtered = df[df[COT_TEN_PGD] == chon_pgd].copy()
        
        # Chá»n XÃ£
        if "TÃªn xÃ£" in df_filtered.columns:
            ds_xa = sorted(df_filtered["TÃªn xÃ£"].dropna().unique().tolist())
            if not ds_xa:
                st.warning("KhÃ´ng cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u xÃ£ nÃ o trong PGD Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»n.")
                return
            chon_xa = st.selectbox("Chá»n XÃ£/PhÆ°á»ng", ds_xa, key="gb_xa")
            df_xa = df_filtered[df_filtered["TÃªn xÃ£"] == chon_xa].copy()
        else:
            st.warning("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y cá»™t 'TÃªn xÃ£' trong dá»¯ liá»‡u.")
            return
        
        if df_xa.empty:
            st.warning(f"KhÃ´ng cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u cho xÃ£ **{chon_xa}**")
            return

        # Chá»n Ä‘iá»ƒm giao dá»‹ch
        import db
        dgd_map = db.doc_dgd_map()
        
        # Láº¥y PGD hiá»‡n táº¡i
        current_pgd = pgd_user if is_pgd_role(role) else (
            chon_pgd if 'chon_pgd' in locals() else pgd_user
        )
        
        ds_dgd = []
        chon_dgd = None
        ds_thon_dgd = None
        ten_dgd = None
        
        if current_pgd and current_pgd in dgd_map and chon_xa in dgd_map[current_pgd]:
            ds_dgd = list(dgd_map[current_pgd][chon_xa].keys())
        
        if not ds_dgd:
            st.info(
                "âš ï¸ XÃ£ nÃ y chÆ°a cáº¥u hÃ¬nh Ä‘iá»ƒm giao dá»‹ch. "
                "VÃ o tab **ðŸ“ Äiá»ƒm GD cá»§a tÃ´i** Ä‘á»ƒ thÃªm/cáº­p nháº­t."
            )
            # Váº«n cho phÃ©p tiáº¿p tá»¥c - lá»c theo toÃ n xÃ£
            chon_dgd = None
            ds_thon_dgd = None
            df_dgd = df_xa.copy()
            ten_dgd = chon_xa
        else:
            chon_dgd = st.selectbox("ðŸ“ Äiá»ƒm giao dá»‹ch", ds_dgd, key="gb_dgd")
            ds_thon_dgd = dgd_map[current_pgd][chon_xa][chon_dgd]
            ten_dgd = chon_dgd
            st.caption(f"Quáº£n lÃ½: {', '.join(ds_thon_dgd)}")
            
            # Lá»c df theo thÃ´n/áº¥p cá»§a Ä‘iá»ƒm giao dá»‹ch
            if "TÃªn thÃ´n" in df_xa.columns:
                df_dgd = df_xa[df_xa["TÃªn thÃ´n"].isin(ds_thon_dgd)].copy()
            else:
                df_dgd = df_xa.copy()
                st.warning("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y cá»™t 'TÃªn thÃ´n' Ä‘á»ƒ lá»c theo Ä‘iá»ƒm giao dá»‹ch.")
        
        if df_dgd.empty:
            st.warning(f"KhÃ´ng cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u cho Ä‘iá»ƒm giao dá»‹ch **{chon_dgd or chon_xa}**")
            return
        
        st.divider()
        
        # â‘¡ Báº£ng tá»•ng há»£p theo ÄVUT
        st.markdown("**â‘¡ Tá»•ng há»£p theo ÄVUT**")
        
        # ÄÃ¡nh dáº¥u khÃ¡ch hÃ ng 3 thÃ¡ng khÃ´ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng
        df_dgd_marked = danh_dau_khong_hd(df_dgd)
        
        # Groupby theo TÃªn ÄVUT
        if "TÃªn ÄVUT" not in df_dgd.columns:
            st.warning("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y cá»™t 'TÃªn ÄVUT' trong dá»¯ liá»‡u.")
            return
        
        # TÃ­nh toÃ¡n cÃ¡c cá»™t
        agg_dict = {
            "Sá»‘ Tá»•": ("TÃªn tá»•", lambda x: x.nunique() if "TÃªn tá»•" in df_dgd.columns else 0),
            "Sá»‘ KH": (COT_MA_KH, lambda x: x.nunique()),
            "Tá»•ng dÆ° ná»£": (COT_TONG_DU_NO, lambda x: pd.to_numeric(x, errors="coerce").fillna(0).sum()),
            "Ná»£ quÃ¡ háº¡n": (COT_DU_NO_QH, lambda x: pd.to_numeric(x, errors="coerce").fillna(0).sum()),
        }
        
        # ThÃªm cÃ¡c cá»™t cÃ³ Ä‘iá»u kiá»‡n
        if "Giáº£i ngÃ¢n trong thÃ¡ng" in df_dgd.columns:
            agg_dict["Doanh sá»‘ cho vay thÃ¡ng"] = ("Giáº£i ngÃ¢n trong thÃ¡ng", 
                lambda x: pd.to_numeric(x, errors="coerce").fillna(0).sum())
        
        # TÃ­nh doanh sá»‘ thu ná»£ (cá»™ng 3 cá»™t náº¿u cÃ³)
        thu_no_cols = ["Thu ná»£ TH thÃ¡ng", "Thu ná»£ QH thÃ¡ng", "Thu ná»£ khoanh thÃ¡ng"]
        existing_thu_no_cols = [col for col in thu_no_cols if col in df_dgd.columns]
        if existing_thu_no_cols:
            for col in existing_thu_no_cols:
                df_dgd[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_dgd[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
            df_dgd["Tá»•ng thu ná»£ thÃ¡ng"] = df_dgd[existing_thu_no_cols].sum(axis=1)
            agg_dict["Doanh sá»‘ thu ná»£ thÃ¡ng"] = ("Tá»•ng thu ná»£ thÃ¡ng", "sum")
        
        if "DÆ° ná»£ khoanh" in df_dgd.columns:
            agg_dict["Ná»£ khoanh"] = ("DÆ° ná»£ khoanh", 
                lambda x: pd.to_numeric(x, errors="coerce").fillna(0).sum())
        
        # Sá»‘ khoáº£n 3m KHÄ
        if "is_3m_inactive" in df_dgd_marked.columns:
            df_dgd["is_3m_inactive"] = df_dgd_marked["is_3m_inactive"]
            agg_dict["Sá»‘ khoáº£n 3m KHÄ"] = ("is_3m_inactive", "sum")
        
        # Táº¡o báº£ng tá»•ng há»£p - chá»‰ sá»­ dá»¥ng nhá»¯ng cá»™t thá»±c sá»± tá»“n táº¡i
        valid_agg_dict = {}
